words: A law about the edge of every place, not between two: a run that is inside a region and then outside took a step that does not keep the region (necessary). Same shape as not-going-out exit 1 and what-a-gate-keeps exits 1 and 2. Could be a standing note on every 'stays'.

atlas.text: Along a run of a process, where it is inside a region at step n and outside at step n + 1, the move at step n does not keep the region. A region every move taken keeps need not be invariant.
atlas.to: outside the region R at step n + 1 from inside it at step n: the move the run took at step n is one under which R is not absorbing (¬ AbsorbingUnder P R (r.act n))

words: One two-state example of exit 1; same treatment.

atlas.text: In Exit, {true} is absorbing under the move false and not under the move true; the run that leaves takes, at its first step, a move that does not keep {true} (a witness on two configurations).
atlas.to: a witness: in Exit (configurations and moves are bits, the move true flips), {true} is absorbing under the move false and not under true, so not invariant; the run that leaves is in {true} at step 0 and out of it at step 1, and its move at step 0 does not keep {true}

words: Sufficient, with a bound: among m listed conditions, anything that cannot come back to itself is among what comes round before step m. The law's 'returns' includes staying put.

atlas.text: Within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m.
atlas.to: a course of the determined law from any configuration, within m listed configurations -> at a configuration that returns, at some step below m

words: Witness (OneWay): possible, not forced. One course goes in and never comes out, another from the same spot keeps coming round.

atlas.text: A configuration possibly drawn may return on another course: in OneWay, false is possibly but not necessarily drawn into {true}, which the process never leaves, and returns (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: in OneWay, false is possibly drawn into {true}, a region the process never leaves, is not necessarily drawn into it (the run that keeps false never enters it), and returns

words: Sufficient: taking only the steps after which it can still be had keeps it within reach.

atlas.text: Keeping, the steps after which s can still be had, can have s from where the process can and keeps s; a process keeping s has no juncture for s on its course.
atlas.to: the sub-process keeping P s (the steps after which s can still be had) keeps s: from wherever its course from s leads it can have s again (Keeps (keeping P s) s)

words: Necessary: at a fork the chooser's step keeps it (instead of losing it) only if what happened had reached the chooser before the fork. Needs 'felt' loosened to a chooser with no rule; otherwise unresolved.

atlas.text: Where the step chosen in one course keeps s, and the step chosen in the other leads somewhere and loses s wherever it leads, x is a juncture for s and the source has, not not, reached the reader by D: to turn a reader at a juncture, a source must reach it before. Finding the reaching outright needs reaching decided.
atlas.to: x is a juncture for s, and the source has, not not, reached the reader g by D (¬ ¬ ReachedBy L L' W obs source g D)

words: Necessary (up to double negation): every way from something that returns to where it cannot be had again passes a fork, a spot with one step that keeps it and one that loses it, and takes the second.

atlas.text: Where s returns, every course from s, or from a configuration that can have s, to one that cannot passes, up to double negation, a juncture at which it takes its losing step.
atlas.to: a configuration from which s can be had (s itself, or x with Reach P x s), s returning -> a configuration t from which s cannot be had again (¬ Reach P t s)

words: A deadline within 'felt': a chooser not reached by the time of the fork takes the same step as if nothing had happened. Joins the pilot's pair 'in time / too late'.

atlas.text: World, with a process; before D both courses balanced with the same formations present, a common start, and every formation the source has not reached responding through its couplings; the reader at one configuration x in both courses supplied: a reader the source has not reached by D, whose step at x is chosen from what it reads through its couplings up to D, takes the same step in both courses; so to turn a reader at a juncture a source must have, not not, reached it by D.
atlas.to: a reader g the source has not reached by D: its step at x, chosen from what it reads through its couplings up to D, is the same in both courses -> the reader's step at x keeps s in one course and loses it in the other: x is a juncture for s and the source has, not not, reached g by D

words: Edge law as attraction exit 1: a line from inside to outside has a step going out (necessary). No two places.

atlas.text: Where every step of continuation keeps to the region, its end a member wherever its start is, or goes from a member to something outside, a line from a member to something outside has a step going out, reached from the start and reaching the end.
atlas.to: a step of continuation from a member of P to something outside P, placed on the line: reached from the line's start and reaching its end

words: Witness (Restored): where the giver does not itself need the stock, a part inactive for one step is active again once the giver gives.

atlas.text: Without the gate a formation inactive at the step the excess reaches can be active again: a part inactive at step 1, where a renewer not requiring the condition gives, is active from step 2 on (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness without the gate: after one step of joint excess a part depending on the condition is inactive at step 1; a renewer that requires nothing gives to the condition at step 1, and the part is active at every step from 2 on

words: Necessary: after a loss that never comes back, whatever is still active needs the thing less or not at all. With the need fixed it is not active (ended). Same law as three-outcomes exit 2.

atlas.text: Where activity needs support, a formation still active after a loss without return has weakened or dissolved its dependence on the condition; with its dependence fixed it is not active after the loss.
atlas.to: three-outcomes-of-a-loss

words: Necessary: going on with a need at least as strong as before means the level meets the earlier need again.

atlas.text: Under Dependent, a formation active with a dependence at least as strong as an earlier one finds the condition meeting the earlier need.
atlas.to: the condition meets g's earlier need at t (W.need T g c ≤ W.level t c): where g is active at t with a dependence on c at least as strong as at T, the loss is restored at t

words: Necessary: still active after a loss without return means the need has weakened or dissolved.

atlas.text: Under Dependent, after a loss without return, a formation still active has weakened or dissolved its dependence on the condition. A lowered need counts as transformation; an application telling weakening from substitution refines it by Dissolves and Forms.
atlas.to: at every step t after T at which g is still active, g no longer requires c at a need at least its need at T: its dependence on c has weakened or dissolved (¬ (W.requires t g c ∧ W.need T g c ≤ W.need t g c))

words: Witness (Crossing): three runs from one break; the move that makes the break picks which. One item, three arrows; the later reader may split it.

atlas.text: From one configuration of one process, three runs break the same dependence at the first step, read at the step's start: one ends with no return of the loss, one dissolves it as a dependence on the second condition forms and stays active with no return of the loss, one waits while the condition is renewed and keeps the dependence again (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: from one configuration of one process, three runs break the same dependence at the first step, read at the step's start: in one the formation ends and the loss is lost; in one the dependence dissolves as one on a second condition forms, the formation stays active and the loss is lost; in one the formation waits, the condition is renewed, and the dependence is kept again from step 2

words: Exact: under a standing draw H a level ends exactly where it starts below the point H + y; from the point up it never falls below its start (stays within-what-returns).

atlas.text: From a level up to the top, under the law's premises, the condition ends exactly where it starts below H + y; from H + y up to the top the level never falls below its start.
atlas.to: from a start level up to hi, the condition ends (its level is 0 at some step) exactly where the start is below H + y: from H + y up to hi it never ends

words: Witness (Crossing.crosses), and the reverse in the same witness: where giving follows with a lag, what was given lately carries a level across the point either way.

atlas.text: Where giving adjusts, what was given can carry a condition across the point: with giving moving one unit a step toward the regime's, from four with recent giving six the level is at least seven from the second step on, and from five with recent giving nothing it is nothing, where the regime's step ends four and holds five (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness with giving that adjusts one unit a step toward the regime's (Adjusted.Between and Settles): from level 4 with recent giving 6 the level is at least 7 from the second step on, and from level 5 with recent giving 0 it is 0 from the second step on, where the regime's own step ends the condition from 4 and holds it from 5

words: The exact line between the two (same law as exit 1): a level pushed below H + y falls at every step; at or above it holds.

atlas.text: Where giving falls short of the draw below y, gives nothing from nothing, meets it at every z from y with z + H at most a top hi the step keeps, and 0 < H + y, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y.
atlas.to: a start level up to hi below the point H + y: the level reaches 0 at some step -> a start level from H + y up to hi: the level never falls below its start nor exceeds hi

words: Where its edge lies: for two draws together the point rises by at least the sum of their separate rises less one; two draws each held alone can end the stock together.

atlas.text: With joint giving subadditive above the need and, at each amount left, no greater than under either draw, where the least levels meeting the two draws and the joint draw lie a, b and c above the need, a + b ≤ c + 1.

words: The draw is raised beyond all giving: then the stock ends from every level within as many steps as it stood. A larger draw raises the point by at least the difference.

atlas.text: Where nothing gives from nothing, a draw beyond all giving ends the condition from every level; a larger draw, giving no more, raises the point by at least the difference.
atlas.to: a draw H that giving meets at a least level y, the point of no return at H + y -> a draw beyond all giving (g z < H at every level z): the condition ends from every level within as many steps as it stood

words: A window: not below a given level before (start minus level)/H steps; below it within (start minus level)/(H minus Y) steps where giving is at most Y.

atlas.text: The time to break lies in a band: the level stays at or above b at every step n with b + H n ≤ x; where giving is at most Y and Y ≤ H ≤ b, it falls below b within any n with x < b + (H − Y) n.
atlas.to: steps n with b + H n ≤ x: the level is at or above b -> giving at most Y with Y ≤ H ≤ b, by any n with x < b + (H − Y) n: the level has fallen below b at some step up to n

words: Exact: the run comes to rest below the draw exactly from levels below a threshold that depends on what was given lately. 'Ended' here is rest below the draw; G's 'at rest' may fit better.

atlas.text: The run from a level and a recent giving up to hi, under an adjustment rising in both and a band, rests below the draw exactly where the level is below the threshold for its recent giving.
atlas.to: from a level up to hi at or above the threshold for its recent giving, the run does not come to rest below the draw

words: The exact line again, now in level and recent giving. Needs giving that rises with what is left: without it no level separates the two (Notch).

atlas.text: Where a fate is down-closed in the level and read off an exact check, the least level up to a bound from which the check fails is exact. Rising with what is left cannot be dropped: in a witness whose giving does not rise with it, no level separates the fates (Notch).
atlas.to: a level up to hi below the threshold for its recent giving: the run comes to rest below the draw -> a level up to hi at or above the threshold: the run does not come to rest below the draw

words: By chance alone, nothing answering the level: within n steps on at most n·p·q/m² of the weight. A bound on how often, not a condition. Loose origin: rises and falls balance, nothing holds it.

atlas.text: The courses of n steps reaching the need weigh, times m·m, at most n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ: at most n·p·q/m² of the weight.
atlas.to: a level standing m above a need, raised q by each one and lowered p by each zero -> the level at the need or below it at some step within n steps, on courses weighing at most n·p·q/m² of the weight

words: Necessary: lasting longer than the stock on hand means something that is itself supplied is giving to it.

atlas.text: With balance at the condition and givers supported over the stretch, requiring and taking for more steps than the initial level exhibits a supported feeder at one of them.
atlas.to: some formation supported at a step t from T before T + n feeds g's continuation there (∃ t f, L.FedBy W (g, t) (f, t) ∧ W.Supported t f)

words: Witness: either of two feeders is enough.

atlas.text: Either of two redundant feeders suffices: with either, the consumer is active and supported at every step (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: with either of two redundant feeders, or both, the consumer is active and supported at every step

words: Witness on a separate flow: each taking only from its own stock, both go on.

atlas.text: With the same dependences, each taking only from its own condition, the flow balances and both are active and supported at every step (a witness; a separate flow, not a course out of Overshoot).
atlas.to: a witness on a separate flow: with Overshoot's dependences, each formation taking only from its own condition, the flow balances and both formations are active and supported at every step

words: Sufficient, in a model where switching is built in: it stays active by switching; what it left ends.

atlas.text: In the support-gated law with a substitutable condition, where the focal formation draws beyond renewal from the start (both needs positive, the focal need within the sustaining one and met at the start), it stays active at every step by switching, still consuming, and the sustaining formation ends. The ability to switch is a modelling choice, and the alternative's level is constant.
atlas.to: substitution-preserves-consumption

words: A window: taking while nothing supplied gives to the stock, active for at most as many steps as the level. The law says 'not active at some step'; whether that is final is not stated.

atlas.text: Active for at most as many consecutive steps from T as the condition's level at T, while nothing supported gives to it.
atlas.to: g taking from c at every step from T at which it is active, nothing supported giving to c while g is active -> g not active at some step within W.level T c + 1 consecutive steps from T

words: Exact: having switched, it still counts as having taken more than came back exactly where the loss shows on a need the switch leaves in place (another's, or its own earlier one).

atlas.text: Consumption is kept under every change of the consumer's own dependence from T₀ on exactly when it consumes through a dependence that change leaves.
atlas.to: where the consumer consumes through no dependence that such a change leaves, not every such change keeps it consuming (¬ ∀ V, DependenceChanged V f T₀ → V.ConsumingIn f)

words: Witness (Lone): alone on the stock, dropping the need removes the overdraw.

atlas.text: A lone formation consumes through no dependence a change from step 0 leaves, and with its dependence dissolved it no longer consumes (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: a lone formation consuming only through its own dependence from step 0; on the web where that dependence is dissolved (DependenceChanged from 0) it no longer consumes

words: Witness: with no draw on the link between, a part downstream of an end holds for ever.

atlas.text: With no draw on the middle of a chain the first still ends, yet the third, downstream of it, holds at two for ever: positive draws on dependents cannot be dropped (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: with no draw on the middle condition of a three-link chain, the first still ends, while the third, downstream of it, holds at two at every step

words: Witness: where its edge lies. From level two it ends with its partner at nothing and holds with its partner at two.

atlas.text: Support can save: from two the first ends with its partner at nothing and holds with its partner at two; its threshold is three at a partner of nothing and two at a partner of two (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness of mutual support: from level two the first condition ends with its partner at nothing and holds with its partner at two; its threshold is three at a partner of nothing and two at a partner of two

words: Witness (Relay.cycles): two stocks each of which would end alone go round for ever together. Target is family F's support-beyond-a-band-can-cycle.

atlas.text: Beyond a band support can sustain a cycle: a pair each of which ends alone moves between two and three and three and two for ever from two and three (a witness).
atlas.to: support-beyond-a-band-can-cycle

words: Witness (Momentum): the edge lies lower after recent giving.

atlas.text: What was given can lower a threshold: one condition under a draw of two gives one where something is left and nothing was given last, two where something was; levels up to four, its threshold is four having given nothing and three having given one, so from three it ends having given nothing and holds having given one (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness with a recent giving: one condition under a draw of two, giving one where something is left and nothing was given last and two where something was; levels up to four, its threshold is four having given nothing and three having given one

words: Exact line for one of two stocks that support each other; it does not rise as the partner's level rises.

atlas.text: Within a band under mutual support, in whole numbers, whether the first condition ends is decided at step 2 hi + 1; for each partner's level up to hi it ends exactly below a least level found by a finite search, which does not rise as the partner's level rises.
atlas.to: the first of two coupled conditions, its level up to hi below its least level for the partner's level: it ends -> its level at or above that least level, up to hi: it does not end

words: The same line for any listed number of stocks; a finite check.

atlas.text: For finitely many listed conditions within a band under mutual support, each condition's point of no return, the others' levels given, is a least level up to hi + 1 below which exactly it ends, and does not rise as any other level rises; in a finite web read condition by condition, where the run stays within a bound B, a condition ends exactly where it is nothing at every step from L = (B + 1)^n to 2 L.
atlas.to: condition i of a finite web, its level up to hi below its threshold, the others' levels given within the band: it ends -> its level at or above the threshold: it does not end

words: The same line where giving also follows what was given last.

atlas.text: For finitely many listed conditions whose giving also reads what each gave last, under mutual support, where the run from a condition's top level stays within a bound B: ending is a finite check, and the threshold is exact and does not rise as any level or recent giving rises.
atlas.to: condition i of a web with a recent giving, its level below its threshold, the run from its top level within a bound B: it ends -> its level at or above the threshold: it does not end; the threshold does not rise as any level or recent giving rises

words: Exact, but not a change between two places: a whole that needs every part goes on exactly while every part does. It carries 'ended' from a part to the whole. Wants a mark 'passes along dependence', with the cascade's own law and co-ending.

atlas.text: A whole of every part is active at every step from T on exactly where every part is: it persists with no arising, but only while no part ceases.
atlas.to: a whole of every part active at every step from T on, exactly where every part is active at every step from T on: it persists with no arising, only while no part ceases

words: Witness (Generations): the line, a whole of some member, is active at every step; the whole of every member at none. Needs outlives-members widened, else comes-round.

atlas.text: The same parts, the two wholes: in Generations a formation that is the whole of every member is active at no step, while the lineage, the whole of some member, is active at every step (a witness). Where a whole of some part has its parts arising only through a family drawn beyond its renewal, whole-drawing-beyond-renewal-ends' law ends it.
atlas.to: a witness: in Generations, a formation that is the whole of every member is active at no step (¬ web.active t v at every t)

words: Witness (Body): the line whose descendant needs something outside the body still has a member after the body's parts have ended; the one confined to the body ends with it.

atlas.text: In the witness Body, of two lineages meeting every clause of a rise, the confined one ends and the one whose descendant depends on a condition outside the body still has a member a cohort after every part depending on the body has ended; it has a member for one generation past the end.
atlas.to: a witness: in Body, the spreading lineage, whose descendant needs nothing of the body (so it is not confined to it), has a member at the second generation: lineage (generationsBy ofSpread) [spread] 2 = [spread₂]

words: Witness, two runs from the same stock: a relay stays here, a run-down goes faster-than-returns to ended. The size of the stock does not say which place it is in.

atlas.text: From the same stock s ≥ 1, a relay with no excess generates and a run-down degenerates (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: from the same stock s ≥ 1, a relay never in excess and never dissipated on keeps the stock at s and its lineage generates (生成), while a run-down in excess at each of its s steps and dissipated on degenerates (退化)

words: Witness: fed from outside, the takers within what is given.

atlas.text: A renewer giving from no listed condition and requiring none, with nothing in excess, meets none of the three premises, every formation active and supported at every step (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: a renewer giving two units at every step and requiring nothing, the takers within what is given, nothing in excess, the condition fed and not dissipated on; every formation active and supported at every step

words: Witness, loose fit: the giver needs nothing of the pool and goes on while the line it fed ends.

atlas.text: Drawn past by n steps of excess from a stock below n + m, a line so renewed degenerates the same, while the renewer's own line can go on (a witness with offspring numbers supplied, where the coupled gate fails at every need).
atlas.to: a witness without the gate: the renewer's own line, giving to the pool and requiring no condition, goes on (延) at the kind grain from (0, 1)

words: Witness: a relay that loses nothing keeps one member each generation on a stock of one. Could be outlives-members if widened.

atlas.text: Without dissipation a lossless relay keeps a lineage going within a family of stock one: dissipation is needed (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: without dissipation, a lossless relay keeps a lineage of one member at every generation within a family of stock one

words: A window: n steps of uptake above what is put back, from a stock below n + m; the line ends on every branch where all it reaches needs at least m.

atlas.text: n steps of a family's uptake above its replenishment from a stock below n + m; at need one the horizon is the stock.
atlas.to: a line from an active occurrence at a step not after T + n, the family's uptake above its replenishment for n steps from T, from a stock below n + m -> the line ends on every branch at the kind grain, where everything it reaches at T + n requires a member of the family at a need of at least m; at need one the horizon is the stock

words: A window: takers that at least double, on a stock given nothing, last at most log2(level + 1) generations. The law says not all stay active, not which stop.

atlas.text: Cohorts of takers that at least double, each member drawing a unit, on a condition given nothing, last at most log₂(level + 1) cohorts; and, where each active member takes from the condition and no cohort lists a member twice, where level + 1 < 2^n not every member of the first n stays active.
atlas.to: generations of takers from at least one, each at least doubling the one before, drawing on a condition given nothing -> the level at the start is at least 2^n − 1: they last at most log₂(level + 1) generations, and where level + 1 < 2^n not every member of the first n generations stays active

words: A window: where something is lost at every step, a line reproduces at most as many steps as the starting stock.

atlas.text: Over cohorts of descent within a family balanced and dissipated on at each step, a lineage reproduces at most the starting stock many steps and then ends; read by offspring number, a lineage that reproduced at its first step within such a family has a step, before the stock runs out, at which transmission lowered offspring number by more than selection and what transmission raised.
atlas.to: a lineage whose offspring stand within a family balanced and dissipated on at each step -> the generation after the starting stock's count of steps is empty: the lineage reproduces at most the starting stock many steps and then ends

words: A rise is undone by chance in the next draw: rare in large samples, never ruled out.

atlas.text: Where a listed step raised the share by the gap g = Np − (p + q)h, the samplings falling back to h/N or below weigh, times n²g², at most N²npq(p + q)ⁿ, and at least qⁿ: undoing selection is rare in large samples and, with q positive, never ruled out.
atlas.to: a listed step that raised the share by the gap g = N·p − (p + q)·h -> a sampling of n from the next generation falling back to h/N or below: such samplings weigh, times n²g², at most N²·n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ, and at least qⁿ

words: By chance the favoured kind is lost, with weight at least b^i: a lower bound, always possible.

atlas.text: The favoured kind is lost from i with weight at least b^i times every later history.
atlas.to: a count i ≤ M of the favoured kind among M + 1 -> the favoured kind lost (count nothing), the histories losing it weighing at least b^i times every later history

words: A rule nobody holds, taught only by its holders or not at all, stays with nobody. A rule taught from outside has holders after one step, but that is another rule, not a way out.

atlas.text: With no holder and no other, a quota of at least one, a level of at least one and a tenure of at least one, entrants on offer: where the rule is taught from outside it has holders after one step; taught by members or not at all it does not. Only that member of the family has holders after one step: it is another rule of the family, not a course out of a net taught by members. Nothing leaves the end, level zero with no member, at any source.
atlas.to: another rule of the family: from no holder and no other, at a quota, a level and a tenure of at least one, with entrants on offer, the rule taught from outside has holders after one step; taught by members, or not at all, it has none

words: Holders leave faster than they are replaced (tenure s at most the lag l), or the quota is nothing: no holder after s steps. H may supply a better origin ('taught only by its own members').

atlas.law: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«不及任则持尽», Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«额零则持尽»
atlas.text: Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l, or at a quota of 0 with no revision to a nonzero one, no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level.
atlas.to: a rule taught by members whose holders are of at most s cohorts, at any level, entrants on offer or not -> no holder left after s steps, where s ≤ l, or where the quota is nothing with no revision to a nonzero one

words: The constant take passes the renewal by d: the level then falls d a step and ends with no member.

atlas.law: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«恒取不逾生则存», Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«恒取逾生则减», Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«恒取逾生则尽»
atlas.text: A family with a constant take of A, closed under the steps that do not end: where A is at most the renewal the level does not fall from a level of at least one; where A is the renewal plus d, the level falls by d a step and the family ends in level zero with no member.
atlas.to: a family of states with a constant take at most the renewal, closed under the steps that do not end: from a level of at least one the level does not fall -> a constant take of the renewal plus d, d ≥ 1: the level falls by d a step and the family ends in level zero with no member

words: A gauge rebuilt from the level it measures, once gone, is brought back by no step. One rebuilt from the supply is back after one supplied step: another rule, not a way out.

atlas.text: Only where the rule's source differs: a reader rebuilt from the supply is present again after one supplied step, from every level. Nothing returns the reader rebuilt from the level, on any branch.
atlas.to: another rule of the family: a reader rebuilt from the supply, at least one unit wanted, gone, is present again after one supplied step, at every level

words: With the supply cut, a stock of 2(k + 1) keeps it for k + 1 steps; one rebuilt from the supply, or never rebuilt, is gone after its span whatever the stock.

atlas.law: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«断而有储则读者存», Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«断则取于供者尽», Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«不复建者尽»
atlas.text: Under a cut, the reader rebuilt from the level is present after k + 1 steps from every level of at least 2 (k + 1); a reader rebuilt from the supply, and one never rebuilt, are gone after their span from every level.
atlas.to: under a cut, from a level of at least 2 (k + 1) -> the reader rebuilt from the level is still present after k + 1 steps, while a reader rebuilt from the supply, or never rebuilt, is gone after its span from every level

words: Edge law as attraction exit 1: where ordinary steps keep a property, a way from having it to not having it passes a gated step (necessary).

atlas.text: Where the ungated steps preserve p, a course from where p holds to where it fails contains a gated move.
atlas.to: the course contains a gated move: some move a of the plan has gate a = true

words: The same, locating the one gated step that changes the quantity.

atlas.text: Where every ungated step keeps the quantity and its values have decidable equality, a course that changes it splits into a prefix keeping it, a gated step that itself changes it, and the rest.
atlas.to: the course splits into a prefix that keeps the quantity, a gated step that itself changes it, and the rest

words: Proved join with fixation-by-drift transition 1: what the ending of groups raised, the next draw can undo by chance. The 'from' side is groups ended.

words: Sufficient, not least: enough support on hand carries it through a finite correction into the kept region (H's never-leaving-a-guard). The support cannot be paid for by the gain it brings.

words: Exact, how long it lasts: n steps exactly when it stands on a ladder of n rungs, every allowed step landing one rung down. Target dynamic is H's.

words: A window: with less than 5 + N in stock the guarded run has stopped by step N. Stopping is leaving the guard; an end is not shown.

words: A sign near its own edge, not a change of place: it recovers from small pushes ever more slowly and swings wider. Says nothing of a dependent's need.

words: A window: unsupported from some step on, with a store that runs down, not active once as many steps have passed as the store.

words: Exact in one number M: the floor is kept from every allowed level exactly where M is at least 0.

words: Witness: from a box about the maintaining end, the guarded history never stops.

words: Exact threshold in a setting, same law as exit 1: below M = 0 a low region exists and some level drops under the floor at the next step. Entry into it is not shown.

words: A law of every edge, not a place: leaving a kept region takes a move that does not keep it (necessary). Belongs in the legend; could instead be drawn as the only way out of past-turning-back.

atlas.text: Along a run of a process, where it is inside a region at step n and outside at step n + 1, the move at step n does not keep the region. A region every move taken keeps need not be invariant.
atlas.to: outside the region R at step n + 1 from inside it at step n: the move the run took at step n is one under which R is not absorbing (¬ AbsorbingUnder P R (r.act n))

words: The same law as a two-state example (witness). Legend.

words: A region with no way back lying within reach does not mean it is entered: on another path the state comes back (witness).

words: Taking only the steps after which it can still be had keeps it (sufficient).

atlas.text: Keeping, the steps after which s can still be had, can have s from where the process can and keeps s; a process keeping s has no juncture for s on its course.
atlas.to: the sub-process keeping P s (the steps after which s can still be had) keeps s: from wherever its course from s leads it can have s again (Keeps (keeping P s) s)

words: At a fork, a chooser is turned only if word reached it before (necessary). Would be an arrow from felt if felt's test is widened.

atlas.text: Where the step chosen in one course keeps s, and the step chosen in the other leads somewhere and loses s wherever it leads, x is a juncture for s and the source has, not not, reached the reader by D: to turn a reader at a juncture, a source must reach it before. Finding the reaching outright needs reaching decided.
atlas.to: x is a juncture for s, and the source has, not not, reached the reader g by D (¬ ¬ ReachedBy L L' W obs source g D)

words: Every loss passes a fork: one step after which it can still be had, one after which it cannot (necessary, up to double negation).

atlas.text: Where s returns, every course from s, or from a configuration that can have s, to one that cannot passes, up to double negation, a juncture at which it takes its losing step.
atlas.to: a configuration from which s can be had (s itself, or x with Reach P x s), s returning -> a configuration t from which s cannot be had again (¬ Reach P t s)

words: The same law as exit 2 said as a deadline: unreached by D, the chooser steps the same either way. Joins felt if its test is widened; otherwise inside can-return.

atlas.text: World, with a process; before D both courses balanced with the same formations present, a common start, and every formation the source has not reached responding through its couplings; the reader at one configuration x in both courses supplied: a reader the source has not reached by D, whose step at x is chosen from what it reads through its couplings up to D, takes the same step in both courses; so to turn a reader at a juncture a source must have, not not, reached it by D.
atlas.to: a reader g the source has not reached by D: its step at x, chosen from what it reads through its couplings up to D, is the same in both courses -> the reader's step at x keeps s in one course and loses it in the other: x is a juncture for s and the source has, not not, reached g by D

words: A law of every edge: a line from inside to outside has a step going out (necessary). Legend.

atlas.text: Where every step of continuation keeps to the region, its end a member wherever its start is, or goes from a member to something outside, a line from a member to something outside has a step going out, reached from the start and reaching the end.
atlas.to: a step of continuation from a member of P to something outside P, placed on the line: reached from the line's start and reaching its end

words: Without the gate: something that needs nothing of it gives to it, and the dependent is active again (witness).

atlas.text: Without the gate a formation inactive at the step the excess reaches can be active again: a part inactive at step 1, where a renewer not requiring the condition gives, is active from step 2 on (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness without the gate: after one step of joint excess a part depending on the condition is inactive at step 1; a renewer that requires nothing gives to the condition at step 1, and the part is active at every step from 2 on

words: With its dependence unchanged, what depended on it is not active after the loss (necessary). Same law as three-outcomes exit 2; drawn once each way out.

atlas.text: Where activity needs support, a formation still active after a loss without return has weakened or dissolved its dependence on the condition; with its dependence fixed it is not active after the loss.
atlas.to: three-outcomes-of-a-loss

words: Going on with a dependence as strong as before means the level is back at the earlier need (necessary).

atlas.text: Under Dependent, a formation active with a dependence at least as strong as an earlier one finds the condition meeting the earlier need.
atlas.to: the condition meets g's earlier need at t (W.need T g c ≤ W.level t c): where g is active at t with a dependence on c at least as strong as at T, the loss is restored at t

words: Still active after a loss without return means its dependence on that thing weakened or dissolved (necessary).

atlas.text: Under Dependent, after a loss without return, a formation still active has weakened or dissolved its dependence on the condition. A lowered need counts as transformation; an application telling weakening from substitution refines it by Dissolves and Forms.
atlas.to: at every step t after T at which g is still active, g no longer requires c at a need at least its need at T: its dependence on c has weakened or dissolved (¬ (W.requires t g c ∧ W.need T g c ≤ W.need t g c))

words: One item, three arrows: from one break, one run ends, one moves to a second source, one waits and is supplied again (witness; the break does not decide).

atlas.text: From one configuration of one process, three runs break the same dependence at the first step, read at the step's start: one ends with no return of the loss, one dissolves it as a dependence on the second condition forms and stays active with no return of the loss, one waits while the condition is renewed and keeps the dependence again (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: from one configuration of one process, three runs break the same dependence at the first step, read at the step's start: in one the formation ends and the loss is lost; in one the dependence dissolves as one on a second condition forms, the formation stays active and the loss is lost; in one the formation waits, the condition is renewed, and the dependence is kept again from step 2

words: Below the point (the draw plus the least level at which giving meets it) the level falls at every step to nothing (exact).

atlas.text: From a level up to the top, under the law's premises, the condition ends exactly where it starts below H + y; from H + y up to the top the level never falls below its start.
atlas.to: from a start level up to hi, the condition ends (its level is 0 at some step) exactly where the start is below H + y: from H + y up to hi it never ends

words: Where its edge lies: with giving that adjusts, what was given lately carries a level across the point either way (witness).

atlas.text: Where giving adjusts, what was given can carry a condition across the point: with giving moving one unit a step toward the regime's, from four with recent giving six the level is at least seven from the second step on, and from five with recent giving nothing it is nothing, where the regime's step ends four and holds five (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness with giving that adjusts one unit a step toward the regime's (Adjusted.Between and Settles): from level 4 with recent giving 6 the level is at least 7 from the second step on, and from level 5 with recent giving 0 it is 0 from the second step on, where the regime's own step ends the condition from 4 and holds it from 5

words: From the point up, the level never falls below its start (the other side of exit 1's iff; the threshold is the edge between the two places).

atlas.text: Where giving falls short of the draw below y, gives nothing from nothing, meets it at every z from y with z + H at most a top hi the step keeps, and 0 < H + y, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y.
atlas.to: a start level up to hi below the point H + y: the level reaches 0 at some step -> a start level from H + y up to hi: the level never falls below its start nor exceeds hi

words: Where its edge lies for two draws together: at least the sum of each alone's rise, less one; two draws each held alone can end it together.

atlas.text: With joint giving subadditive above the need and, at each amount left, no greater than under either draw, where the least levels meeting the two draws and the joint draw lie a, b and c above the need, a + b ≤ c + 1.

words: The draw grows: a larger draw raises the point by at least the difference; a draw beyond all giving ends it from every level within as many steps as it stood.

atlas.text: Where nothing gives from nothing, a draw beyond all giving ends the condition from every level; a larger draw, giving no more, raises the point by at least the difference.
atlas.to: a draw H that giving meets at a least level y, the point of no return at H + y -> a draw beyond all giving (g z < H at every level z): the condition ends from every level within as many steps as it stood

words: A band on the time to the break: not before (x − b)/H steps; with giving at most Y, within (x − b)/(H − Y).

atlas.text: The time to break lies in a band: the level stays at or above b at every step n with b + H n ≤ x; where giving is at most Y and Y ≤ H ≤ b, it falls below b within any n with x < b + (H − Y) n.
atlas.to: steps n with b + H n ≤ x: the level is at or above b -> giving at most Y with Y ≤ H ≤ b, by any n with x < b + (H − Y) n: the level has fallen below b at some step up to n

words: At or above the threshold for its recent giving, the run does not come to rest below the draw (exact).

atlas.text: The run from a level and a recent giving up to hi, under an adjustment rising in both and a band, rests below the draw exactly where the level is below the threshold for its recent giving.
atlas.to: from a level up to hi at or above the threshold for its recent giving, the run does not come to rest below the draw

words: Where its edge lies in level and recent giving together: a least level that does not rise as recent giving rises; with giving that does not rise with what is left, no level separates.

atlas.text: Where a fate is down-closed in the level and read off an exact check, the least level up to a bound from which the check fails is exact. Rising with what is left cannot be dropped: in a witness whose giving does not rise with it, no level separates the fates (Notch).

words: By chance alone: a level m above its need reaches the need within n steps on at most n·p·q/m² of the weight. It can fall and recover.

words: Each taking only from its own source, both go on at every step (witness on a separate flow, not a path out).

words: A whole of every part goes on exactly while every part does: one part ceasing ends it (exact; the other side of the iff is staying).

words: Given to from outside, takers within what is given: all go on at every step (witness).
