atlas.to: generations of takers from at least one, each at least doubling the one before, drawing on a condition given nothing -> the level at the start is at least 2^n − 1: they last at most log₂(level + 1) generations, and where level + 1 < 2^n not every member of the first n generations stays active

words: Where each passing loses some, a line reproduces at most as many steps as the starting stock, then ends (window).

atlas.text: Over cohorts of descent within a family balanced and dissipated on at each step, a lineage reproduces at most the starting stock many steps and then ends; read by offspring number, a lineage that reproduced at its first step within such a family has a step, before the stock runs out, at which transmission lowered offspring number by more than selection and what transmission raised.
atlas.to: a lineage whose offspring stand within a family balanced and dissipated on at each step -> the generation after the starting stock's count of steps is empty: the lineage reproduces at most the starting stock many steps and then ends

words: What the rule raised, chance in who is drawn next can undo: rare in large samples, never ruled out (exit by drift, bounds both ways).

atlas.text: Where a listed step raised the share by the gap g = Np − (p + q)h, the samplings falling back to h/N or below weigh, times n²g², at most N²npq(p + q)ⁿ, and at least qⁿ: undoing selection is rare in large samples and, with q positive, never ruled out.
atlas.to: a listed step that raised the share by the gap g = N·p − (p + q)·h -> a sampling of n from the next generation falling back to h/N or below: such samplings weigh, times n²g², at most N²·n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ, and at least qⁿ

words: By chance the favoured kind is lost from a count of i, with weight at least b^i of every later history; all are then the other kind.

atlas.text: The favoured kind is lost from i with weight at least b^i times every later history.
atlas.to: a count i ≤ M of the favoured kind among M + 1 -> the favoured kind lost (count nothing), the histories losing it weighing at least b^i times every later history

words: Only a differently built rule (taught from outside) has holders again after one step; it is another rule, not a path out. Nothing leaves the end.

atlas.text: With no holder and no other, a quota of at least one, a level of at least one and a tenure of at least one, entrants on offer: where the rule is taught from outside it has holders after one step; taught by members or not at all it does not. Only that member of the family has holders after one step: it is another rule of the family, not a course out of a net taught by members. Nothing leaves the end, level zero with no member, at any source.
atlas.to: another rule of the family: from no holder and no other, at a quota, a level and a tenure of at least one, with entrants on offer, the rule taught from outside has holders after one step; taught by members, or not at all, it has none

words: Holders leave no later than those they teach take over, or the quota is nothing: no holder after s steps. From-place rough: 'a rule kept up by members teaching members' may be family H's.

atlas.law: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«不及任则持尽», Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«额零则持尽»
atlas.text: Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l, or at a quota of 0 with no revision to a nonzero one, no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level.
atlas.to: a rule taught by members whose holders are of at most s cohorts, at any level, entrants on offer or not -> no holder left after s steps, where s ≤ l, or where the quota is nothing with no revision to a nonzero one

words: A constant take at most the renewal holds the level; the renewal plus d makes it fall d a step, and it ends with no member.

atlas.law: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«恒取不逾生则存», Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«恒取逾生则减», Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«恒取逾生则尽»
atlas.text: A family with a constant take of A, closed under the steps that do not end: where A is at most the renewal the level does not fall from a level of at least one; where A is the renewal plus d, the level falls by d a step and the family ends in level zero with no member.
atlas.to: a family of states with a constant take at most the renewal, closed under the steps that do not end: from a level of at least one the level does not fall -> a constant take of the renewal plus d, d ≥ 1: the level falls by d a step and the family ends in level zero with no member

words: Only a differently built one (rebuilt from the supply) is present again after a supplied step; another rule, not a path out.

atlas.text: Only where the rule's source differs: a reader rebuilt from the supply is present again after one supplied step, from every level. Nothing returns the reader rebuilt from the level, on any branch.
atlas.to: another rule of the family: a reader rebuilt from the supply, at least one unit wanted, gone, is present again after one supplied step, at every level

words: How long the store lasts under a cut: still present after k + 1 steps from a level of at least 2(k + 1); the store buys time only where the rebuilding draws on it.

atlas.law: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«断而有储则读者存», Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«断则取于供者尽», Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«不复建者尽»
atlas.text: Under a cut, the reader rebuilt from the level is present after k + 1 steps from every level of at least 2 (k + 1); a reader rebuilt from the supply, and one never rebuilt, are gone after their span from every level.
atlas.to: under a cut, from a level of at least 2 (k + 1) -> the reader rebuilt from the level is still present after k + 1 steps, while a reader rebuilt from the supply, or never rebuilt, is gone after its span from every level

words: A law of every edge: a path from where something holds to where it fails contains a gated move (necessary). Legend.

atlas.text: Where the ungated steps preserve p, a course from where p holds to where it fails contains a gated move.
atlas.to: the course contains a gated move: some move a of the plan has gate a = true

words: The same: a change of a kept quantity splits into a keeping stretch, one gated step that changes it, and the rest. Legend.

atlas.text: Where every ungated step keeps the quantity and its values have decidable equality, a course that changes it splits into a prefix keeping it, a gated step that itself changes it, and the rest.
atlas.to: the course splits into a prefix that keeps the quantity, a gated step that itself changes it, and the rest

words: A join, not a change of place: what the ending of groups with less raised, a sampling of the next generation can undo, with the bounds of fixation-by-drift transition 1 (proved). May be better as unresolved, as the pilot left such joins.

atlas.to: {"dynamic": "fixation-by-drift", "law": "Becoming.Drift.falls_back", "role": "pool"}

words: Enough stored at the start carries it through a finite correction into the protected region (sufficient, not least; no one horizon serves every start).

atlas.text: With β = 0 actually holding during the pulse, then β = 1/2, extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step and no other shocks, each positive state has a horizon N at which initial support at least K_N carries it through a finite correction into the original protection; no single N serves every positive share. Sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.
atlas.to: never-leaving-a-guard

words: How long it lasts: n steps exactly when a ladder of levels holds it at level n (exact).

atlas.text: For every law with admissible disturbances and a guard, a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n (levels within the guard, every admissible step from level k + 1 landing at level k).
atlas.to: never-leaving-a-guard

words: A small start lasting N steps needs a stock of at least 5 + N; with less the guarded run has stopped by step N (window; a conservative bound, the model's numbers).

atlas.text: A guarded run of a physical pair with stock at least 5, nonnegative support shocks and share times (3/2)^N at most 1/6 lasting N steps needs stock at least 5 + N.
atlas.to: a guarded run of a physical pair (stock at least 5, nonnegative support shocks, share times (3/2)^N at most 1/6) that lasts N steps, its starting stock at least 5 + N -> a starting stock below 5 + N: the guarded run has stopped by step N

words: A reading, no law: a kind of arrow (a parameter change removes what kept a place). Legend of arrow kinds; compare margin transition 3.

atlas.text: A parameter change removing a region's retention.

words: A reading: a kind of arrow (a push into another kept place). Legend.

atlas.text: A shock into another retained region.

words: A reading: a kind of arrow (correction stops). Legend.

atlas.text: A failure stopping correction.

words: A reading: a kind of arrow (change too fast for correction). Legend.

atlas.text: Change too fast for correction.

words: A sign near its edge: as the margin shrinks, small pushes are taken back more slowly and swings grow. It tells nothing of a dependent's need.

atlas.text: Variance Var E/(1 − a²) and lag-1 autocorrelation a, with a rising to one as the margin shrinks at a fold (a = 1 − 2h√m) or a transcritical end under a proportional draw (a = 1 − h(r − q)).
atlas.to: a deviation about a rest stepping by multiplier a plus independent noise, stationary with a² < 1: variance Var E / (1 − a²) and lag-1 autocorrelation a -> as the margin to a fold shrinks (a = 1 − 2h√m) or a proportional draw rises to the renewal rate (a = 1 − h(r − q)), a rises to one and the stationary variance tends to infinity

words: Unsupplied from some step on, with a store that runs down: not active once as many steps have passed as the store (window).

atlas.text: Where the reserve decays, a formation unsupported from some step on is not active once as many steps have passed as its reserve.
atlas.to: a formation unsupported from step S on, its carried reserve decaying, with a reserve at S of at most n -> the formation not active at step S + n

words: Supply returning within the store finds it: unsupplied three steps with a store of three, active throughout (witness).

atlas.text: Unsupported at the first three steps and supported from step three on, a formation with a reserve of three, falling by one at each unsupported step, is active at every step: support returning within the reserve finds it (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: a formation unsupported at the first three steps and supported from step three on, with a reserve of three falling by one at each unsupported step, is active at every step: support returning within the reserve finds it

words: Unsupplied across n steps with a store of at most n: inactive with the store spent; for good only under the further premise that such a stop is final, and then supply returning finds nothing (window).

atlas.text: Carried, decaying and unsupported across the steps from S to S + n, with a reserve at S of at most n: inactive at S + n with the reserve spent; with an ending final from S + n on, inactive at every step from S + n on, support restored after the reserve is spent restoring nothing.
atlas.to: carried, decaying and unsupported across the steps from S to S + n, with a reserve at S of at most n -> inactive at S + n with the reserve spent; with the ending final from S + n on, inactive at every later step, support returning after the reserve is spent finding no dependent

words: Where its edge lies in the model's parameters: the floor is kept at the next step from every level exactly where the margin M is at least zero (exact).

atlas.text: The floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level θ ≤ q ≤ 1 under every influence 0 ≤ w ≤ λ exactly where M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ ≥ 0.
atlas.to: where the margin M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ is negative, the floor is not protected: some level θ ≤ q ≤ 1 under some influence 0 ≤ w ≤ λ falls below θ at the next step

words: From the box about the maintaining end, with stock of at least 5 and no shocks, the guarded history never stops (witness).

atlas.text: From the box about the maintenance end, with stock at least 5, the guarded history never fails, in the original example at β = 1/2 with no shocks.
atlas.to: a witness: in the original example at β = 1/2 with no shocks, from the box about the maintenance end with stock at least 5, the guarded history never stops

words: Rough: with M below zero a set of states below the floor exists; that any history enters it is not shown, so this may be leads-out. The same law as exit 1.

atlas.text: For α, β ≥ 0, α + β ≤ 1, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 < θ ≤ 1, the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level θ ≤ q ≤ 1 and influence 0 ≤ w ≤ λ, exactly where M ≥ 0; for α > 0, β ≥ 0, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 < θ < 1, the low-selection certificate exists exactly where M < 0.
atlas.to: margin M ≥ 0 (α, β ≥ 0, α + β ≤ 1, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1, 0 < θ ≤ 1): the floor is kept at the next step from every level θ ≤ q ≤ 1 under every influence 0 ≤ w ≤ λ -> margin M < 0 (α > 0, 0 < θ < 1): a low-selection certificate exists, a positive-width set of states below the floor

words: sufficient (Flow.joint_keeps): together they take no more than comes in at this step, so the level does not fall across it

atlas.text: In a balanced flow, taking jointly within what is given keeps the level.
atlas.to: across a step at which the formations together take from c at most what is given to it, under balance, the level of c does not fall across that step

words: sufficient (Flow.level_kept_of_plans): the take is divided so that no unit is counted by two; that an actual division is so is not shown. Leads on to H's division-by-exclusive-footprints

atlas.text: Under balance, with a division of the take by exclusive footprints at every step, the level never falls below its start; that an actual division is by exclusive footprints is not shown.
atlas.to: division-by-exclusive-footprints

words: witness (Alone): one taker with the same renewer keeps the level and both go on, where two takers end themselves and it

atlas.text: With one taker the same renewer keeps the level and both are active at every step, where in Exceeding two takers end themselves and their renewer.
atlas.to: witness (Alone): one taker and one renewer on one condition, balance and Dependent holding, the take jointly within what is given at every step, and both active at every step

words: witness (Restored.returns): what gives to it does not itself depend on it, so after one step over, the part stopped for one step is active again. Same law as position exit 0; draw once

atlas.text: A formation renewed from outside can be active again: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end, and the renewal restores the part from the next step on.
atlas.to: witness (Restored): after one step of joint excess the part is inactive at step 1; a renewer that requires nothing gives at that step, and the part is active at every step from step 2 on

words: witness (Pool): three takers; withholding either of the first two parts alone leaves the break, withholding both keeps it. One alone changes nothing

atlas.text: In Pool, withholding the first two drawers' parts together keeps the dependence where withholding either alone leaves the same move breaking it.
atlas.to: witness (Pool): from three drawers each taking one unit, the first two drawers' parts make the difference only together: withheld together they keep the sustaining formation's dependence, while withheld either alone the same move still breaks it

words: witness (Renewable): at the step that breaks it, taking nothing would keep it for that step; the outcome of the whole run is fixed by the rest of the run, not by any one taking

atlas.text: At the breaking step of the renewable witness, drawing nothing from the same configuration keeps the dependence: a step-level statement, which leaves the run-level outcome to the tail.
atlas.to: witness (Renewable): at the breaking step, from level one, drawing two breaks the sustaining formation's dependence, while from the same configuration drawing nothing keeps it

words: proved join to D's what-training-installs (Training.outrun_settles_iff): where the others alone take more than comes in, a score that looks at the stock only after they have emptied it scores every act of the one member alike, at any weight. Alternative reading: past-turning-back (the measure is taken too late)

atlas.to: {"dynamic": "what-training-installs", "law": "Becoming.Training.outrun_settles_iff", "role": "reading"}

words: sufficient (Flow.level_kept): jointly within what comes in at every step, the level never falls below its start

atlas.text: Taking jointly within what is given at every step keeps the level, and every formation depending on that condition alone at a need met at the start stays supported.
atlas.to: under balance, with the take jointly within what is given at every step, the level of c never falls below its start

words: witness (Sharing): room for two where neither takes all that comes in. Marks the edge of the place: one taking all leaves room for no other

atlas.text: Of a renewer giving two units across each step and two takers at need one, where each takes one, all three are supported and active at every step and neither takes all that is given, so the law needs its premise of full taking.
atlas.to: witness (Sharing): a renewer giving two units a step and two takers each taking one at need one: the take is jointly within what is given, neither taker takes all that is given, the second lives by taking, and all are active at every step

words: exact (Optimum.counted_after_keeps_iff): the need counted only after the target is reached; kept exactly where some way of reaching the target keeps it (one thing outside; with several, one can still be emptied)

atlas.text: A term on what lies beyond counted after the set point: with one condition beyond it keeps a need exactly where some way of reaching the set point keeps it; with several it can empty one (Spread.counted_after_empties); counting less, it drains (Topped.counted_less_drains).
atlas.to: where some eligible outcome stands at the set point, every optimum of the order by distance with the one condition c beyond counted after keeps a need at c exactly where some eligible outcome at the set point keeps it

words: witness (Topped.weighted_keeps): the source traded at any positive weight against the gap from the target; every best outcome meets the need

atlas.text: In the exchange witness, trading the source at any positive weight against the store's gap, every optimum meets the need.
atlas.to: witness (Topped): every optimum, among the outcomes open to the taker, of the order trading the source at a positive weight against the store's gap from its set point meets the dweller's need at the source

words: witness (Drain.satisficingThen_keeps): counted after a level that is 'enough', the source is kept at the dependant's need

atlas.text: Counted after an aspiration level it keeps as well: the plateau decides, not the set point.
atlas.to: witness (Drain): every optimum among the splits of three units of the order satisficing at a store of one with the source counted after leaves the source at two, the dweller's need

words: exact threshold (atSetPoint_broken_iff): topping up to the target, with what the step loses, takes more than the stock plus the spare above the dependant's need. The law says the dependence breaks at that step

atlas.text: In a balanced step in which the family with the one condition beyond gains nothing and the family stands at its set point after it, the dependence met at the step breaks exactly where the set point's total with the loss exceeds the family before with the slack.
atlas.to: the set point's total with what the whole loses is at most the family's stock before with the slack at the one condition c beyond: the dependence on c is kept across the step -> it exceeds W.stock ds t + (W.level t c − W.need t (dep c) c): the dependence on c is broken across the step

words: sufficient (Next.frontier_leaves): even with others drawing first, where some reachable level regrows faster than later is counted down, no best course empties it at once

atlas.text: Where nothing stands at nothing and some level within reach rises faster than the weighting falls, with what stands at it at least it and a capacity drawing down to it and holding it, no optimum ends the base at once.
atlas.to: where nothing stands at nothing and some level y within what stands at the start, with what stands at y at least y at every step, rises faster than the weighting falls at each step, over at least two steps, with a capacity drawing down to y and holding it: every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw stands above nothing after the first step (0 < x 1)

words: sufficient (Web.Next.frontier_rebuilds): from a low start every best course takes nothing while the stock regrows, restoring each dependant as its need is passed. Leads on to H's optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base

atlas.text: From a start at or below y, where what stands rises with the level below y and is at least y at y, and the weighted gain rises strictly up to y and is greatest there, with a capacity covering what stands at y and at nothing, every optimum follows the rising course below y, drawing nothing, restoring every dependence whose need it meets.
atlas.to: optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base

words: witness (Holding.doubling_drawn_first): alone every best course rebuilds the source; once others first draw all but a quarter of what it leaves, every best course empties it at once

atlas.text: Under w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1), a doubling source is rebuilt by every optimum alone and ended at once with others first drawing all but a quarter; drawing all but half, every optimum ends it under weights falling at every step, and at equal weights ending and holding at two are both optima.
atlas.to: witness (a source doubling up to eight, from two, capacity sixteen): where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1), every optimum alone rebuilds the source (four after the first step, eight after), while with others first drawing all but a quarter every optimum ends it at once and breaks the dweller needing two; where the weighting falls at every step, with others drawing all but half, every optimum ends it; at equal weights, with others drawing all but half, ending at once and holding at two are both optima

words: exact, both ways (AtOnce.drain_perfect_iff): taking everything stops being a best profile exactly where some drawer's portion returns more than one for one on what it alone leaves. What is then best is not shown

atlas.text: Drawing at once with no floor, drawing everything is perfect exactly where, at every step before the last and with the others drawing everything, no portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves. Which profiles are perfect where the drain is not is not shown.
atlas.to: drawing at once with no floor, where at some step before the last, the others drawing everything, some drawer's portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what it alone leaves: drawing everything is not perfect (which profiles are perfect then is not shown)

words: exact (AtOnce.whole_perfect_iff): one drawer given the whole empties it exactly where the whole never returns more than one for one

atlas.text: For one drawer given the whole, draining is perfect exactly where the whole never returns more than one for one.
atlas.to: for one drawer given all that stands, where at some step before the last what stands from some b left exceeds what stands from nothing, and b: drawing everything is not perfect

words: witness (Holding.doubling_capacity): a limit on how low the second may draw; the first then leaves everything and the dweller is kept. With no limit every best profile cuts the dweller off

atlas.text: A floor on the other's draw can keep the stock: under doubling with a one-unit floor on the second, the first leaves everything from three and the dweller is kept.
atlas.to: witness (doubling, two drawers in turn over two steps): with a one-unit floor on the second drawer, the profile keeping is perfect and in every perfect profile the first leaves everything from three, the dweller kept; with no floor, every perfect profile breaks the dweller

words: the same law as exit 0 (drain_perfect_iff) entered as a transition; draw once

atlas.text: Drawing at once with no floor, drawing everything is perfect exactly where, at every step before the last and with the others drawing everything, no portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves.
atlas.to: at every step before the last, the others drawing everything, no portion returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves: drawing everything is perfect -> at some step some portion does: drawing everything is not perfect

words: sufficient (Coupled.kept_above): each drawer counts, for every step the need is met, more than the need itself; on a stock that cannot regrow from below the need, every best profile leaves exactly the need

atlas.text: With two drawers or more and no floor, under the gate (below the need what stands next is below it, at or above it what stands next meets it, and what stands next from nothing, with the need, is at most what stands next from the need), where m < c every perfect profile has each drawer leave exactly the need of an amount meeting it and nothing of a smaller one, and from a start meeting the need it is met at every step to the horizon.
atlas.to: with two drawers or more in turn and no floor, under the gate (below the need what stands next is below it, at or above it what stands next meets it, and what stands next from nothing with the need is at most what stands next from the need), where m < c: every perfect profile has every drawer leave exactly the need of an amount meeting it and nothing of a smaller one, at every step before the horizon

words: tipping (Coupled.gated_threshold): at reward per step equal to the need both are best; below it every best profile leaves nothing (on to ended); above it every best profile keeps exactly the need

atlas.text: With two drawers or more in turn and no floor, on the gated renewal, for every q: where c < m every perfect profile drains at every step; where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect; where m ≤ c keeping the need is perfect; where m < c every perfect profile keeps exactly the need, and from a start meeting it it is met at every step; both profiles are perfect at c = m.
atlas.to: c < m: every perfect profile has every drawer leave nothing at every step before the horizon (and where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect) -> m < c: every perfect profile keeps exactly the need, and from a start meeting it the need is met at every step (and where m ≤ c keeping the need is perfect); at c = m both are perfect

words: witness (InTurn.Stopping.perfect_keeps) marking the edge: where a unit left stops what would regrow for the other, a racer keeps it to deny the other, so taking everything is not best. Could also be left unresolved

atlas.text: Where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it. Stopping: from nothing two stand, from anything left nothing; with two drawers over two steps every perfect profile has the second drawer keep the unit it is given at the first step, so drawing everything is not perfect.
atlas.to: witness (Stopping: from nothing two stand, from anything left nothing): with two drawers over two steps, every profile perfect for position has the second drawer keep the unit it is given at the first step, so drawing everything is not perfect

words: exact threshold (mutual_lowers_iff, mutual_broken_iff_capacity): a dependant's need exceeds what the others leave less all that the takers together can take. Origin could instead be left-is-lost (holding back is no one's best move); I chose uncounted because the stock lies outside every taker's count

atlas.text: At a mutual best response, a condition beyond every optimizer's family is lowered below where the formations outside every optimizer leave it exactly where the optimizers have some capacity there and something is left; on a web, a dependence on it met at the step breaks exactly where its need exceeds what those formations leave less the optimizers' joint capacity.
atlas.to: the optimizers have no capacity at the condition c beyond every family, or nothing is left there: c stands where the formations outside every optimizer leave it, and a dependence on it met at the step is kept where its need is at most that less the joint capacity -> the optimizers have some capacity at c and something is left there: c is lowered below where the formations outside leave it, and a dependence met at the step breaks exactly where its need exceeds what they leave less the optimizers' joint capacity

words: exact (Web.course_kept_iff): the level stays at or above the need at every step exactly where what is withdrawn is at most what renews

atlas.text: From a start at the need, the condition stands at or above the need at every step exactly where the withdrawal is within the renewal, k ≤ r.
atlas.to: from a start at the need, with the withdrawal within the renewal (k ≤ r), the condition stands at or above the need at every step

words: exact (Optimum.reread_kept_iff): a change of course at step T keeps the need for good exactly where the need is still met at T; otherwise it is past-turning-back

atlas.text: With the draw above the renewal until a step T, a re-reading from T on that keeps the need where it is met keeps it at every step exactly where it is met at T; stated on the level law alone.
atlas.to: the draw above the renewal before T, and from T on a re-reading that keeps the need wherever it is met: the need is met at every step exactly where it is met at T

words: witness (Renewing.restraint_holds_more): holding back together keeps the source and over a long stretch leaves each with more by its own count, though at no step is holding back either one's best move. Sits at the edge with left-is-lost

atlas.text: Two takers of capacity one lose a source renewed by r < 2 at mutual best responses at every step; at renewal one, a restrained course, none of whose steps is a mutual best response, keeps the source at its start and after a long course holds more in the store, by the optimizer's own order.
atlas.to: witness (Renewing, two takers of capacity one): at renewal one, a restrained course, none of whose steps is a mutual best response, keeps the source at its start and, over a course longer than twice the start, holds more in the store than the course of mutual best responses

words: exact tipping at renewal < withdrawal (course_lost_iff, course_kept_iff); the same law says that what depends on it is then lost for good, i.e. on to past-turning-back

atlas.text: A dependence at the need, met at the start, is lost exactly where r < k; from a start at the need, the condition stands at or above it at every step exactly where k ≤ r.
atlas.to: k ≤ r: from a start at the need, the condition stands at or above the need at every step -> r < k: a dependence at the need throughout, met at the start, is lost for good

words: exact deadline (Optimum.reread_deadline_iff): the need is still met at step T exactly where the level started at least T times the excess above the need

atlas.text: Given exactly r at or above a positive need, at most r everywhere, and k > r drawn before T, the need is met at T exactly where the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need.
atlas.to: the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need, m + T (k − r) ≤ x 0: the need is met at T -> it starts less above it: the need is not met at T

words: sufficient (Optimum.frontier_leaves): some reachable level regrows faster than later is counted down; every best course leaves something after the first step

atlas.text: Where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach renews faster than the weighting falls (w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step), with reach and y + R y ≤ k, every optimum leaves something at the first step.
atlas.to: where nothing is renewed at nothing and some level y within the start with its renewal renews faster than the weighting falls at each step, w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y), over at least two steps, with a capacity drawing down to y and covering y with its renewal: every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw stands above nothing after the first step

words: sufficient (Optimum.frontier_rebuilds): from a low start every best course takes nothing while the stock regrows. Not shown where regrowth overshoots. Leads on to H's optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base

atlas.text: From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence whose need the rising level meets. Under an overcompensating renewal this is not shown.
atlas.to: optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base

words: witness of the tipping (Holding.logistic_weighted): later counted at under half, the source is emptied at once; at over half, held at one, which is below what the dweller needs (for the dweller: uncounted); at exactly half both are best

atlas.text: Under the logistic law, from a source at two with capacity two: where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends the source at once; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending and holding at one are both optima; where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum holds it at one and breaks the dweller.
atlas.to: witness (the logistic law, from a source at two with capacity two): where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends the source at once; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once and holding at one are both optima; where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum holds it at one, breaking the dweller

words: tipping in how fast later is counted down against how fast the stock regrows (frontier_exhausts, frontier_leaves); two sufficient sides, the gap between them not stated; on the first side the stock is ended at the first step

atlas.text: Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, every optimum ends the stock at the first step; where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach has w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step, every optimum leaves something at the first step.
atlas.to: w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z: every optimum ends the stock at the first step -> R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach has w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step: every optimum leaves something at the first step

words: exact (Optimum.frontier_left_iff): with what is left at the end counted one for one, the best courses are exactly those holding a level where the most comes in; emptying at the end is no longer forced. A need above that level is still cut off at the first step (uncounted)

atlas.text: With what is left valued one for one, the optima are exactly the open courses standing at a level of greatest renewal at every step to the horizon: the drain at the end is no longer forced; keeping and draining at the end are both optima, and a dependence above every such level is still broken at the first step.
atlas.to: with what is left at the horizon counted one for one with what is drawn: the optima are exactly the open courses whose level renews by the greatest renewal at every step from the first to the n-th (R (x (t + 1)) = r for every t < n)

words: sufficient (Optimum.frontier_keeps_stepwise): a reward for each step the need stays met that covers what that step's keeping gives up and exceeds the final draw. Same law as keeping-forgoes exit 1; H's a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon

atlas.text: Reward each step a need stays met: where the coupling covers the renewal forgone a step and exceeds the end, every optimum keeps the dependence at every horizon. Below that coupling, a long horizon outweighs it. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.
atlas.to: a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon

words: sufficient (Optimum.frontier_keeps_above): a reward for keeping, fixed in total, larger than all that keeping gives up over the stretch. Same law as keeping-forgoes exit 0

atlas.text: A coupling of keeping fixed in total: with r n + e < w + q n it leaves only optima keeping the dependence; with w + q n + e < r n + m only optima breaking it within the horizon; the tie is not stated.
atlas.to: keeping-forgoes-the-renewal-at-the-need

words: sufficient (frontier_keeps_above): keeping is rewarded in total by more than everything it gives up over the stretch; every best course keeps the dependant supplied

atlas.text: For a worth adding at least w to a keeping course and nothing to one below m, R ≤ r, the keeping course ending at e from m to y, where r n + e < w + q n, every optimum keeps the dependence.
atlas.to: every optimum, among the open courses, of every order rising with a worth adding at least w to a keeping course and nothing to one falling below m, keeps its level at m or above at every step through the horizon (r n + e < w + q n)

words: sufficient (frontier_keeps_stepwise): the reward is per step kept, so it holds at every length of stretch. One taker's law

atlas.text: A coupling for each step kept in place of one fixed in total: where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.
atlas.to: a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon

words: tipping (frontier_breaks_below, frontier_keeps_above): below the lower threshold every best course cuts the dependant off within the stretch (on to ended); above the upper every best course keeps it; the tie and the gap are not stated. What keeping gives up grows with the length of the stretch

atlas.text: A coupling w fixed in total with w + q n + e < r n + m leaves only optima breaking the dependence within the horizon; one with r n + e < w + q n only optima keeping it; the tie is not stated.
atlas.to: every optimum among the open courses falls below m at some step within the horizon (w + q n + e < r n + m) -> every optimum among the open courses keeps its level at m or above through the horizon (r n + e < w + q n)

words: sufficient (Flow.Balances.kept_of_restrained): each within the spare, together past it; taking less together by exactly the excess keeps the need met after the step. Leads on to H's restraint-within-the-joint-slack

atlas.text: Restraint within the joint slack: where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack and the joint draw breaks a need, a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met. Where the rest outruns the renewal, at need one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint, and, among optimizers each ranking by its own rising order, restraint at a condition beyond one's own family is no mutual best response wherever something stands there.
atlas.to: restraint-within-the-joint-slack

words: witness (Diversion.supplying_rises_by_inflow): a rise no larger than what comes in takes from nothing around it

atlas.text: A rise up to the inflow need not reach beyond: Diversion's supplying flow raises the store by exactly its one unit of inflow with nothing taken.
atlas.to: across the first step, the supplying flow's inflow on the source and the store is one unit, the store rises by exactly that unit, and nothing is taken by any formation: a rise up to the inflow with no draw from beyond (a witness)

words: witness (DrawnBeyond.WithinSlack): a rise equal to the spare cuts off no one

atlas.text: A slack equal to the rise breaks nothing.
atlas.to: with the source one above the dweller's need, the store rises by exactly the slack, the whole gains nothing, and the dweller's dependence on the source is kept across the step (a witness)

words: witness (Lapsing.share_falls): about whether the practice of drawing from outside is passed on to offspring; it is not, in this example. A question of how a practice spreads (C or H ground), not a place of this family

atlas.text: Lapsing: with the same offspring, more going to the taker which raises the store, nothing is discordant, yet the taker's offspring do not reach beyond and the share falls from a half to nothing: selection alone does not carry the share.
atlas.to: nothing is discordant at the first step, more offspring going to the taker which raises the store, yet the share reaching beyond falls from a half to nothing at the next generation, the taker's offspring not reaching beyond (a witness)

words: exact threshold (Flow.Balances.broken_iff), for one who depends on it: its need plus all that is taken exceeds the level plus all that is given at that step. The law says the dependence breaks; ending needs the further premise that its activity needs that support

atlas.text: When several take at once, in a balanced flow a dependence met at a step breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given.
atlas.to: the dependence of g on c, required and met at t, is not broken across the step: its need with all that is taken is at most the level with all that is given -> the dependence is broken across the step: the level with all that is given is below the need with all that is taken (Web.Broken t g c)

words: proved bound joining E (PairSelection.Place.received_factor_le): what being given to adds for a pair is at most the spare around it plus what comes in, so a positive return needs spare, inflow, or someone cut off. Not a change of place: the same stock seen from E's giving

atlas.to: {"dynamic": "offspring-read-from-giving-that-waits", "law": null, "role": "reading"}

words: witness (SharedModels.OneGoal.continues): two aiming at a shared level, each counting only its own take, are over at the first step and within at the second, and all go on; three end at the first step. So aiming at the shared level is no guarantee

atlas.text: A goal over the shared level: two regulators reading the level and preferring four, each counting only its own take, continue with every member active; three such regulators end at the first step, so it is no guarantee.
atlas.to: two regulators, each reading the shared level, preferring four and counting only its own take, take within what is given each while together more at the first step, jointly within it at the second, and all three members are active and supported at every step (a witness)

words: witness (Alone.takes_all): taking all that comes in, without the take rising, goes on at every step. The edge of the place

atlas.text: A full taker whose take does not rise continues (Alone): it takes all that is given at every step and is active at every step.
atlas.to: in Alone the first formation takes all that is given at every step and is active at every step (a witness)

words: witness (Restored.returns): the end lasts only where what renews the stock depends on it; here a renewer that needs nothing gives, and the part is active again. Same law as own-count exit 3

atlas.text: Gated renewal is needed for the end to last: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end; the race ends the part, greatest at every step, at its end, and the renewal restores it from the next step on.
atlas.to: in Restored the race is one step of joint excess and the part, greatest at every step by what each has drawn, is inactive at step one; the renewer, which gives at that step and does not require the condition, restores the level, and the part is active from step two on (a witness)

words: witness (Clearing.greatest_continues): the one that ends is the dweller who lives on what is drawn down; the one drawing it down, ahead at every step, does not live on it and goes on. Alternative origin: uncounted

atlas.text: Dependence is needed: in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues, active and supported at every step, while the dweller depending on it ends.
atlas.to: in the clearing witness the clearer, greatest at every step by what it has drawn, does not require the habitat and is active and supported at every step, while the dweller, depending on the habitat at need one, is inactive from step two on

words: witness (RaceWithin.same_positions_apart): the same standings as in the race, with the total taken within what comes in and everyone going on. Standings say nothing of the balance

atlas.text: With the race's positions at every step, what is taken stays within what is given and every part is active at every step: the same positions go with a condition that ends and one that lasts.
atlas.to: a flow with the race's positions at every step (the same greatest part, the first rising in position in both) in which what is taken is within what is given at every step, the condition rises and every part is active at every step (a witness)

words: witness (Cycle.closed_more) leading to F's closed-cycle-without-dissipation: where nothing is lost at each handing-on, a closed finite group can pass the same amount round without end. Needs F's place for 'going round, nothing used up'

atlas.text: Without dissipation a closed finite family can be more without end: each formation gives back what it takes and the total never changes.
atlas.to: closed-cycle-without-dissipation

words: witness (Spray.spray) of a formal edge: with endlessly many sources a giver can give while taking nothing. No place; a note on the main law's premise

atlas.text: Where exchange reaches infinitely many conditions dissipation is vacuous and a renewer can give while taking nothing.
atlas.to: the flow balances, gives and takes only while active, keeps activity supported and is dissipative, yet no step is enclosed: at every step the renewer gives the pool one unit while taking nothing, and a formation takes from the pool (a witness)

words: witness (WholeWithin.kept): drawing within what its members give, the line is active at every step. Leads on to H's whole-persists-through-generation

atlas.text: Drawing within what the members give, the lineage is active at every step.
atlas.to: whole-persists-through-generation

words: witness (WholeUnending.persists): with one member that never ends, the whole goes on through the same excess; shows the premise 'every member ends' is needed

atlas.text: With a part that never ends, the whole persists through the same excess.
atlas.to: with a part whose activity never ends, every other premise of Whole.family_excess_ends holds, the uptake exceeding the replenishment at step zero from a stock below one plus the need, and the whole is active at every step (a witness)

words: witness (WholeUngated.persists): new members arise without needing the stock drawn down, and the whole goes on through the same excess

atlas.text: With members arising without depending on the drawn condition, the whole persists through the same excess.
atlas.to: whole-persists-through-generation

words: window (Web.Whole.family_excess_ends): n steps of taking over what is replenished, from a stock below n plus the need; no new member arises after them (past-turning-back on the way) and the whole ends once those present have ended. Not shown: at which step

atlas.text: n steps of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment from a stock below n + m: no part arises after them, and the whole ends once the parts active then have ended.
atlas.to: n consecutive steps from T of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment, from a stock below n + m -> no part arises from T + n on, and the whole ends (Web.Ends w), once the parts active then have ended

words: witness (Season.plateau_optima): the catch valued only up to a target; a season keeping the bay and one emptying it are both best. Same shape as the pilot's what-an-optimum exit 3

atlas.text: Valuing the catch only up to 26 does not rise with the catch, and its optima include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it.
atlas.to: valuing the catch only up to 26, the optima among the season's outcomes include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it (a witness)

words: witness (Season.unshared_optima): ranked by the ground's catch alone, keeping the bay and emptying it are both best: the push down is not forced where using it adds nothing to what is counted

atlas.text: Ranked by the ground's catch alone, the bay shares no units with what is ranked and has no room: the optima include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it.
atlas.to: ranked by the ground's catch alone, the optima among the season's outcomes include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it (a witness)

words: Flow.joint_keeps, sufficient: across a step where all together take at most what comes in, the level does not fall. The law that states the place.

atlas.text: In a balanced flow, taking jointly within what is given keeps the level.
atlas.to: across a step at which the formations together take from c at most what is given to it, under balance, the level of c does not fall across that step

words: Flow.level_kept_of_plans (target dynamic in H): the taking is divided beforehand into parts that do not overlap and together fit what comes in. Sufficient; that an actual division is so is not shown.

atlas.text: Under balance, with a division of the take by exclusive footprints at every step, the level never falls below its start; that an actual division is by exclusive footprints is not shown.
atlas.to: division-by-exclusive-footprints

words: Alone.all_continue, witness: one taker with the same renewer, both active at every step, where two takers end themselves and it.

atlas.text: With one taker the same renewer keeps the level and both are active at every step, where in Exceeding two takers end themselves and their renewer.
atlas.to: witness (Alone): one taker and one renewer on one condition, balance and Dependent holding, the take jointly within what is given at every step, and both active at every step

words: Restored.returns, witness: what refills the stock does not itself live on the stock, so after one round of excess the part is inactive for a step and active again from the next. Same law as position exit 1; draw once.

atlas.text: A formation renewed from outside can be active again: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end, and the renewal restores the part from the next step on.
atlas.to: witness (Restored): after one step of joint excess the part is inactive at step 1; a renewer that requires nothing gives at that step, and the part is active at every step from step 2 on

words: Pool.first_two_only_together, witness: of three drawers, two held back together keep it; either held back alone changes nothing.

atlas.text: In Pool, withholding the first two drawers' parts together keeps the dependence where withholding either alone leaves the same move breaking it.
atlas.to: witness (Pool): from three drawers each taking one unit, the first two drawers' parts make the difference only together: withheld together they keep the sustaining formation's dependence, while withheld either alone the same move still breaks it

words: Renewable.breaking_event_makes_step_difference, witness: here the 'members' are one drawer's own successive takes; at the breaking step taking nothing would keep it, while over the run no single take decides. Could instead be read inside overdrawing.

atlas.text: At the breaking step of the renewable witness, drawing nothing from the same configuration keeps the dependence: a step-level statement, which leaves the run-level outcome to the tail.
atlas.to: witness (Renewable): at the breaking step, from level one, drawing two breaks the sustaining formation's dependence, while from the same configuration drawing nothing keeps it

words: Training.outrun_settles_iff, proved join into D (what-training-installs): a reward that adds, at any weight, a score taken only after the others have run the stock out settles where the reward without it settles. Also a late reading (past-turning-back) and a door into D's place for training.

atlas.to: {"dynamic": "what-training-installs", "law": "Becoming.Training.outrun_settles_iff", "role": "reading"}

words: Flow.level_kept, sufficient: jointly within what comes in at every step, the level never falls below its start and whoever depends on it alone stays supplied.

atlas.text: Taking jointly within what is given at every step keeps the level, and every formation depending on that condition alone at a need met at the start stays supported.
atlas.to: under balance, with the take jointly within what is given at every step, the level of c never falls below its start

words: Sharing.full_taking_needed, witness: two takers each take half of what comes in, neither takes all, all continue. The main law (one takes all that comes in, so any second taker tips it into overdrawing) has no item of its own.

atlas.text: Of a renewer giving two units across each step and two takers at need one, where each takes one, all three are supported and active at every step and neither takes all that is given, so the law needs its premise of full taking.
atlas.to: witness (Sharing): a renewer giving two units a step and two takers each taking one at need one: the take is jointly within what is given, neither taker takes all that is given, the second lives by taking, and all are active at every step

words: Optimum.counted_after_keeps_iff, exact: what lies outside is counted last, after the mark is reached; the need is kept exactly where some way of reaching the mark keeps it. With several things outside, one can still be emptied.

atlas.text: A term on what lies beyond counted after the set point: with one condition beyond it keeps a need exactly where some way of reaching the set point keeps it; with several it can empty one (Spread.counted_after_empties); counting less, it drains (Topped.counted_less_drains).
atlas.to: where some eligible outcome stands at the set point, every optimum of the order by distance with the one condition c beyond counted after keeps a need at c exactly where some eligible outcome at the set point keeps it

words: Optimum.Topped.weighted_keeps, witness: the source traded at any positive weight against the gap from the mark; every best outcome meets the need.

atlas.text: In the exchange witness, trading the source at any positive weight against the store's gap, every optimum meets the need.
atlas.to: witness (Topped): every optimum, among the outcomes open to the taker, of the order trading the source at a positive weight against the store's gap from its set point meets the dweller's need at the source

words: Optimum.Drain.satisficingThen_keeps, witness: counted after a level of 'enough', it keeps as well.

atlas.text: Counted after an aspiration level it keeps as well: the plateau decides, not the set point.
atlas.to: witness (Drain): every optimum among the splits of three units of the order satisficing at a store of one with the source counted after leaves the source at two, the dweller's need

words: Flow.Balances.atSetPoint_broken_iff, exact, one step: the taker stands at its mark; what it takes to stay there, with what the step loses, exceeds the spare above the dependant's need. Ends the dependant, not the taker.

atlas.text: In a balanced step in which the family with the one condition beyond gains nothing and the family stands at its set point after it, the dependence met at the step breaks exactly where the set point's total with the loss exceeds the family before with the slack.
atlas.to: the set point's total with what the whole loses is at most the family's stock before with the slack at the one condition c beyond: the dependence on c is kept across the step -> it exceeds W.stock ds t + (W.level t c − W.need t (dep c) c): the dependence on c is broken across the step

words: Optimum.Next.frontier_leaves, sufficient: even with others drawing first, some reachable level stands for the drawer next round by more than later is marked down; then no best outcome ends the stock at once.

atlas.text: Where nothing stands at nothing and some level within reach rises faster than the weighting falls, with what stands at it at least it and a capacity drawing down to it and holding it, no optimum ends the base at once.
atlas.to: where nothing stands at nothing and some level y within what stands at the start, with what stands at y at least y at every step, rises faster than the weighting falls at each step, over at least two steps, with a capacity drawing down to y and holding it: every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw stands above nothing after the first step (0 < x 1)

words: Web.Next.frontier_rebuilds (target dynamic in H), sufficient: from a depleted start, every best outcome takes nothing while the level rises, and each need the rising level meets is supplied again.

atlas.text: From a start at or below y, where what stands rises with the level below y and is at least y at y, and the weighted gain rises strictly up to y and is greatest there, with a capacity covering what stands at y and at nothing, every optimum follows the rising course below y, drawing nothing, restoring every dependence whose need it meets.
atlas.to: optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base

words: Optimum.Holding.doubling_drawn_first, witness: the same doubling source is rebuilt by one drawer alone and ended at once when others first draw all but a quarter of what is left. From leaving-lost the main law then goes to ended.

atlas.text: Under w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1), a doubling source is rebuilt by every optimum alone and ended at once with others first drawing all but a quarter; drawing all but half, every optimum ends it under weights falling at every step, and at equal weights ending and holding at two are both optima.
atlas.to: witness (a source doubling up to eight, from two, capacity sixteen): where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1), every optimum alone rebuilds the source (four after the first step, eight after), while with others first drawing all but a quarter every optimum ends it at once and breaks the dweller needing two; where the weighting falls at every step, with others drawing all but half, every optimum ends it; at equal weights, with others drawing all but half, ending at once and holding at two are both optima

words: Optimum.AtOnce.drain_perfect_iff, exact: drawing at once with no floor, everyone drawing everything stops being stable exactly where some drawer's portion returns more than one for one on what it alone leaves. What is stable instead is not shown.

atlas.text: Drawing at once with no floor, drawing everything is perfect exactly where, at every step before the last and with the others drawing everything, no portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves. Which profiles are perfect where the drain is not is not shown.
atlas.to: drawing at once with no floor, where at some step before the last, the others drawing everything, some drawer's portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what it alone leaves: drawing everything is not perfect (which profiles are perfect then is not shown)

words: Optimum.AtOnce.whole_perfect_iff, exact: one drawer given the whole drains exactly where the whole never returns more than one for one.

atlas.text: For one drawer given the whole, draining is perfect exactly where the whole never returns more than one for one.
atlas.to: for one drawer given all that stands, where at some step before the last what stands from some b left exceeds what stands from nothing, and b: drawing everything is not perfect

words: Optimum.Holding.doubling_capacity, witness: a floor on what the second drawer may take; the first then leaves everything and the dependant is kept.

atlas.text: A floor on the other's draw can keep the stock: under doubling with a one-unit floor on the second, the first leaves everything from three and the dweller is kept.
atlas.to: witness (doubling, two drawers in turn over two steps): with a one-unit floor on the second drawer, the profile keeping is perfect and in every perfect profile the first leaves everything from three, the dweller kept; with no floor, every perfect profile breaks the dweller

words: Same law and threshold as exit 1 (drain_perfect_iff). Draw once.

atlas.text: Drawing at once with no floor, drawing everything is perfect exactly where, at every step before the last and with the others drawing everything, no portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves.
atlas.to: at every step before the last, the others drawing everything, no portion returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves: drawing everything is perfect -> at some step some portion does: drawing everything is not perfect

words: Optimum.Coupled.kept_above, sufficient: each drawer counts, for every round the dependant's need stays met, more than the need itself; every stable way of drawing then leaves exactly the need.

atlas.text: With two drawers or more and no floor, under the gate (below the need what stands next is below it, at or above it what stands next meets it, and what stands next from nothing, with the need, is at most what stands next from the need), where m < c every perfect profile has each drawer leave exactly the need of an amount meeting it and nothing of a smaller one, and from a start meeting the need it is met at every step to the horizon.
atlas.to: with two drawers or more in turn and no floor, under the gate (below the need what stands next is below it, at or above it what stands next meets it, and what stands next from nothing with the need is at most what stands next from the need), where m < c: every perfect profile has every drawer leave exactly the need of an amount meeting it and nothing of a smaller one, at every step before the horizon

words: Optimum.Coupled.gated_threshold, tipping, both ways: below the need per round every stable way drains; above it every stable way keeps exactly the need; at equality both. The threshold is the need, not the regrowth forgone. Drawing at once where no portion reaches the need stays in together-over at every payment (no item).

atlas.text: With two drawers or more in turn and no floor, on the gated renewal, for every q: where c < m every perfect profile drains at every step; where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect; where m ≤ c keeping the need is perfect; where m < c every perfect profile keeps exactly the need, and from a start meeting it it is met at every step; both profiles are perfect at c = m.
atlas.to: c < m: every perfect profile has every drawer leave nothing at every step before the horizon (and where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect) -> m < c: every perfect profile keeps exactly the need, and from a start meeting it the need is met at every step (and where m ≤ c keeping the need is perfect); at c = m both are perfect

words: Optimum.InTurn.Stopping.perfect_keeps, witness: where something left would stop what the other gets next, a drawer leaves it. The return is in standing against the other, not in stock; a later reader may prefer 'inside leaving-lost'.

atlas.text: Where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it. Stopping: from nothing two stand, from anything left nothing; with two drawers over two steps every perfect profile has the second drawer keep the unit it is given at the first step, so drawing everything is not perfect.
atlas.to: witness (Stopping: from nothing two stand, from anything left nothing): with two drawers over two steps, every profile perfect for position has the second drawer keep the unit it is given at the first step, so drawing everything is not perfect

words: Optimum.mutual_lowers_iff and Web.mutual_broken_iff_capacity, exact, one step: a dependant's need is more than what the others leave less all that the takers together can take. Its first half (lowered exactly where they can take and something is left) is inside uncounted. Each taker alone is also in leaving-lost: holding back is no best reply.

atlas.text: At a mutual best response, a condition beyond every optimizer's family is lowered below where the formations outside every optimizer leave it exactly where the optimizers have some capacity there and something is left; on a web, a dependence on it met at the step breaks exactly where its need exceeds what those formations leave less the optimizers' joint capacity.
atlas.to: the optimizers have no capacity at the condition c beyond every family, or nothing is left there: c stands where the formations outside every optimizer leave it, and a dependence on it met at the step is kept where its need is at most that less the joint capacity -> the optimizers have some capacity at c and something is left there: c is lowered below where the formations outside leave it, and a dependence met at the step breaks exactly where its need exceeds what they leave less the optimizers' joint capacity

words: Web.course_kept_iff, exact: from a start at the need, it is met at every step exactly where the withdrawal is within the renewal.

atlas.text: From a start at the need, the condition stands at or above the need at every step exactly where the withdrawal is within the renewal, k ≤ r.

words: Optimum.reread_kept_iff, exact: taking above renewal until step T, then a way of taking that keeps the need wherever it is met; the need is met for good exactly where it is still met at T. Otherwise the arrow is to past-turning-back.

words: Optimum.Renewing.restraint_holds_more, witness: two takers both holding back keep the source and after a long run hold more by their own count, though at no single step is holding back either's best reply. Not reached from leaving-lost by step-by-step best replies.

atlas.text: Two takers of capacity one lose a source renewed by r < 2 at mutual best responses at every step; at renewal one, a restrained course, none of whose steps is a mutual best response, keeps the source at its start and after a long course holds more in the store, by the optimizer's own order.
atlas.to: witness (Renewing, two takers of capacity one): at renewal one, a restrained course, none of whose steps is a mutual best response, keeps the source at its start and, over a course longer than twice the start, holds more in the store than the course of mutual best responses

words: Web.course_lost_iff with course_kept_iff, exact in a parameter: what is withdrawn each round exceeds what is renewed; from there the need is lost for good (on to past-turning-back), however small each taker's capacity.

words: Optimum.reread_deadline_iff, exact deadline: after T rounds of taking k against renewal r, the need is still met exactly where the level started at least T (k − r) above it.

atlas.text: Given exactly r at or above a positive need, at most r everywhere, and k > r drawn before T, the need is met at T exactly where the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need.

words: Optimum.frontier_leaves, sufficient: some reachable level regrows faster than later is marked down; every best outcome then leaves something at the first step.

atlas.text: Where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach renews faster than the weighting falls (w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step), with reach and y + R y ≤ k, every optimum leaves something at the first step.

words: Optimum.frontier_rebuilds (target dynamic in H), sufficient: from a start at or below the level where the weighted gain is greatest, every best outcome takes nothing while the stock regrows. Not shown where regrowth overshoots.

atlas.text: From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence whose need the rising level meets. words: Optimum.Holding.logistic_weighted, witness of the threshold in one example: later marked down by more than half, ended at once; by exactly half, both; by less, held at one. The held level still cuts off a dependant needing two: leaving-pays is not cost-counts.

atlas.text: Under the logistic law, from a source at two with capacity two: where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends the source at once; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending and holding at one are both optima; where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum holds it at one and breaks the dweller.
atlas.to: witness (the logistic law, from a source at two with capacity two): where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends the source at once; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once and holding at one are both optima; where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum holds it at one, breaking the dweller

words: Optimum.frontier_exhausts against frontier_leaves, tipping in a parameter: two sufficient sides with a gap between, not an exact threshold. Same change as exit 1; draw once. On the first side the main law goes on to ended (its own stock, at the first step).

atlas.text: Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, every optimum ends the stock at the first step; where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach has w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step, every optimum leaves something at the first step.

words: Optimum.frontier_left_iff, exact: with what is left at the end counted one for one with what is taken, the best outcomes are exactly those holding the level that regrows most at every step; emptying at the last round is no longer forced, nor excluded. A need above that level is still cut off at the first step (uncounted to ended, no item).

atlas.text: With what is left valued one for one, the optima are exactly the open courses standing at a level of greatest renewal at every step to the horizon: the drain at the end is no longer forced; keeping and draining at the end are both optima, and a dependence above every such level is still broken at the first step.
atlas.to: with what is left at the horizon counted one for one with what is drawn: the optima are exactly the open courses whose level renews by the greatest renewal at every step from the first to the n-th (R (x (t + 1)) = r for every t < n)

words: Optimum.frontier_keeps_stepwise (target dynamic in H), sufficient: a payment for each round the need stays met that covers the regrowth given up per round and exceeds what could be taken at the end; then kept at every length of run. One drawer's law.

atlas.text: Reward each step a need stays met: where the coupling covers the renewal forgone a step and exceeds the end, every optimum keeps the dependence at every horizon. Below that coupling, a long horizon outweighs it. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.

words: Optimum.frontier_keeps_above (keeping-forgoes, B), sufficient: a payment for keeping, fixed in total, larger than all that keeping gives up over the run.

atlas.text: A coupling of keeping fixed in total: with r n + e < w + q n it leaves only optima keeping the dependence; with w + q n + e < r n + m only optima breaking it within the horizon; the tie is not stated.

words: Optimum.frontier_keeps_above, sufficient: with the payment above what keeping gives up, every best outcome keeps the level at the need or above through the run. The to-side of transition 1.

atlas.text: For a worth adding at least w to a keeping course and nothing to one below m, R ≤ r, the keeping course ending at e from m to y, where r n + e < w + q n, every optimum keeps the dependence.

words: Optimum.frontier_keeps_stepwise (H), sufficient: pay for each round kept in place of a fixed total; then it holds at every length of run.

atlas.text: A coupling for each step kept in place of one fixed in total: where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.
atlas.to: a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon

words: Optimum.frontier_breaks_below against frontier_keeps_above, tipping, both ways, the tie not stated: below the threshold every best outcome falls below the need within the run. Where the kept level regrows less than the freest one, what keeping gives up grows with the length of the run, so a fixed payment is outgrown (cost-counts back to felt as the run lengthens).

atlas.text: A coupling w fixed in total with w + q n + e < r n + m leaves only optima breaking the dependence within the horizon; one with r n + e < w + q n only optima keeping it; the tie is not stated.

words: Flow.Balances.kept_of_restrained (target dynamic in H), sufficient: each take is within the joint spare and together they cut off a dependant; one drawer taking less by the excess keeps the need met. The destination is 'the need stays met', which is looser than within-renewal; the later reader should check.

atlas.text: Restraint within the joint slack: where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack and the joint draw breaks a need, a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met. Where the rest outruns the renewal, at need one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint, and, among optimizers each ranking by its own rising order, restraint at a condition beyond one's own family is no mutual best response wherever something stands there.

words: Diversion.supplying_rises_by_inflow, witness: a rise no larger than what comes in takes nothing from outside.

atlas.text: A rise up to the inflow need not reach beyond: Diversion's supplying flow raises the store by exactly its one unit of inflow with nothing taken.

words: DrawnBeyond.WithinSlack.within_slack, witness: a rise equal to the spare above the dependant's need cuts off no one. As the pilot decided for what-an-optimum exit 1.

words: DrawnBeyond.Lapsing.share_falls, witness: nothing picks against the drawing from outside, yet the taker's offspring do not do it and it lapses in one generation. Perhaps uncounted to within-renewal; the law states only that picking does not carry the habit.

atlas.text: Lapsing: with the same offspring, more going to the taker which raises the store, nothing is discordant, yet the taker's offspring do not reach beyond and the share falls from a half to nothing: selection alone does not carry the share.

words: Flow.Balances.broken_iff, exact, one step: what all take together, less what all give, leaves less than the dependant needs. Ends the dependant; could start from uncounted where a rule rewarding the rise is in the statement.

words: PairSelection.Place.received_factor_le, proved, into E: a bound carried into another model (what a place gains per round received is at most the spare outside with what comes in). words: FreeEnergyGuarantees.SharedModels.OneGoal.continues, witness: two takers who both go by the shared level, each counting only its own take, are over at the first round and within at the second, and all continue; three counting the same way end at the first round. No guarantee.

words: Alone.takes_all, witness: a taker that takes all that comes in, whose take does not rise, goes on. The main law (a take that rises every round is in overdrawing after B + 1 rounds, then ended where it does not resume) has no item.

words: Restored.returns, witness: same law as own-count exit 4. For the end to last, what refills the stock must itself live on it.

atlas.text: Gated renewal is needed for the end to last: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end; the race ends the part, greatest at every step, at its end, and the renewal restores it from the next step on.

words: Clearing.greatest_continues, witness: the one who has drawn most does not live on what it draws down and goes on, active and supplied at every step; the one who lives on it is gone from step two. The arrow to ended is for the dependant only.

words: RaceWithin.same_positions_apart, witness: the same standings among the racers as in the race that ends, with the total within what comes in and everyone going on. Standing against each other does not tell which place one is in.

words: Spray.spray, witness: where exchange reaches endlessly many sources, a giver gives while taking nothing. Outside what any finite stock describes; no place.

words: WholeWithin.kept (target dynamic in H), witness: drawing within what its members give, the line is active and a new member arises at every step. Also a door to H's place for a whole going on through new members.

words: Exact, both ways: it rests with what it was after met exactly where it reaches a state its step leaves unchanged that meets it. A mark only change can meet has no such state.

words: Sufficient: where what there is runs down at every step from some point on, the rises stop coming, from running out and not from having enough. Leads to family B's ground (drawing faster than it renews, run down). Not 'ended': the law says nothing of the seekers ending.

atlas.text: Under a census of what stands, where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. It shows only that the rises do not recur, not that exhaustion ends the seekers.

words: Exact: two worlds look alike to it exactly as long as they answer alike the acts it actually takes; at the first answer that differs, what it takes in differs.
