atlas.to: the values the formation senses in the two worlds differ at the step after the first one at which the worlds answer the act it takes, at the value it senses, differently

words: Necessary: where every differing answer would break the task it is keeping, it takes the two worlds in alike as long as it keeps the task at every step. Telling them apart takes an act that breaks the task.

atlas.text: Equality of values sensed decided: where each answer of the second world to the first course's act and value that differs from the first world's breaks a task on the values sensed, a formation keeping the task at every step in the second world senses alike in both. So a formation sensing the two apart does not keep the task at every step in the second.
atlas.to: a formation that senses the two worlds apart does not keep the task K at every step in the second world

words: Witness: started with the act it had not tried, the worlds separate and it rests on the account that fits in each.

atlas.text: Started the same way but with the untried act, it separates the worlds and rests on the true candidate in each, sensing the low value at step one and at no other step in the second (a witness).
atlas.to: started with both candidates and the untried act, the formation separates the worlds: in the first it rests from step four on the true candidate alone, the untried act and the high value; in the second from step three on the true candidate alone and the known act, having sensed the low value at step one and at no other step (a witness)

words: Witness: told which account holds (given as its start), the one that ranks the untried outcome higher takes the untried act; the one that ranks it lower keeps the known act, so that half stays. By being told, not by its own trial.

atlas.text: Started the same way with the true candidate alone, the first ranking takes the untried act and senses high from step three on, while the second, already so started, keeps the known act (a witness; informing is represented by its outcome, a start with the true candidate alone, not by an act within the law; informing and revaluing as acts within one law are a-reading-informed-and-revalued's).
atlas.to: started with the true candidate alone and the first ranking of the values, the formation takes the untried act and senses the high value from step three on in the first world, while the second ranking, so started, keeps the known act (a witness; informing is represented by the start, not by an act within the law)

words: Witness: a trial that reports each toss, not only whether they agree, is available and is the one chosen; the same outcome then turns the order.

atlas.text: With two experiments, reading both tosses or only whether they agree, and a policy choosing the first, the same outcome turns the order (a witness).

words: A reading, no law: what breaks a tie comes from outside the picture, a new kind of evidence or a new account.

atlas.text: Reading [AI reading, D45]: what changes a tie couples in from beyond the model, a new likelihood or a new hypothesis (selection-when-the-lumping-changes). Novelty and structure learning are both conditioning in a larger model, whose ties the law covers too.

words: Witness: its list allows that going on may lose as well as gain, and it holds its act first; the answer comes and it switches off where going on loses, goes on where it gains.

words: Witness: two forecasts each make themselves true; where publishing starts decides which is reached. A tipping count inside the place, no loss counted.

atlas.text: In a witness, a threshold response on 0, 1, 2, two where anything is predicted and zero where nothing is: zero and two are both right, publication from zero stays zero, and from one it reaches two after one step and stays there. Where publication starts decides; beyond a start that is right or whose outcome is right, and the pace bound's course from the bottom, the record's laws state none of which start reaches which. The witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.
atlas.to: publication under the threshold response on 0, 1, 2 starting at 0, which stays 0 (itself right) -> publication starting at 1, which reaches the right prediction 2 after one step and stays there

words: Pace: publishing each round what happened the round before, from the bottom, reaches the lowest forecast that makes itself true within as many rounds as there are values. Could also be read as inside at-rest.

atlas.text: On the values 0 to n, under a response keeping them and their order, repeated publication from the bottom is right by step n.
atlas.to: repeated publication from the bottom value 0 of the chain 0 to n, under a response mapping the chain into itself and keeping its order -> a right prediction by step n, the least right prediction on the chain

words: Sufficient: where the stock is registered by its level, not only by whether it has run out, any difference in it shows at once. Needs felt's test widened (no rule here).

atlas.text: Coupled by level, every raise passes at once: with the stock coupled into the formation by level, any positive raise sets the webs apart through its couplings at every step.
atlas.to: with the stock coupled into the formation by level, any positive raise sets the webs apart through its couplings at every step: a raise of the stock couples in

words: Witness: a search that tries no neighbour rests at holding back, which the reward itself settles on at no weight; one that tries every candidate moves at its first step to drawing. The rest reached lies in family B's ground (the others take faster than it is renewed).

atlas.text: Where the rest outruns the renewal, restraint is settled at no weight, yet a local search whose neighbourhoods are empty rests at it; one in which every candidate is a neighbour moves from it to the drawing law (a witness).
atlas.to: in the commons where the rest outruns the renewal, a local search in which every candidate is a neighbour moves from restraint to the drawing law at its first step, at every weight; one with empty neighbourhoods rests at restraint, which the reward settles on at no weight (a witness)

words: Pace: a search that moves only to what is scored higher, scores capped at B, has stopped by step B + 1 from any start.

atlas.text: A search improving a natural-number reward, under a reward at most B, rests from every start by step B + 1.
atlas.to: any start of a search improving for a natural-number reward at most B -> a rest of the search, a candidate the step leaves unchanged, reached by step B + 1

words: Witness: the change is between two of family B's places (the others taking within what is renewed, then faster than it). What a training settles on flips with it: holding back at weights of one or more before, at no weight after.

atlas.text: In a computed commons (a witness): where the rest draws within the renewal, restraint is settled exactly at weights of at least one; where it outruns the renewal, restraint is settled at no weight and the drawing law at every weight. At weight one, with the rest within the renewal, both laws are settled and every improving search keeps the one it starts from.
atlas.to: the computed commons with the rest drawing one unit a step, within the renewal: restraint is settled exactly at weights of at least one; at weight one both laws are settled and every improving search keeps the one it starts from -> the rest drawing two units a step, outrunning the renewal: restraint is settled at no weight and the drawing law at every weight

words: Necessary: a rule that treats a case and its mirror image alike never brings the two together; bringing them together needs a rule that treats them differently. Weak fit: what stays is two runs kept apart, which could also be read as several-ways.

atlas.text: To merge what a symmetry tells apart, a law must break the symmetry: where σ moves every configuration and the runs from x and σ x are at one configuration at a step, the law does not commute with σ.
atlas.to: a law under which the runs from x and from σ x are at one configuration at some step: such a law does not commute with σ

words: Witness: reopened, inspected while an inspection can still be made, and taken up. Reopening without inspecting, or with no inspection left (no-means), leaves it as it was.

atlas.text: In the named history, reopening, inspecting and taking up repairs the judgment, using up the inspection available; reopening and taking up without inspection does not, nor does reopening with no inspection left (a witness).
atlas.to: in the named history, after reopening, inspecting and taking up, the changed history's judgment is the present target (true), with the inspection budget and the work at nothing; reopening and taking up without inspection, or with no inspection left, leaves it not correct (a witness)

words: Sufficient: the channels are inspected afresh with at least seven units, through a connected apparatus, every gain nonzero; the run is then the run with faithful reports.

atlas.text: Inspecting the channels with at least seven units, through a connected apparatus and with every gain nonzero, makes the admitted run equal the run with responsive reports, for every network and task list.
atlas.to: the admitted run equals the run with responsive reports, for every network and task list

words: Witness: seven units revise it within two tasks; six leave it unrevised, and that half is no-means.

words: Pace: over a world a list of length N holds, wrong guesses are fewer than a bound set by N and a guess is given at every step from N on. That it has come to rest on the right one is only 'not refuted'; no arrow to at-rest.

atlas.text: Under a determined law whose orbit is held by a list l, read through any map: elimination over the lasso candidates misses fewer than tri (length of l) times and proposes at every step from the length of l on. The bound is not shown to be the least.
atlas.to: elimination over the lasso candidates on the orbit, read through any map, of a determined law held by a list l, before step length of l -> from step length of l on, it proposes a value at every step, its current candidate having stayed below place tri (length of l); misses do not recur at arbitrarily late steps, and that it proposes and is right from some step on is not refuted

words: Witness: the group admits someone who registers the loss as soon as the place reads empty; the loss shows at the first step. This group does not pick its members by what it already notices.

atlas.text: A pool admitting a reader where the habitat reads empty does not recruit through itself and couples the loss apart at once (a witness).
atlas.to: the pool admitting a reader where the habitat reads empty couples the lost and the spared history apart at step 1 (a witness)

words: Witness: someone who registers the loss is due to join at step 2 whatever happens; the loss shows then and not before, through a member the group would have had anyway.

atlas.text: The scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there, through a member the course without the loss holds too (a witness).
atlas.to: the scheduled pool, alike before step 2, couples the lost and the spared history apart at step 2, through the reader, a member at step 2 along the spared history too (a witness)

words: Exact: every old choice survives a new way of sorting exactly where the new one merges nothing the old one separated; a merged pair is a choice gone. No honest origin among the places: any condition in which the pair was told apart.

atlas.text: For a reflexive, symmetric and transitive old relation and any new relation on the same alternatives, every selection through the old is through the new exactly where every pair the new relation makes alike the old one makes alike; a pair the new makes alike and the old tells apart gives a selection through the old that is not through the new (Learning.Training.lost_choice).
atlas.to: where the new relation makes alike a pair the old one tells apart, some selection through the old relation is not through the new one

words: Exact: an act is carried out exactly where the stock covers it and the process allows it; either can fail alone. The place's own threshold.

atlas.text: Run jointly with any process step for step, the stock process executes a course from a stock and a configuration exactly where the stock covers the course and the process can execute it.
atlas.to: run jointly with a process, the stock process executes a course exactly where the stock covers it and the process can execute it; where either fails, the course is not executed

words: Witness: from two units, rebuilding the link makes the difference tellable and leaves enough to correct; from one unit it is tellable with nothing left (no-means). Leads to family H's a-revision-that-opens-a-correction.

atlas.text: From two units, rebuilding the link forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction enabled; from one unit it forms it and leaves correction disabled (Revising.opens_without_correction; a witness).
atlas.to: a-revision-that-opens-a-correction

words: Witness: the link is rebuilt away, from two units; the difference can no longer be told, one unit is left and correcting is off. Same missing origin as exit 1.

atlas.text: Rebuilding the link away from two units loses the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled with one unit left (a witness).
atlas.to: rebuilding the link away from two units reaches (1, link unformed, response false): the selection 'is true' is no longer through the lumping, and correction is disabled (a witness)

words: Witness: from nothing, a supplied controller forms the link (the difference is now told, correcting still off), replenishes, then corrects. Passes looks-same, no-means, then family H's 'a correction is open'.

atlas.text: A supplied controller reading the stock and the link runs Revising from no stock, no link and response false: it forms the link at step 1, at step 2 the finer lumping selects 'is true' with correction disabled, it replenishes, and step 3 corrects the response to true (a witness; the controller's preference for reconstruction is supplied, not derived).
atlas.to: a-revision-that-opens-a-correction

words: Exact threshold: rebuilding is possible exactly where some stock is left, correcting exactly where the link is formed as well.

atlas.text: In Revising, rebuilding is enabled exactly where the stock is positive, correcting exactly where the link is formed too.
atlas.to: a configuration of Revising with no stock (rebuilding disabled), or with the link unformed (correcting disabled) -> a configuration with positive stock (rebuilding enabled), and with the link formed as well (correcting enabled)

words: Witness: its moves are varied against the hidden thing instead of in step with it; the record then excludes the wrong account, and every account that looks only at the outcome.

atlas.text: Moving left again where the hidden bit differs from the first step, no determined process admits the projected steps up to the fifth: in this witness a move varied against the hidden bit excludes every determined model read through the outcome.
atlas.to: with the moves varied against the hidden bit, no determined process admits the projected steps of the run up to the fifth configuration: the model in which the move decides the outcome is excluded, as is every determined model read through the outcome (a witness)

words: Witness: a change is written down as no change while the thing moved; the actual state is no longer among those held possible, and the check built on them still passes.

atlas.text: A change recorded as steady when the world moved leaves the actual world outside the possible ones, the certificate passing on compromised support while the audit fails (a witness).
atlas.to: after a change recorded as steady while the world moved, the actual world lies outside the possible ones, two models remain, the pooled certificate passes on compromised support and the audit fails (a witness)

words: Witness: a reset is foreseen after the scan; accounts the scan had ruled out are open again and the check that passed now fails.

atlas.text: After a scan leaves two models, predicting a reset reopens all three and the certificate that passed fails (a witness).
atlas.to: after a scan leaves two models, predicting a reset reopens all three, and the pooled certificate that passed fails (a witness)

words: Witness: a change is made after the last report; all the accounts are open again.

atlas.text: A control change after the last report reopens all three (a witness).
atlas.to: a control change after the last report reopens all three models (a witness)

words: Necessary only: once the look's age passes the bound set by how fast its error grows and how much room is left, nothing can be certified from it. A fresh look resets it, so not past-turning-back.

atlas.text: Over the reals, for a correction whose error grows as σ + ρt, a certificate covering the uncertainty interval needs 2ρt ≤ B − L − 2σ: a necessary deadline, not a sufficient one; the error model and an additive intervention bounded by what is left are supplied.
atlas.to: ages t at which 2ρt ≤ B − L − 2σ, where a certificate from the reading may hold (the law gives no sufficiency) -> ages t at which 2ρt > B − L − 2σ, where no intervention is certified from the reading

words: Exact: a meaning stays possible exactly while every later record that bears on it still offers it; once out, it is out at every later step.

atlas.text: Along a run, a candidate stays one exactly while every later bearing move offers it.
atlas.to: the meaning is no longer a candidate after n + k steps: some bearing move between steps n and n + k does not offer it, and it stays out at every later step

words: Witness: after things were moved, the place is surveyed again; the remembered report is brought up to date, earlier ones kept, and the next choice changes with it.

atlas.text: After a supplied rearrangement, surveying the place again revises the recalled report, keeping the earlier reports, and the next choice with it (a witness; reobservation is a supplied intervention).
atlas.to: after surveying the place again, the recalled access report is the current one, the earlier reports kept, and the next choice is (0, 1) where the stale report gave (2, 2) (a witness; the rearrangement and the survey are supplied interventions)

words: Witness: it is shown which of two cases holds; its list is cut to that one and its answer turns, where changing what it values would have left the answer.

atlas.text: From both worlds listed and a valuation agreeing with the supplied reference, being shown turns an answer that revaluing leaves; along the course, by that reference on the holding formation's listing of both worlds, holding for the answer falls short by 1 at step 1 and by nothing at step 2 (a witness; there it removes the least shortfall, in these witnesses only).
atlas.to: along the course from both worlds listed, the agreeing valuation and a scheduled demonstration, holding for the reading formation's answer falls short, by the reference on the listing of both worlds, by 1 at step 1 and by nothing at step 2 (a witness; there being shown removes the least shortfall)

words: Witness: what it values is changed, not what it takes to be so, and the answer turns. No place names a change of what is wanted; probably family H's. To an onlooker the two routes give the same answers and the same end (looks-same without the start).

atlas.text: From the first world alone and the reversed valuation, revaluing turns an answer that being shown leaves; along the course, by that reference on the first world alone, holding for the answer falls short by 1 at step 1 and by nothing at step 2 (a witness; there it removes the residual, in these witnesses only).
atlas.to: along the course from the first world alone, the reversed valuation and a presented input, the answer falls short of the reference by 1 at step 1 and by nothing at step 2 (a witness; there revaluing removes the residual)

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: 'More than now' is met only by changing; 'above all others' by at most one of two. Neither is met standing still.

Exact. It rests with what it is after met exactly when it reaches a state its own step leaves as it is and that meets it. Only an aim a standstill can meet allows this (the exit drops 'more than now'). Chapter 03 reads this as 知足.

atlas.text: Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target.
atlas.to: the orbit rests with its target met from some step on, exactly where it has reached a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target

words: Sufficient. Where what it draws on runs down at every step from some point, nothing keeps rising: stopped by running out, not by having enough. No last rise is named and nothing is said of an end, so not 'ended' and not 'at-rest'.

atlas.text: Under a census of what stands, where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. It shows only that the rises do not recur, not that exhaustion ends the seekers.
atlas.to: for every condition, it is not the case that it rises at arbitrarily late steps (exhaustion, not enough); no last rise is named, and nothing is said of the seekers ending

words: A reading (无明): seeking fixed on an aim no standstill meets. Which seeking is so fixed is the reading; the law under it is seeking-boundary's.
A reading (偏蔽): a once-useful habit kept as the measure of later cases. Reopening (复通) would be the arrow to felt; no law states either.

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: It acts by the candidates it keeps, every one predicts the answer it gets, and it rests on a view its own path never contradicts, in either world.
Exact. The two cases come apart for it exactly at the first step where they answer differently an act it actually takes.

atlas.text: Two worlds give the formation one sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act it takes at the value it senses: the course parts them only at an answer that differs.
atlas.to: the values the formation senses in the two worlds differ at the step after the first one at which the worlds answer the act it takes, at the value it senses, differently

words: Necessary. While it keeps what it is keeping at every step in the second case, the two look alike; telling them apart means not keeping it at some step. The price of leaving.

atlas.text: Equality of values sensed decided: where each answer of the second world to the first course's act and value that differs from the first world's breaks a task on the values sensed, a formation keeping the task at every step in the second world senses alike in both. So a formation sensing the two apart does not keep the task at every step in the second.
atlas.to: a formation that senses the two worlds apart does not keep the task K at every step in the second world

words: Witness. Started on the untried act, it parts the two cases and settles on the one that holds, having touched the low value once. Also at rest afterwards.

atlas.text: Started the same way but with the untried act, it separates the worlds and rests on the true candidate in each, sensing the low value at step one and at no other step in the second (a witness).
atlas.to: started with both candidates and the untried act, the formation separates the worlds: in the first it rests from step four on the true candidate alone, the untried act and the high value; in the second from step three on the true candidate alone and the known act, having sensed the low value at step one and at no other step (a witness)

words: Witness. Told from outside which case holds, it takes the untried act; one that ranks the outcomes the other way keeps the known act even so. Being told is represented by the start, not by an act.

atlas.text: Started the same way with the true candidate alone, the first ranking takes the untried act and senses high from step three on, while the second, already so started, keeps the known act (a witness; informing is represented by its outcome, a start with the true candidate alone, not by an act within the law; informing and revaluing as acts within one law are a-reading-informed-and-revalued's).
atlas.to: started with the true candidate alone and the first ranking of the values, the formation takes the untried act and senses the high value from step three on in the first world, while the second ranking, so started, keeps the known act (a witness; informing is represented by the start, not by an act within the law)

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: Two candidates every available experiment treats alike keep their starting order under every way of choosing experiments.
Witness. An experiment that shows both tosses, not only whether they agree, is available and chosen: the same outcome turns the order.

atlas.text: With two experiments, reading both tosses or only whether they agree, and a policy choosing the first, the same outcome turns the order (a witness).
atlas.to: with the experiment reading both tosses chosen, the course of two heads leaves the true coin above the tails-biased one: the order the agreement-reading experiment kept turns (a witness)

words: A reading, no law. What breaks a tie comes from beyond what it has: a new way of telling or a new candidate. Leads on to selection-when-the-lumping-changes.

atlas.text: Reading [AI reading, D45]: what changes a tie couples in from beyond the model, a new likelihood or a new hypothesis (selection-when-the-lumping-changes). Novelty and structure learning are both conditioning in a larger model, whose ties the law covers too.

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: Listing only the possibility that going on gains, and going on from the start, it rests at once and never meets the stop, whichever is true.
Witness. It lists both possibilities and holds first for the answer: it is off from the second step where going on loses, and goes on where it gains.

atlas.text: Listing both signs and holding first, it is off from the second step where going on loses, and goes on from the second where it gains (a witness).
atlas.to: listing both signs and holding first, the formation is off from the second step where going on loses (and goes on from the second where it gains, both_on) (a witness)

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: A forecast is right exactly where the response to it is itself, and once published it is published again at every later step. The other half of the mechanism (a response that moves every value: no right forecast, alternating for ever) is nowhere-to-rest.
Witness. Two forecasts are each right; which one is reached is decided by where publication starts. A tipping count inside the place.

atlas.text: In a witness, a threshold response on 0, 1, 2, two where anything is predicted and zero where nothing is: zero and two are both right, publication from zero stays zero, and from one it reaches two after one step and stays there. Where publication starts decides; beyond a start that is right or whose outcome is right, and the pace bound's course from the bottom, the record's laws state none of which start reaches which. The witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.
atlas.to: publication under the threshold response on 0, 1, 2 starting at 0, which stays 0 (itself right) -> publication starting at 1, which reaches the right prediction 2 after one step and stays there

words: Pace. Where the response keeps the order of the values, publishing again from the bottom reaches the least right forecast within as many steps as there are values. Could be drawn instead as an arrow into at-rest.

atlas.text: On the values 0 to n, under a response keeping them and their order, repeated publication from the bottom is right by step n.
atlas.to: repeated publication from the bottom value 0 of the chain 0 to n, under a response mapping the chain into itself and keeping its order -> a right prediction by step n, the least right prediction on the chain

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: A stock registered only as 'run out or not': more or less of it looks the same until it fails, so how far off the break is does not show.
Sufficient. The stock is registered by its level, not only by whether it has run out: every rise or fall shows at once.

atlas.text: Coupled by level, every raise passes at once: with the stock coupled into the formation by level, any positive raise sets the webs apart through its couplings at every step.
atlas.to: with the stock coupled into the formation by level, any positive raise sets the webs apart through its couplings at every step: a raise of the stock couples in

words: Acting only in ways that work in every case its view still allows keeps it within bounds. That is family H's ground (never-leaving-a-guard); here it is what can safely be done inside looks-the-same. No arrow.

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: Training fixes a way of acting only on the cases its own runs brought up; ways that agree there are trained alike and may differ anywhere else. Its 'beyond' sentence is uncounted.

Witness. Where the others already take faster than it returns, a search that can reach the taking way leaves holding back for it at its first step; a search that can reach nothing stays at holding back. Leads to family B (the-rest-outruns-the-renewal), into past-renewal.

atlas.text: Where the rest outruns the renewal, restraint is settled at no weight, yet a local search whose neighbourhoods are empty rests at it; one in which every candidate is a neighbour moves from it to the drawing law (a witness).
atlas.to: in the commons where the rest outruns the renewal, a local search in which every candidate is a neighbour moves from restraint to the drawing law at its first step, at every weight; one with empty neighbourhoods rests at restraint, which the reward settles on at no weight (a witness)

words: Pace. A search that only improves a score bounded by B is at rest by step B + 1, from any start.

atlas.text: A search improving a natural-number reward, under a reward at most B, rests from every start by step B + 1.
atlas.to: any start of a search improving for a natural-number reward at most B -> a rest of the search, a candidate the step leaves unchanged, reached by step B + 1

words: Witness, a tipping in a parameter. The others' take goes from within what returns to beyond it: holding back, settled on at weights of at least one, is then settled on at no weight. At weight one within the renewal both ways are settled and the start decides.

atlas.text: In a computed commons (a witness): where the rest draws within the renewal, restraint is settled exactly at weights of at least one; where it outruns the renewal, restraint is settled at no weight and the drawing law at every weight. At weight one, with the rest within the renewal, both laws are settled and every improving search keeps the one it starts from.
atlas.to: the computed commons with the rest drawing one unit a step, within the renewal: restraint is settled exactly at weights of at least one; at weight one both laws are settled and every improving search keeps the one it starts from -> the rest drawing two units a step, outrunning the renewal: restraint is settled at no weight and the drawing law at every weight

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: Where nothing rewards a choice and nothing the learner registers tells its two values apart, neither is favoured on average. A map moving every value never rests (nowhere-to-rest) is the same record's root law.
Necessary. A rule that treats two mirror-image starts alike never brings them to one; bringing them to one needs the rule itself to treat them differently.

atlas.text: To merge what a symmetry tells apart, a law must break the symmetry: where σ moves every configuration and the runs from x and σ x are at one configuration at a step, the law does not commute with σ.
atlas.to: a law under which the runs from x and from σ x are at one configuration at some step: such a law does not commute with σ

words: Every attempt to say everything about itself leaves one more thing unsaid; each revision says the last gap and makes a new one.

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: A reference changed without entering what is kept: two histories share one view while the present answers differ, and no listed move from that view resolves them.
Witness. The closed question is reopened, checked afresh and the result taken up, using up the check that was left. Reopening without checking, or with no check left, changes nothing (it stays).

atlas.text: In the named history, reopening, inspecting and taking up repairs the judgment, using up the inspection available; reopening and taking up without inspection does not, nor does reopening with no inspection left (a witness).
atlas.to: in the named history, after reopening, inspecting and taking up, the changed history's judgment is the present target (true), with the inspection budget and the work at nothing; reopening and taking up without inspection, or with no inspection left, leaves it not correct (a witness)

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: Set against references once, then the channels change: the report is defeated and nothing in the apparatus registers it. A second staying law is looks-the-same: a faithful sensor and one that reverses success and failure report alike after every action (argued, not in Lean).
Sufficient. The channels are checked afresh against known references, with enough to spend and every channel responding: the run equals the run with reports that respond.

atlas.text: Inspecting the channels with at least seven units, through a connected apparatus and with every gain nonzero, makes the admitted run equal the run with responsive reports, for every network and task list.
atlas.to: the admitted run equals the run with responsive reports, for every network and task list

words: Witness, with its threshold: seven units spent on the fresh check repair it within two tasks; six leave it as it was.

atlas.text: In the named runs, seven units revise the overwritten matrix within two tasks, one succeeding; six leave it unrevised, none succeeding (a witness).
atlas.to: in the named runs, inspecting the changed channels with seven units revises the overwritten matrix within two tasks, one succeeding; with six units it stays unrevised, none succeeding (a witness)

words: Sufficient, a pace bound. Where what it predicts repeats within a finite list, dropping each candidate a miss contradicts leaves fewer misses than a stated bound, and it proposes at every step from then on. Rest is stated only as 'not refutable'.

atlas.text: Under a determined law whose orbit is held by a list l, read through any map: elimination over the lasso candidates misses fewer than tri (length of l) times and proposes at every step from the length of l on. The bound is not shown to be the least.
atlas.to: elimination over the lasso candidates on the orbit, read through any map, of a determined law held by a list l, before step length of l -> from step length of l on, it proposes a value at every step, its current candidate having stayed below place tri (length of l); misses do not recur at arbitrarily late steps, and that it proposes and is right from some step on is not refuted

words: Once each later member acts the same whatever it privately sees, what the acts carry is only what the first few saw; anything later looks the same through the acts. Sits beside all-on-one.

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: A group that admits members only by what it already registers comes to notice a loss only as it would have without the loss. Could equally be read as only-where-it-went for a group.
Witness. A member is admitted by something the group did not yet register (the place found empty): the loss shows at once.

atlas.text: A pool admitting a reader where the habitat reads empty does not recruit through itself and couples the loss apart at once (a witness).
atlas.to: the pool admitting a reader where the habitat reads empty couples the lost and the spared history apart at step 1 (a witness)

words: Witness. A member who can notice is admitted on a fixed date whatever has happened: the loss shows from that date. Same law as the pilot's unselected-beyond exit 3; draw once, two sources.

atlas.text: The scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there, through a member the course without the loss holds too (a witness).
atlas.to: the scheduled pool, alike before step 2, couples the lost and the spared history apart at step 2, through the reader, a member at step 2 along the spared history too (a witness)

words: Exact. A new way of sorting puts together a pair the old one kept apart: some choice the old way allowed is no longer available. Every old choice is kept exactly where the new way puts together nothing the old kept apart.

atlas.text: For a reflexive, symmetric and transitive old relation and any new relation on the same alternatives, every selection through the old is through the new exactly where every pair the new relation makes alike the old one makes alike; a pair the new makes alike and the old tells apart gives a selection through the old that is not through the new (Learning.Training.lost_choice).
atlas.to: where the new relation makes alike a pair the old one tells apart, some selection through the old relation is not through the new one

words: Exact, but a gate, not a place: something is carried out exactly where there is enough in stock for each step and the way admits it. It is the condition on the arrow from felt to cost-counts. Belongs with family H (a-revision-that-opens-a-correction) and B/H's stock places.

atlas.text: Run jointly with any process step for step, the stock process executes a course from a stock and a configuration exactly where the stock covers the course and the process can execute it.
atlas.to: run jointly with a process, the stock process executes a course exactly where the stock covers it and the process can execute it; where either fails, the course is not executed

words: Witness. One unit is spent forming the link and it can now tell 'is true'. Whether it can then correct depends on a unit being left: from two, yes; from one, no (it stays in felt without the means). Leads on to family H's a-revision-that-opens-a-correction.

atlas.text: From two units, rebuilding the link forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction enabled; from one unit it forms it and leaves correction disabled (Revising.opens_without_correction; a witness).
atlas.to: a-revision-that-opens-a-correction

words: Witness. The link is rebuilt away: the difference it could tell is gone, and correcting is disabled even with a unit left.

atlas.text: Rebuilding the link away from two units loses the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled with one unit left (a witness).
atlas.to: rebuilding the link away from two units reaches (1, link unformed, response false): the selection 'is true' is no longer through the lumping, and correction is disabled (a witness)

words: Witness, by way of felt. A supplied controller forms the link (it can tell, cannot yet correct), refills the stock, and corrects at the third step. The controller's preference is supplied. Leads on to family H.

atlas.text: A supplied controller reading the stock and the link runs Revising from no stock, no link and response false: it forms the link at step 1, at step 2 the finer lumping selects 'is true' with correction disabled, it replenishes, and step 3 corrects the response to true (a witness; the controller's preference for reconstruction is supplied, not derived).
atlas.to: a-revision-that-opens-a-correction

words: Exact thresholds on being able to act: rebuilding needs something in stock; correcting needs the link formed too. 'Able to' is not 'done', so both sides are short of cost-counts. Part of the from-side (link unformed) is looks-the-same.

atlas.text: In Revising, rebuilding is enabled exactly where the stock is positive, correcting exactly where the link is formed too.
atlas.to: a configuration of Revising with no stock (rebuilding disabled), or with the link unformed (correcting disabled) -> a configuration with positive stock (rebuilding enabled), and with the link formed as well (correcting enabled)

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: While its moves go in step with what its view leaves out, a wrong view fits the record at every step.
Witness. One move made out of step with what was left out: no view of that kind fits the record any more. The record now contradicts it; no new view is said to be taken up.

atlas.text: Moving left again where the hidden bit differs from the first step, no determined process admits the projected steps up to the fifth: in this witness a move varied against the hidden bit excludes every determined model read through the outcome.
atlas.to: with the moves varied against the hidden bit, no determined process admits the projected steps of the run up to the fifth configuration: the model in which the move decides the outcome is excluded, as is every determined model read through the outcome (a witness)

item: mechanism (staying law, not an atlas item)
words: A record carried forward through every change that is admitted keeps the actual case among those it allows. This is the law of not falling behind; that the admitted changes are the actual ones is supplied.

words: What one turn round does to a difference: closes it only through a link giving back less, keeps it, or widens it. The record says none of its laws has a difference that returns without resting.

Giving that falls as what is left rises: the level goes 1, 2, 1, 2, never still (witness). Stated beside it: giving that rises with what is left, within a band, rests within 3hi+3 steps (at-rest); rising with no band climbs by one each step (one-way). G's exit into F arrives here.

Two that each end alone (ended) hold each other up and pass between (2,3) and (3,2) for ever (witness). Within a band mutual support rests (at-rest). returns_within: a run inside a bound is back at an earlier state within (B+1)^n steps; whether it cycles or rests is not said. A's exit into F arrives here.
Heater giving two wherever below the set level, window open: 3, 4, 3, 4 (witness). It returns, so nothing measured off it keeps widening: no arrow to family H's widening place.

The start is holds-itself's held configuration with its rule turned round and measured one step late: the lead falls at even steps, the rule at odd ones, held neither way at any step (Alternating.never_locked, witness). An arrow holds-itself to swinging would say this; no item of the data states it.

A forecast answered by its opposite: no published forecast is right and none is published twice running. rests_iff_right: it stays exactly where the forecast is right (at-rest), in the mechanism only; the general law lives in family D.

keeps_changing_iff: some run keeps changing exactly where a change within reach can be undone (the loop here is of states, not of dependence). It may be a different run from the same start, and staying can be possible too.

Any run among listed states revisits; under a determined rule of change, nothing merges exactly where every state returns. The other side is stated too: what keeps its whole history never returns (one-way).

Things keep starting exactly where things keep stopping: an event recurring, not a state coming back, and no period. Nearer to a place of family G or H for 'new ones come as old ones go' than to coming-round. G's ceasing-needs-arising exits into it (exact).
Where more than one next step is possible: every state returns exactly where each region never left keeps all its own possibilities; keeping every possibility alone no longer gives return (witness).
Back every two steps while what steers it is the same at every step: coming round is not learning (witness). No arrow from here to any place of revising.
Back every two steps with everything possible at each step, and yet it does not keep widening (witness): endless change is not enough for family H's widening place.

Looked at only every second step it shows as at rest (Strobe; the 1 - cos course). Not an arrow: a caution written into at-rest's test, and a candidate for a 'same place seen at another step size' mark.

Three paces of a need being met again: within p steps (seasonal: within two, not one), at some later step with no bound on the wait (Slowing), never (consumed: toward family B's place or 'ended'). May belong with B's or H's renewing places instead.
On the sixty-four figures: nothing merges, so every figure returns; the opposite at six steps, itself at twelve; no figure is a rest of it. A period is stated, of this model only.
upCrossing_next, downCrossing_next: for the late relay an upward crossing is followed by a downward one and that by an upward one, a law on every balanced run, not a witness.

Witness («入而屡之例»): a count going up by one for ever cannot get back to where it was and never stops. Being unable to go back is not being at rest. Also points toward family A's place for what cannot leave; loose fit, one built example.

atlas.text: Under the first law, a family without repetition that rises across a step is given net by the rest or is open there.
atlas.to: across the step at which the family rises, the rest of the world gives it net or the family is not closed across the step ((L.withImbalance W).NetGiver cs t none ∨ ¬ L.ClosedAt cs t)

words: Witness (Web.counting_new): a level that is one higher at every step is new at every step and past every bound. Shows the returning law needs the bound.

atlas.text: In Web.counting the level is the step, new at every step and above every bound: the bound in the laws cannot be dropped.
atlas.to: a witness, the counting web on one condition: the level is the step, so the family's configurations at any two steps differ and its stock passes every bound

words: Witness (Flow.counting_given_by_rest): closed, yet given one unit by the rest at every step, it is never the same twice. Shows the returning law needs 'the rest gives nothing'; being given is not being open. Could equally be 'stays piling-up'.

atlas.text: Web.counting with nothing taking part: the family is closed, yet counting on is new at every step, the rest giving one unit at every step; the condition that the rest gives nothing net cannot be dropped from the return of a finite whole.
atlas.to: a witness, the counting web with nothing taking part: the family is closed, yet the rest gives it one unit net at every step, so it is new at every step

words: Exact (Flow.change_recurs_iff): change goes on exactly where, again and again, a change comes that is not a running down; where every late change runs it down, change stops (as 'does not recur', no step named).

atlas.text: Under a census of what stands, standing changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly when it changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down.
atlas.to: standing changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down (∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ ¬ L.RunsDown W t ∧ ∃ c, W.Rises t c ∨ W.Falls t c)

words: Necessary (World.arising_opens): new ones keep arriving only where it is never closed in for good, each exchange losing something. Its other face is the rest theorem itself: closed in for good, it runs down to rest.

atlas.text: With a census of what is active, every relatum embodied and flow balanced and dissipative, arising without end leaves no step from which every step is enclosed.
atlas.to: with arising recurring, for every T some step from T on is not enclosed: the exchange lies within no finite family without repetition there (¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → w.flow.Enclosed t)

words: Witness (World.exposed_world): never closed in, and arrivals never stop.

atlas.text: exposed meets all eight premises, no step enclosed, and arising never ceases; so enclosure cannot be dropped. Activity needing support, bounded transmission and dissipation hold vacuously in it.
atlas.to: a witness, the world exposed: it meets all eight premises, no step is enclosed, and arising never ceases (activity needing support, bounded transmission and dissipation hold in it vacuously)

words: Witness (World.rest_needs_standing): closed in at every step and losing at each exchange, yet arrivals never stop, because what is there to use is not finitely listed. Running down that never finishes. Loose fit: could be read as coming-in-and-going-out fed from an unlimited store.

atlas.text: With only arising embodied, a world can be enclosed at every step and arise without end: throughput has no census of what stands, embodiedThroughput no census of what is active.
atlas.to: two witnesses, each enclosed at every step and arising without end: throughput, with a census of what is active, whatever arises embodied, balanced and dissipative, enclosed around its two sides, and no census of what stands; embodiedThroughput, every step enclosed, every relatum embodied, balanced and dissipative, and no census of what is active

words: Witness (World.rest_needs_census): members leave one after another for ever and none arrive; possible only where those present are not finitely listed.

atlas.text: attrition meets every premise of the rest theorem but the census of what is active, every step enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs.
atlas.to: a witness, attrition: a census of what stands (nothing stands), whatever arises embodied, balanced, dissipative, every step enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurring, with no census of what is active

words: Witness (Gathering.gathers): a record that gains from an unlimited outside rises at every step while exchange goes on. Shows the stopping law needs 'gains nothing' and a finite whole.

atlas.text: Exact conservation, every step enclosed and the exchange recurring, a record's level an arrow from the start, rising at every step, where the record gains from relata beyond it and the world is not finite: gaining nothing and finiteness do work.
atlas.to: a witness, gathering: balanced, conserving, every step enclosed, the exchange recurring, a record's level an arrow from step 0 (never falling, and rising across every step at which the family [0] changes), the family [0] gainless at no step, and the world not finite

words: Witness (Passing.passes), target F's lossless-exchange-continues-and-returns: a unit carried back and forth, each exchange undone at the next step, nothing lost; neither rest nor running down.

atlas.text: Finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed, each exchange reversed at the next step, arising and ceasing recurring, with no arrow: the first law gives neither rest nor dissipation. The lossless returning course, entered by family F.
atlas.to: lossless-exchange-continues-and-returns

words: Necessary (arising_opens_refinement_counted): as continued-change exit 2, with the splitting of the unit counted as something that gives.

atlas.text: In a world with a census of activity and embodied relata, balanced at the refining unit and, with the refinement counted, dissipative at every step, where arising recurs no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed with the refinement counted.
atlas.to: with arising recurring, for every T some step from T on is not enclosed with the refinement counted (¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → (w.flow.withRefinement w.web split).Enclosed t)

words: Necessary (arising_needs_refinement): arrivals go on only where it is not both closed in and given nothing by the splitting of the unit: the supply is from outside or from ever finer amounts.

atlas.text: Balanced at the refining unit and dissipative, where arising recurs no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed and the refinement gives no relatum anything.
atlas.to: with arising recurring, for every T it is not the case both that every step from T on is enclosed and that the refinement gives no relatum anything from T on

words: Witness (arising_needs_quantum, emission): closed in, half of each taking lost, amounts halving at every step; a new one arrives at every step. Never reaches rest. Under the reading that counts the splitting as a giver it is fed, and would sit in coming-in-and-going-out.

atlas.text: Emission, with a census, embodied relata, every step enclosed and half of what is taken lost, has a new relatum arise at every step, standing at one unit of the step after, and does not balance at the fixed unit.
atlas.to: a witness, emission: a census of what is active, every relatum embodied, the flow balanced at a unit splitting in two at every step, dissipative and dissipative in proportion 1, every step enclosed, arising recurring, and no balance at the fixed unit

words: Witness (exchange_needs_quantum, circulation): the same, with a loss that is no fixed part of what is taken; exchange never stops.

atlas.text: Circulation exchanges one whole unit of step 0 at every step, every step enclosed around what stands, losing one unit of the step after, and is dissipative in no proportion.
atlas.to: a witness, circulation: a census of what stands, balance at the unit splitting in two, dissipative, every step enclosed around what stands, one whole unit of step 0 exchanged at every step, the exchange recurring, and dissipative in no proportion

words: Witness (rest_needs_quantum, asymptote): a closed pool taken from at arbitrarily late steps while the unit keeps splitting.

atlas.text: With the unit splitting at arbitrarily late steps, the closed pool of Asymptote is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, its flow balanced at that resolution and dissipative, even losing all it takes; it does not balance at the fixed unit.
atlas.to: a witness, asymptote, with the unit splitting at arbitrarily late steps: the closed pool is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, its flow balanced at that resolution, dissipative and dissipative in every proportion, and not balanced at the fixed unit

words: Exact (World.InAmounts.change_stops_iff): it stops changing exactly where its total stops falling. One arrow with continued-change exit 1, in any kind of amounts.

atlas.text: A family balanced and dissipated on from T on stops changing, as far as can be refuted, exactly where its total's strict falls stop; the edge is that they do not stop.
atlas.to: the family's total's strict falls do not stop from T on (¬ M.FallsStop (v.stock M ds) T), so it is not the case that the family stops changing, as far as can be refuted

words: Witness (Pass.endless_keeps_from_rest): along an amount that falls at every step it never rests.

atlas.text: Along an amount that does not rise and falls strictly at every step, a standing passed between two relata meets the enclosed premises and never rests; no list holds its levels.
atlas.to: a witness, in any amounts along an amount d that does not rise and falls strictly at every step: a standing passed between two relata has a census of its active relata, every relatum embodied, a balanced and dissipative flow and every step enclosed, and rests from no step on

words: Witness (Halving.worlds_need_not_rest): amounts with no smallest loss, or with one but no limit to how many fit in the stock.

atlas.text: In dyadic amounts (no least fall) some world with the enclosed premises never rests; in layered amounts (not Archimedean) likewise, Layered.worlds_need_not_rest.
atlas.to: a witness: in the dyadic amounts, Archimedean with no least fall, not every world with the enclosed premises rests (¬ Dyadic.amounts.WorldsRest); in layered amounts, with a least fall and not Archimedean, likewise

words: Witness (Halving.never_rests): every loss above nothing, none smallest; it falls at every step.

atlas.text: Dense, Archimedean dyadic amounts, every loss above nothing and no least loss, the stock falling at every step.
atlas.to: a witness in the dyadic amounts, Archimedean: across each step the stock falls by its loss, the stock does not rise, every loss is above nothing, for every ε above nothing not every step loses at least ε, and its strict falls recur

words: Witness (Layered.never_rests): a smallest loss at every step, the stock larger than any number of them.

atlas.text: In layered amounts a least loss at every step, the stock beyond every multiple of it, falling at every step; the amounts are not Archimedean, so approach fails too.
atlas.to: a witness in layered amounts: the stock does not rise, falls by at least a least loss above nothing at every step, holds every multiple of that loss at the start, and its strict falls recur

words: Witness (Halving.stock_unlisted): falling for ever needs values no finite list holds.

atlas.text: Falls that recur need a reading no list holds: the halving stock falls strictly at every step, and no list holds its values.
atlas.to: a witness: the halving stock in the dyadic amounts takes values no list holds (¬ ∃ l, ∀ t, stock t ∈ l), while its strict falls recur

words: Witness (RandomEnd.rest_not_in_expectation): every single run comes to rest, while the average over runs falls at every step. The average is not a run. In the example the level goes to nothing, so a later reader may say ended.

atlas.text: Every realization comes to rest, while the expected level falls strictly at every step and never rests.
atlas.to: a witness: a condition standing at one up to a random step ω and at nothing after it, ω weighted by one half to the power ω + 1; every realization comes to rest from step ω + 1 on, while the expected level falls strictly at every step and never rests

words: Witness (Alternation.alternates), target F's overcompensating-giving-cycles: what comes back is large from nothing and nothing from more; the level moves between one and two at every step and is never still.

atlas.text: Without giving rising with what is left: giving two from nothing and nothing from more keeps a band up to two under a draw of one, yet the run from one moves between one and two at every step.
atlas.to: overcompensating-giving-cycles

words: Witness (Crossing.rises_without_rest): with no ceiling, the level rises by one at every step. Loose fit: what comes back is the stock's own renewal, not a gift from an outside named in the law.

atlas.text: With no band, the gated giving's run from five rises at every step.
atlas.to: a witness with no band: the gated giving rises with what is left and rests at the draw, yet the run from five rises by one at every step (its state at n is n + 5) and neither it nor the adjusted run from (5, 3) is still from any step

words: Exact (Saturation.stops_iff): a way through that weakens with what it has carried stops passing anything exactly where its response reaches nothing at some amount carried.

atlas.text: With strengths f a times k, a what has passed and f not rising, k reading the level of a listed condition at each step through some formation present outside the part and that level standing, the coupling stops by some step exactly where f is zero at some amount.
atlas.to: the response f is zero at no amount, and the coupling stops by no step (¬ ∃ N, StopsBy cs part (strengths part (scaled f k) present l) present d c N)

words: Sufficient (Saturation.floored): where the response never falls below one, at least one more passes at every step, from a source that stands.

atlas.text: With the response at least one at every amount, under the same reading, the coupling recurs and at least one more passes at every step.
atlas.to: the coupling recurs: at arbitrarily late steps something passes through it, and by every step t at least t has passed (CouplingRecurs ... ∧ ∀ t, t ≤ passed part (scaled f k) present l d c t)

words: Necessary (Unceasing.activeRenewer_recurs): where each arrival goes with a fall in a stock, arrivals without end need renewing that stops from no step on.

atlas.text: Where, at a step at which no condition of the family rises, each arising goes with a fall in one of them, and every rise is an active renewer's, unceasing arising leaves renewing stopping from no step on.
atlas.to: an active renewer of the family recurs: for every T, it is not the case that from T on no formation is an active renewer (¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → ∀ f, ¬ W.ActiveRenewer renews cs t f)

words: Necessary (Flow.uptake_needs_replenishment): taking at arbitrarily late steps needs giving back at arbitrarily late steps.

atlas.text: Under balance, positive uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs the family replenished at arbitrarily late steps.
atlas.to: the family's replenishment is zero from no step on (for every T, ¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → L.replenishment cs t = 0)

words: Witness (Recycle.closed_unceasing), target F's closed-cycle-without-dissipation: one unit passed between two pools, nothing lost; arrivals never stop and nothing comes in.

atlas.text: One unit cycles between two pools, the total stays one, every premise holds and arising is unceasing; the dissipation law needs every arising to lower the quantity concerned.
atlas.to: closed-cycle-without-dissipation

words: Exact (CountedBy.arising_iff_ceasing): where the number present comes back under some ceiling again and again, new ones keep arriving exactly where old ones keep leaving. A count, not a cause.

atlas.text: On a World with activity decided, at most B t relata active at each step t and listed, and B returning within some K at arbitrarily late steps, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.
atlas.to: on a world with activity decided and its census counted by a bound returning within K at arbitrarily late steps, arising recurs exactly where ceasing does (w.ArisingRecurs ↔ w.CeasingRecurs)

words: Exact (World.arising_iff_ceasing): the same in a finite whole. One mark with exit 1.

atlas.text: In a finite world whose activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.
atlas.to: in a finite world with activity decided, arising recurs exactly where ceasing does (w.ArisingRecurs ↔ w.CeasingRecurs)

words: Exact (arising_iff_ceasing_decided), target F's recurrence-without-decidedness: the same with less assumed about what can be decided. One mark with exit 1.

atlas.text: In a finite world whose activity is decided from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does, with no decision procedure.
atlas.to: recurrence-without-decidedness

words: Witness (World.census_one_way), first of two examples: arrivals without end and nobody leaving, the number present without a ceiling.

atlas.text: accretion has a census, arising recurring and ceasing not; attrition keeps ceasing while nothing arises, so by this law it has no census.
atlas.to: two witnesses: accretion, with a census of what is active, arising recurring and ceasing not; attrition, ceasing recurring, nothing arising and no census of what is active

words: The same item's second example: members keep leaving and none arrive, possible only where those present are not finitely listed.

atlas.text: accretion has a census, arising recurring and ceasing not; attrition keeps ceasing while nothing arises, so by this law it has no census.
atlas.to: two witnesses: accretion, with a census of what is active, arising recurring and ceasing not; attrition, ceasing recurring, nothing arising and no census of what is active

words: Witness (World.slow_world): under any ceiling that keeps rising, however slowly, arrivals can go on with nobody leaving.

atlas.text: For any non-decreasing, unbounded B, in slow B a census is counted by B, arising recurs and nothing ever ceases: no bound growing without end keeps the two together.
atlas.to: a witness for any bound B that never falls and passes every number: in the world slow B a census is counted by B, arising recurs and nothing ever ceases

words: Witness (World.procession_world): one present at a time, each leaving as the next arrives, without end.

atlas.text: One relatum active at each step, arising and ceasing both recurring, the relata not finitely many: the bounded law reaches beyond finite worlds.
atlas.to: a witness, procession: one relatum active at each step (counted within 1), arising and ceasing both recurring, the relata not finitely many

words: Necessary for leaving (SharedCodes.outside_needed): where everyone holds the one way, all hold it at every later step under copying; the difference comes back only if someone outside still keeps another.

atlas.text: Where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, those imposed on and those kept alike, all hold it at every later step: the return needs a form held outside.
atlas.to: a merged distinction returns only where some formation outside the group does not hold the imposed form at the sense: where every formation, imposed on or kept, holds it at step n, all hold it at every later step

words: Sufficient (SharedCodes.outside_returns): one who hears, from outside, a different word for one of the two things can tell them apart again, and now differs from the rest. Same law as the pilot's hanging a-code-formed exit 4.

atlas.text: Where a formation holds the imposed form at one sense and, under a rule that always takes the form heard, hears at a sense the imposed code merges with it a formation whose form there is not the imposed one, it then tells the two senses apart although the imposed code merges them.
atlas.to: after the step at which h, holding the imposed form at m', hears at m a formation j whose form there is not the imposed one, under the rule that always takes the form heard, h tells m from m' (r.state (n + 1) h m ≠ r.state (n + 1) h m') although the imposed code merges them

words: Sufficient (SharedCodes.coined_returns): a newly made word for one of the two, heard by all, lets everyone tell them apart again while all still hold the same way. Same law as the pilot's a-code-formed exit 5.

atlas.text: Where all hold a code merging two senses, a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again.
atlas.to: where all hold an imposed code, a form x coined by o at m, not the form the code gives m', broadcast to every formation under the rule always, leaves every formation telling m from m'

words: One built example (counting up by ones): pulled in, yet its marked steps never stop. It shows that being pulled toward something is not being at rest. Needs family A's place for 'pulled toward'; the example itself is building-up.

atlas.text: Along the successor on the whole numbers every step is an F step, so the F steps recur, and 0 is drawn in: being drawn does not bring rest.
atlas.to: a witness on the whole numbers: Q and F both the successor step, the line g the identity, every step a step of Q, the F steps recurring along g («屡» F g), and the line's place at 0 drawn in under Q («入» Q (g 0)): a place drawn in whose marked steps recur, so not at rest

words: Exact dividing line, both ways, among finitely many states: it can keep changing exactly where some change it can reach can be undone. Where none can, no run keeps changing; that it then stops at a nameable step is not given. Target is F's a-run-round-a-loop-keeps-changing.

atlas.text: In a world a list holds, some run from a configuration keeps changing exactly where a configuration reachable from it has a step to another configuration from which it can be reached again.
atlas.to: a-run-round-a-loop-keeps-changing

words: Necessary: only while, again and again, it steps outside any fixed set of moves.

words: Necessary: only while what is held fixed keeps being changed.

atlas.text: The held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end: from every step some bounded stretch does not hold it throughout.
atlas.to: the held possible keeps widening along the course, and from every step N some bounded stretch from N does not hold the part read by Same throughout (∃ d, ¬ ∀ i, i < d → Same (r.state (N + i)) (r.state (N + i + 1)))

words: Necessary: only where no finite list holds all it could ever reach.

atlas.text: It keeps widening only where no list holds the whole possible from the course's start.

words: One built example: a rule raised at every step. Nothing in it lasts from one moment to the next.

atlas.text: With a rule raised at every step, the possible with the rule held keeps widening while every formation is possible from every configuration of the course; read on the course's moments under the rule held, every moment ceases.
atlas.to: a witness on the raised rule's process (a configuration a rule n and a position; a move raises the rule by one or moves the position to any value at most n): along the course raising the rule at every step from (0, 0), the possible with the rule held keeps widening, read from its first step

words: One built example: a tower of rules, each changed once as the change climbs.

atlas.text: On a tower whose moves above 0 copy a rule down, each rule changing once as the change climbs, the possible with the rules from every height up held keeps widening.
atlas.to: a witness on a rule tower whose move k + 1 copies the rule at height k + 1 down to height k: along the course copying down to height k at step k, the possible with the rules from any height n up held keeps widening, read from its first step

words: One built example (rule raised every other step) that is always-new and renewed without end together. To family H's rule-raised-every-other-step; the second half is kept-up or H's own place.

atlas.text: With the rule raised at every other step, the held possible keeps widening, every formation stays possible, and renewal without end holds at every even moment.
atlas.to: rule-raised-every-other-step

words: Necessary, with fixed needs and nothing made from nothing: only while, again and again, the rest gives it more than it takes or its edge is open (building-up). Could be drawn as a needed line from building-up.

atlas.text: Under the first law, the family without repetition, at arbitrarily late steps the rest gives it net or it is not closed.
atlas.to: at arbitrarily late steps the rest of the world gives the family more than it takes, or the family is not closed across the step (∀ M, ∃ t, M ≤ t ∧ ((L.withImbalance W).NetGiver cs t none ∨ ¬ L.ClosedAt cs t))

words: Necessary: if it also gives back as much as it gets, then its edge is open again and again.

atlas.text: With balance on the family from a step as well, it is not closed at arbitrarily late steps.
atlas.to: with balance on the family from T₀ as well, the family is not closed across the step at arbitrarily late steps (∀ M, ∃ t, M ≤ t ∧ ¬ L.ClosedAt cs t): some formation present takes or gives a condition outside it

words: One built example where something is given from nothing: closed, never given to, still always new. Shows the 'nothing made from nothing' premise is needed.

atlas.text: Without the first law: with a source giving from nothing, a finite balanced world keeps widening by name, its family closed and never given from beyond.
atlas.to: a witness without the first law: on one condition, a flow with a source giving from nothing balances, keeps widening by name from step 0 with needs fixed within the one condition, every condition listed once, and at no step is the rest a net giver or the family open

words: One built example where needs shrink: always new on a stock of one. Shows fixed needs are needed for the tie to building-up.

atlas.text: Without fixed needs: on a loosening web, needs falling toward one, a course keeps widening by name with stock one throughout.
atlas.to: a witness without fixed needs: on a loosening web with one condition, a course keeps widening by name from step 0 with every requirement on that condition, the need of a formation changing between steps 0 and 1, and the stock one at every step

words: One built example: counted by kind it is always-new, counted by name it only comes round again (going-round). To family H's kind-relay-keeps-widening-within-kinds.

atlas.text: On the kind relay, six formations of two kinds whose units pass within and across kinds with period two, the kind chosen so that the passings across kinds begin, the levels keep widening within kinds, while what it can form by name only returns.
atlas.to: kind-relay-keeps-widening-within-kinds

words: Exact: a part's giving opens something for the rest exactly when it never takes past the slack of anything the rest could already do and, at some moment, brings one more thing within reach.

atlas.text: With balance before each step at the conditions each formation requires, the levels with a part widen those without it exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation the levels without it admit and, at some step, brings within it one they do not.
atlas.to: the levels with the part widen those without it: its net draw stays within the margin for every formation the levels without it admit, and at some step brings within the margin a formation they do not admit

words: One built example: a giver from beyond. Without it one thing can never form; with it that thing can from the next step on.

atlas.text: A giver from beyond: without its part the condition stays at zero and a formation is admitted at no step; with it that formation is supported from step one on.
atlas.to: a witness, a giver from beyond: without its part the formation false is admitted at no step, with it that formation is supported from step 1 on, and the levels with the part include and exceed those without it (they widen them)

words: One built example: a taker that stays supported throughout takes what another needed; the other cannot go on from the second step. It opens nothing.

atlas.text: The clearer, active and supported at every step: its part opens nothing and closes the dweller, unsupported from step two on.
atlas.to: a witness, the clearer's part: the levels without the part include and exceed those with it, so the part opens nothing and closes some formation (it narrows)

words: One built example: a unit moved from one stock to another. One thing becomes possible and another stops being so: running-down for one, building-up for the other. No single place; the chapter says ordering it needs a further judgment that names its measure and who holds it.

atlas.text: A conveyor takes a unit from one condition and gives it to another: each path admits a formation the other does not.
atlas.to: a witness, a conveyor taking a unit from one condition and giving it to another: each level path exceeds the other, the levels without the part admitting the first formation and not the second at every step, the levels with it supporting the second and not the first from step 1 on (mixed)

words: One built example: within what comes back at the moment it is looked at, yet over the whole run it takes more than comes back. A look at one moment does not settle whether it is kept-up or running-down.

atlas.text: A drawer within renewal at its step, consuming over the run: its part narrows, so being within renewal at a step decides nothing.
atlas.to: a witness, a drawer within renewal at step 0 (RenewingAt 0), consuming over the run and not renewing over it: the levels without its part widen those with it, so being within renewal at a step decides nothing

words: One built example: it would use up a stock that never reaches what it needs, so nothing is taken and everything else is as it would be without it. Wants a place for 'makes no difference to the rest' (near the readers' 'made good again'); none of mine fits.

atlas.text: A formation drawing on a condition that stays below its need, consuming over the run with nothing taken: its part keeps what can form the same, so consuming alone does not narrow.
atlas.to: a witness on one condition: a formation drawing on a condition that stays below its need, consuming over the run with nothing taken, the flow balanced and only active formations taking: the levels with and without its part admit alike (it keeps what can form the same)

words: One built example: a newcomer takes a unit before something else comes to depend on it. Arriving new does not settle which side it is on.

atlas.text: A member not active at the start that arises across the first step then narrows, taking a condition's unit before a dependence on it forms.
atlas.to: a witness: the flow balanced, only active formations taking, and only from what they draw on, and only active formations giving; a member not active at the start arises across the first step, and the levels without its part widen those with it (it narrows)

words: One built example: a newcomer gives a unit that something later needs.

atlas.text: A member not active at the start that arises across the first step then widens, giving a condition the unit a later dependence needs: the arising class does not decide.
atlas.to: a witness: the flow balanced, only active formations taking, and only from what they draw on, and only active formations giving; a member not active at the start arises across the first step, and the levels with its part widen those without it

words: Necessary, nothing made from nothing: any rise at all is given across that step by the rest, or its edge is open there.

atlas.text: Under the first law, a family without repetition that rises across a step is given net by the rest or is open there.
atlas.to: across the step at which the family rises, the rest of the world gives it net or the family is not closed across the step ((L.withImbalance W).NetGiver cs t none ∨ ¬ L.ClosedAt cs t)

words: One built example: a level that is the count of steps, above every bound, never the same twice. Shows the bound cannot be dropped from the law of coming back.

atlas.text: In Web.counting the level is the step, new at every step and above every bound: the bound in the laws cannot be dropped.
atlas.to: a witness, the counting web on one condition: the level is the step, so the family's configurations at any two steps differ and its stock passes every bound

words: One built example: closed, yet the rest gives one unit at every step. Being given to is not the same as being open.

atlas.text: Web.counting with nothing taking part: the family is closed, yet counting on is new at every step, the rest giving one unit at every step; the condition that the rest gives nothing net cannot be dropped from the return of a finite whole.
atlas.to: a witness, the counting web with nothing taking part: the family is closed, yet the rest gives it one unit net at every step, so it is new at every step

words: Exact, with a finite count of what stands: change goes on without end exactly where it keeps happening at steps that use nothing up; otherwise it stops, with no step named.

atlas.text: Under a census of what stands, standing changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly when it changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down.
atlas.to: standing changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down (∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ ¬ L.RunsDown W t ∧ ∃ c, W.Rises t c ∨ W.Falls t c)

words: Necessary: things keep arising only if, after every moment, it is at some later moment not closed off.
