atlas.text: With a census of what is active, every relatum embodied and flow balanced and dissipative, arising without end leaves no step from which every step is enclosed.
atlas.to: with arising recurring, for every T some step from T on is not enclosed: the exchange lies within no finite family without repetition there (¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → w.flow.Enclosed t)

words: One built example never closed off, exchanging with a ground without limit: things keep arising.

atlas.text: exposed meets all eight premises, no step enclosed, and arising never ceases; so enclosure cannot be dropped. Activity needing support, bounded transmission and dissipation hold vacuously in it.
atlas.to: a witness, the world exposed: it meets all eight premises, no step is enclosed, and arising never ceases (activity needing support, bounded transmission and dissipation hold in it vacuously)

words: Two built examples closed off at every step where things keep arising: the fuel still standing has no finite count (or what is active has none). Without the finite count, running down never arrives at rest.

atlas.text: With only arising embodied, a world can be enclosed at every step and arise without end: throughput has no census of what stands, embodiedThroughput no census of what is active.
atlas.to: two witnesses, each enclosed at every step and arising without end: throughput, with a census of what is active, whatever arises embodied, balanced and dissipative, enclosed around its two sides, and no census of what stands; embodiedThroughput, every step enclosed, every relatum embodied, balanced and dissipative, and no census of what is active

words: One built example: things keep ceasing with nothing arising; what is active has no finite count.

atlas.text: attrition meets every premise of the rest theorem but the census of what is active, every step enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs.
atlas.to: a witness, attrition: a census of what stands (nothing stands), whatever arises embodied, balanced, dissipative, every step enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurring, with no census of what is active

words: One built example: a record whose level rises with every exchange. It gains from beyond itself and the whole is not finite; a record that keeps growing needs both.

atlas.text: Exact conservation, every step enclosed and the exchange recurring, a record's level an arrow from the start, rising at every step, where the record gains from relata beyond it and the world is not finite: gaining nothing and finiteness do work.
atlas.to: a witness, gathering: balanced, conserving, every step enclosed, the exchange recurring, a record's level an arrow from step 0 (never falling, and rising across every step at which the family [0] changes), the family [0] gainless at no step, and the world not finite

words: One built example: closed off, nothing lost, each exchange undone at the next step. Neither at rest nor running down. Target is F's lossless-exchange-continues-and-returns.

atlas.text: Finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed, each exchange reversed at the next step, arising and ceasing recurring, with no arrow: the first law gives neither rest nor dissipation. The lossless returning course, entered by family F.
atlas.to: lossless-exchange-continues-and-returns

words: Necessary, at every fineness of unit, with the splitting of the unit counted as a giver: things keep arising only if it is not closed off again and again.

atlas.text: In a world with a census of activity and embodied relata, balanced at the refining unit and, with the refinement counted, dissipative at every step, where arising recurs no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed with the refinement counted.
atlas.to: with arising recurring, for every T some step from T on is not enclosed with the refinement counted (¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → (w.flow.withRefinement w.web split).Enclosed t)

words: Necessary: things keep arising only if, again and again, it is either not closed off or given something by the splitting of the unit.

atlas.text: Balanced at the refining unit and dissipative, where arising recurs no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed and the refinement gives no relatum anything.
atlas.to: with arising recurring, for every T it is not the case both that every step from T on is enclosed and that the refinement gives no relatum anything from T on

words: One built example: closed off, half of what is taken lost, the unit halving at every step; something new arises at every step and it is never at rest. On the reading that counts the splitting as a giver (an AI reading) it is kept-up instead.

atlas.text: Emission, with a census, embodied relata, every step enclosed and half of what is taken lost, has a new relatum arise at every step, standing at one unit of the step after, and does not balance at the fixed unit.
atlas.to: a witness, emission: a census of what is active, every relatum embodied, the flow balanced at a unit splitting in two at every step, dissipative and dissipative in proportion 1, every step enclosed, arising recurring, and no balance at the fixed unit

words: One built example: one whole unit exchanged at every step while the loss per step halves. Never at rest; shows a loss in proportion is needed.

atlas.text: Circulation exchanges one whole unit of step 0 at every step, every step enclosed around what stands, losing one unit of the step after, and is dissipative in no proportion.
atlas.to: a witness, circulation: a census of what stands, balance at the unit splitting in two, dissipative, every step enclosed around what stands, one whole unit of step 0 exchanged at every step, the exchange recurring, and dissipative in no proportion

words: One built example: a closed pool taken from at arbitrarily late steps, the unit splitting without end. Never at rest.

atlas.text: With the unit splitting at arbitrarily late steps, the closed pool of Asymptote is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, its flow balanced at that resolution and dissipative, even losing all it takes; it does not balance at the fixed unit.
atlas.to: a witness, asymptote, with the unit splitting at arbitrarily late steps: the closed pool is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, its flow balanced at that resolution, dissipative and dissipative in every proportion, and not balanced at the fixed unit

words: Exact, in any amounts: it stops changing exactly where its total stops going down (as far as can be refuted).

atlas.text: A family balanced and dissipated on from T on stops changing, as far as can be refuted, exactly where its total's strict falls stop; the edge is that they do not stop.
atlas.to: the family's total's strict falls do not stop from T on (¬ M.FallsStop (v.stock M ds) T), so it is not the case that the family stops changing, as far as can be refuted

words: One built example: a total that goes down at every step and never rises; never at rest, and no finite list holds its levels.

atlas.text: Along an amount that does not rise and falls strictly at every step, a standing passed between two relata meets the enclosed premises and never rests; no list holds its levels.
atlas.to: a witness, in any amounts along an amount d that does not rise and falls strictly at every step: a standing passed between two relata has a census of its active relata, every relatum embodied, a balanced and dissipative flow and every step enclosed, and rests from no step on

words: Built examples: amounts with no least fall, or with a least fall but no end to how many fit; some closed whole never rests.

atlas.text: In dyadic amounts (no least fall) some world with the enclosed premises never rests; in layered amounts (not Archimedean) likewise, Layered.worlds_need_not_rest.
atlas.to: a witness: in the dyadic amounts, Archimedean with no least fall, not every world with the enclosed premises rests (¬ Dyadic.amounts.WorldsRest); in layered amounts, with a least fall and not Archimedean, likewise

words: One built example: a stock halving, every loss above nothing, no least loss; it falls at every step.

atlas.text: Dense, Archimedean dyadic amounts, every loss above nothing and no least loss, the stock falling at every step.
atlas.to: a witness in the dyadic amounts, Archimedean: across each step the stock falls by its loss, the stock does not rise, every loss is above nothing, for every ε above nothing not every step loses at least ε, and its strict falls recur

words: One built example: a least loss at every step, the stock holding every multiple of it; it falls at every step.

atlas.text: In layered amounts a least loss at every step, the stock beyond every multiple of it, falling at every step; the amounts are not Archimedean, so approach fails too.
atlas.to: a witness in layered amounts: the stock does not rise, falls by at least a least loss above nothing at every step, holds every multiple of that loss at the start, and its strict falls recur

words: One built example: the halving stock takes values no finite list holds. Falls that never stop need that.

atlas.text: Falls that recur need a reading no list holds: the halving stock falls strictly at every step, and no list holds its values.
atlas.to: a witness: the halving stock in the dyadic amounts takes values no list holds (¬ ∃ l, ∀ t, stock t ∈ l), while its strict falls recur

words: One built example with chance: every single run comes to rest, while the average over runs falls at every step and never rests. At rest is said run by run, not of the average.

atlas.text: Every realization comes to rest, while the expected level falls strictly at every step and never rests.
atlas.to: a witness: a condition standing at one up to a random step ω and at nothing after it, ω weighted by one half to the power ω + 1; every realization comes to rest from step ω + 1 on, while the expected level falls strictly at every step and never rests

words: One built example: giving that falls as what is left rises (two from nothing, nothing from more); the level moves between one and two for ever. Target is F's overcompensating-giving-cycles. The law of rest it bounds is at-rest within a known number of steps.

atlas.text: Without giving rising with what is left: giving two from nothing and nothing from more keeps a band up to two under a draw of one, yet the run from one moves between one and two at every step.
atlas.to: overcompensating-giving-cycles

words: One built example with no upper band: the level rises by one at every step.

atlas.text: With no band, the gated giving's run from five rises at every step.
atlas.to: a witness with no band: the gated giving rises with what is left and rests at the draw, yet the run from five rises by one at every step (its state at n is n + 5) and neither it nor the adjusted run from (5, 3) is still from any step

words: Exact: a link that weakens with what has passed through it stops by some step exactly where the weakening reaches nothing at some amount.

atlas.text: With strengths f a times k, a what has passed and f not rising, k reading the level of a listed condition at each step through some formation present outside the part and that level standing, the coupling stops by some step exactly where f is zero at some amount.
atlas.to: the response f is zero at no amount, and the coupling stops by no step (¬ ∃ N, StopsBy cs part (strengths part (scaled f k) present l) present d c N)

words: Sufficient: where the link never weakens below a floor and the level it draws from is held up, at least one more passes at every step. Doubtful fit: the held-up level is a premise, not a law of replacement.

atlas.text: With the response at least one at every amount, under the same reading, the coupling recurs and at least one more passes at every step.
atlas.to: the coupling recurs: at arbitrarily late steps something passes through it, and by every step t at least t has passed (CouplingRecurs ... ∧ ∀ t, t ≤ passed part (scaled f k) present l d c t)

words: Necessary: things keep arising only while something that renews what they use keeps acting.

atlas.text: Where, at a step at which no condition of the family rises, each arising goes with a fall in one of them, and every rise is an active renewer's, unceasing arising leaves renewing stopping from no step on.
atlas.to: an active renewer of the family recurs: for every T, it is not the case that from T on no formation is an active renewer (¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → ∀ f, ¬ W.ActiveRenewer renews cs t f)

words: Necessary, nothing made from nothing: taking at arbitrarily late moments needs putting back at arbitrarily late moments.

atlas.text: Under balance, positive uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs the family replenished at arbitrarily late steps.
atlas.to: the family's replenishment is zero from no step on (for every T, ¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → L.replenishment cs t = 0)

words: One built example: one unit goes round two pools, the total stays one, and arising never stops. Kept up by the round alone, nothing from beyond and nothing lost. Target is F's closed-cycle-without-dissipation.

atlas.text: One unit cycles between two pools, the total stays one, every premise holds and arising is unceasing; the dissipation law needs every arising to lower the quantity concerned.
atlas.to: closed-cycle-without-dissipation

words: Exact: where the number present comes back within some bound again and again, things keep arising exactly where things keep ceasing.

atlas.text: On a World with activity decided, at most B t relata active at each step t and listed, and B returning within some K at arbitrarily late steps, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.
atlas.to: on a world with activity decided and its census counted by a bound returning within K at arbitrarily late steps, arising recurs exactly where ceasing does (w.ArisingRecurs ↔ w.CeasingRecurs)

words: Exact: the same in a finite whole.

atlas.text: In a finite world whose activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.
atlas.to: in a finite world with activity decided, arising recurs exactly where ceasing does (w.ArisingRecurs ↔ w.CeasingRecurs)

words: Exact: the same where who is present is decided only from some step on. Target is F's recurrence-without-decidedness.

atlas.text: In a finite world whose activity is decided from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does, with no decision procedure.
atlas.to: recurrence-without-decidedness

words: Two built examples in one item: only coming, with a count of who is present (building-up), and only going, with no finite count of who is present (running-down). A later reader may split it.

atlas.text: accretion has a census, arising recurring and ceasing not; attrition keeps ceasing while nothing arises, so by this law it has no census.
atlas.to: two witnesses: accretion, with a census of what is active, arising recurring and ceasing not; attrition, ceasing recurring, nothing arising and no census of what is active

words: Built example for any room that never shrinks and grows past every number, however slowly: things keep arising and nothing ever ceases.

atlas.text: For any non-decreasing, unbounded B, in slow B a census is counted by B, arising recurs and nothing ever ceases: no bound growing without end keeps the two together.
atlas.to: a witness for any bound B that never falls and passes every number: in the world slow B a census is counted by B, arising recurs and nothing ever ceases

words: One built example: one present at a time, each one new, without end. The pace law reaches beyond finite wholes.

atlas.text: One relatum active at each step, arising and ceasing both recurring, the relata not finitely many: the bounded law reaches beyond finite worlds.
atlas.to: a witness, procession: one relatum active at each step (counted within 1), arising and ceasing both recurring, the relata not finitely many

words: Necessary: where everyone anywhere holds the shared way at that point, under copying all hold it at every later step. Getting the difference back needs someone outside the group who holds another way. Same law as a-code-formed exit 3.

atlas.text: Where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, those imposed on and those kept alike, all hold it at every later step: the return needs a form held outside.
atlas.to: a merged distinction returns only where some formation outside the group does not hold the imposed form at the sense: where every formation, imposed on or kept, holds it at step n, all hold it at every later step

words: Sufficient: a member hears, from someone holding another way, a different form for one of the two and takes it; that member tells the two apart again. Same law as the pilot's hanging a-code-formed exit 4; draw it once.

atlas.text: Where a formation holds the imposed form at one sense and, under a rule that always takes the form heard, hears at a sense the imposed code merges with it a formation whose form there is not the imposed one, it then tells the two senses apart although the imposed code merges them.
atlas.to: after the step at which h, holding the imposed form at m', hears at m a formation j whose form there is not the imposed one, under the rule that always takes the form heard, h tells m from m' (r.state (n + 1) h m ≠ r.state (n + 1) h m') although the imposed code merges them

words: Sufficient: a new word is made for one of the two and heard by all; everyone tells them apart again, all still on the same one. Same law as a-code-formed exit 5.

atlas.text: Where all hold a code merging two senses, a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again.
atlas.to: where all hold an imposed code, a form x coined by o at m, not the form the code gives m', broadcast to every formation under the rule always, leaves every formation telling m from m'

words: Pace bound: more is given than taken at each step until then; back at the need within as many steps as it was short. The Lean (Flow.restores) starts from any level, not only one below a need. The entry's own open: being back does not mean staying.

atlas.text: Where giving jointly exceeds taking at each step at which the level is not below its start, m − level steps bring it to at least m.
atlas.to: c at its level at T, given more than is taken at each step at which it is not below that start -> c at least at m by step T + (m − its level at T)

words: Witness: it comes to need less and so is supported again. The entry calls this change, not recovery. No place for 'now needs something else'; family A's three-outcomes-of-a-loss names it 'transformed'.

atlas.text: A requirement dissolves (requirements loosen): a formation unsupported at step zero is supported at step one (a witness); dissolving a requirement is transformation, not recovery.
atlas.to: a witness: balanced, only active formations giving and activity needing support, with nothing supported at step 0, a formation whose requirement loosens across step 0 is supported at step 1

words: Witness: something outside the group, needing nothing itself, gives what was short.

atlas.text: Something beyond the family gives: a giver requiring nothing gives to the required condition, and a formation unsupported at step zero is supported at step one (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: balanced, only active formations giving and activity needing support, one formation's requirements never loosening, another formation gives at step 0 to the condition the first requires there, and the first, unsupported at step 0, is supported at step 1

words: Sufficient: no one hands it on from some step; once the last holders' time is up no one holds it.

atlas.text: Under the passing premise, with carriers brief for d: where no carrier passes it from T on, nothing carries it from T + d on.
atlas.to: nothing carries the pattern at any step from T + d on (¬ V.Present t for every t ≥ T + d)

words: Pace: while it lasts it is handed on at least once in every stretch as long as one holder lasts; a witness attains the bound. Rests on the premise that holding comes only by being handed it.

atlas.text: Under the passing premise, its carriers brief for d, the pattern is passed across one of every d consecutive steps from T on; PatternRelay attains the bound (a witness).

words: Sufficient, one crossing: the push back is larger than the gap to the mark, so the level lands on the other side.

atlas.text: Beyond the bound an opposing exchange crosses m: with balance across the step, above m and not within the gap, the next level is below m.
atlas.to: overshoot-beyond-the-gap

words: Witness: pushed back by more than the gap every time; crosses for ever and is never on the mark.

atlas.text: A balanced witness opposing the departure at every step and exceeding the gap at every step oscillates about m and is never m.
atlas.to: overshoot-beyond-the-gap

words: Sufficient: below the mark no more is given than is taken, so the level never gets back to the mark. 'Short of what it needs' is loose for 'below the mark'. Leads to family A's loss-of-renewal-for-good.

atlas.text: With balance from T, the joint exchange giving no more than it takes wherever the level is below m: a level below m at T never returns to m.
atlas.to: loss-of-renewal-for-good

words: Sufficient: the response comes some steps late and the band is narrower than what the level moves meanwhile; it leaves both ends of the band without end. Leads to family F's late-relay-oscillates.

atlas.text: A relay reading ℓ steps late, balanced at every step, a ≤ b, past b + 2 ≤ a + (ℓ + 1)M: from the start a − 1 held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, the level leaves both ends of the band without end.
atlas.to: late-relay-oscillates

words: Exact threshold in the band's width against lateness times step size. The far side says only that not every run settles in the band; exit 4 supplies the swinging.

atlas.text: With a ≤ b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1: every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ steps late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, settles in the band [a, b] exactly where a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1.
atlas.to: a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1: every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, is within [a, b] at every step from some T -> b + 1 < a + (ℓ + 1)M: not every such run is within [a, b] from some step on

words: How wide a band a late response needs: at least twice (lateness + 1) times the largest move a step; the late return attains it. A bound attained, not an iff.

atlas.text: A bound attained, not an iff in the Lean: a rule reading ℓ late that keeps the level within [a, b], 0 < a, under every rest moving it by at most d a step has a + 2(ℓ + 1)d ≤ b; where (ℓ + 1)d ≤ x₀ the late return keeps x₀ within (ℓ + 1)d on each side.
atlas.to: b < a + 2(ℓ + 1)d with 0 < a: no rule reading ℓ late keeps the level within [a, b] on its course from x₀ under every rest moving it by at most d a step -> with (ℓ + 1)d ≤ x₀, the late return, which reads ℓ late, keeps the level within (ℓ + 1)d of x₀ on each side under every such rest

words: Exact, one step: a dependant's need breaks exactly where the need plus all that is taken exceeds the level plus all that is given. Each taker alone can be within the slack; one holding back by the excess keeps it.

atlas.text: In a balanced flow a dependence met at a step breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given.
atlas.to: a dependence of g on c, met at t, broken across the step (the level at t + 1 below its need), exactly where the need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given

words: Sufficient: what is paid for each step the need is kept, plus what can be left at the end, is less than the need; every best course breaks a dependant's need within the plan. One planner under a supplied order.

atlas.text: Where c + e < m, every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon.
atlas.to: every optimum among the open courses, of every order rising with the worth, breaks f's dependence on c at some step within the horizon (∃ t ≤ n, W.Broken t f c)

words: Sufficient: the pay per step is below the need (and covers the renewal given up): kept to the last step, broken at the last.

atlas.text: Where r < q + c and c < m, every optimum meets it to the n-th step and breaks it at the last.
atlas.to: every optimum meets f's need of c at every step to the n-th and breaks the dependence at the last (W.Broken n f c)

words: Sufficient: keeping gives up more renewal each step than the pay for keeping; over a long enough plan every best course breaks the need. Leads to family B's keeping-forgoes-the-renewal-at-the-need.

atlas.text: Where q + c < r, a coupling of at most c a step with c + e < n + m falls below what keeping forgoes, so every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon.
atlas.to: keeping-forgoes-the-renewal-at-the-need

words: Witness: with pay counted at every step the need is met, a course that falls below the need once and meets it again ties with the keeping course; at a slightly higher pay every best course keeps it.

atlas.text: Under a burst renewing four at one, from the dweller's need two with capacity three, at a coupling of four a step: counted from the start every optimum keeps the dweller; counted at every step met, the course falling once and met again is an optimum beside the keeping course; five a step keeps it under every optimum.
atlas.to: a witness: under a burst renewing four at one, the dweller's need two, capacity three and a coupling of four a step counted at every step met, a course falling below the need once and met again is an optimum beside the keeping course; at five a step every optimum keeps the need

words: Tipping in the pay per step kept: where it covers the renewal that keeping gives up, the need is kept at every length of plan; below that a long plan outweighs it.

atlas.text: Where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon; where q + c < r, a long horizon outweighs the coupling.
atlas.to: r ≤ q + c and e < c: every optimum of every order rising with the worth keeps the need at every horizon -> q + c < r, with c + e < n + m: every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon

words: Sufficient, one direction: counted at every step met, the need is kept under a stated margin; at equality a fall that is met again can tie (witness).

atlas.text: Counted at every step met, wherever: every optimum keeps the need where r + e < q + c + m and e < c; at r + e = q + c + m a fall met again can tie (a witness). The law is one direction, where and not exactly where.
atlas.to: counted at every step met, r + e < q + c + m and e < c: every optimum keeps the need -> at r + e = q + c + m, a witness: a course falling once and met again is an optimum beside the keeping course

words: Sufficient: members together take a fixed amount more than comes back each step; the excess is spent each step until nothing and no member is left.

atlas.text: A family with a constant take of the renewal plus d, d at least one, closed under the steps that do not end, ends in level zero with no member at some step.
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Sufficient: holders leave before they are old enough to teach; after one tenure no one holds the rule, and no holder stays no holder. What ends is the rule's holding. Leads to family A.

atlas.text: Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level.
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Sufficient: the number let in is revised to none; the holders empty out likewise.

atlas.text: A revision to 0 where a holder stands empties the holders likewise.
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Witness: revisions from a state inside the band leave gaps between cohorts; it ends with the rule still held.

atlas.text: A state with gaps is reached by revisions from a state in the band and ends with the rule held (a witness).
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Exact, from the steady state with no revision: held at every step exactly where holders stay longer than it takes to become a teacher, at least one is let in, and what holders and entrants take over a tenure is within what comes back. Two conditions in one: handing on (outlives-members) and taking within renewal.

atlas.law: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«稳者恒持当且仅当在带»
atlas.text: From the steady state for quota q, taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, a level of at least one: held at every step exactly where l < s, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g, with e q := f − c · q · (s − l).
atlas.to: in the band (l < s, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g): from the steady state for q, taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, a level of at least one, the rule is held at every step -> outside the band: the rule is not held at some step

words: Necessary: with the supply cut, the one rebuilt from its own stock ends only with the stock empty, and from there nothing brings it back, supply on or off. Leads to family A.

atlas.text: Where the reader rebuilt from the level ends, the level is empty; that state is closed under the net, the supply on or off.
atlas.to: a-reader-rebuilt-from-its-stock-ends-with-it

words: Witness: from 'two cases look the same and need different handling' to 'they can be told apart and acted on', by rebuilding a link at the cost of one unit of stock. Both ends are family D's ground (what the view in force cannot tell apart); H proposes no place for it.

atlas.text: Starting with the link off and at least two units, rebuilding it opens the correction in one step (on Revising's process).
atlas.to: a witness on Revising's stock-and-link process: from the link off and n + 2 units, rebuilding the link in one step reaches a configuration with the link on and n + 1 units where a fitting uniform policy exists; with the link off none exists, both situations reading alike and needing different acts

words: Witness: the view is unchanged and there is no stock to act with; one unit given makes the correction possible. The destination is 'able to act', which 'back where it was' fits loosely.

atlas.text: Replenishing alone opens the correction where the link is on and the stock is not: the reading unchanged, the gain is in what can be executed.
atlas.to: a witness: with the link on and no stock, replenishing one unit reaches a configuration where a fitting uniform policy exists, the reading unchanged

words: Sufficient: nothing comes back from the work (return cut): no way of going on without end exists, whoever steers. 'Ended' here means no unending run, not a named last step.

atlas.text: With the return cut, at yield 0, the process has no run at all, under any controller.
atlas.to: becoming-renewal-reading

words: Exact threshold in a parameter: each round gives back at least the nine units it uses. Not a change in time.

atlas.text: At every yield, some configuration has every number of cycles executable from it exactly where the yield is at least nine.
atlas.to: yield at least nine: some configuration has every number of rounds of the history executable from it -> yield below nine: no configuration does

words: Exact: a round can be repeated any number of times exactly where its first pass is covered by the stock and what it gives back in all is at least what it takes in all.

atlas.text: In the stock process, one course can be repeated any number of times from stock n exactly where its first pass is covered from n (each draw within the stock then standing) and its total replenishment is at least its total draw.
atlas.to: the course's first pass covered from stock n and its total replenishment at least its total draw: it can be repeated any number of times from n -> otherwise: some number of repetitions is not covered from n

words: Sufficient: carriers leave no more carrying young than the others leave, and some copies lose it; the carriers' part falls at each step while any remain. Heads toward all-on-one without the law saying it arrives.

atlas.text: Where k ≤ w, with any loss and carriers present, the share falls at each step at which carriers remain.
atlas.to: carriers present, the carriers' share falls across the step: c k (c + d) < c (c k + (c m + d w)), the share cross-multiplied

words: Tipping (the error threshold): above it the carriers' part can rise and is kept exactly at one balance; at or below it the part never rises. Arriving at the balance is not shown.

atlas.text: Where k ≤ w the share never rises, whatever c, and with any loss falls at each step at which carriers remain: the error threshold.
atlas.to: w < k: carriers present, the share rises exactly where c m + d w < d k (rises_iff), and the step keeps it exactly at the balance c m + d w = d k -> k ≤ w: the share never rises, whatever c, and with any loss falls at each step at which carriers remain (the error threshold)

words: Witness: after the first exchange nothing more is exchanged; from then on neither reaches the other. No place for 'apart'; it is the precondition of 'uncounted' with no rule in it.

atlas.text: Read in time, mutual dependence can lapse: the Drawing pair is mutually dependent in time from its first step and not from the next, while mutual dependence read across all steps stands (Drawing.lapses); read across all steps it can hold with nothing affecting anything in time (LatePair.apart).
atlas.to: a witness (Drawing): the pair is mutually dependent and mutually dependent in time from step 0, and not from step 1: from step 1, for some formations f and g, g's continuation lies within f's closure in time at no step

words: Witness: each takes from what the other needs and nothing gives; they still depend on each other. It holds counting taking and giving, and fails counting giving only.

atlas.text: In Drawing, a balanced pair each taking one unit across the first step from the condition the other requires, every formation's acts return and the condition held de se at them holds along affecting and along being affected, not along feeding: exchanging counts taking as well as giving
atlas.to: a witness (Drawing): every formation's acts return, and the condition held de se at the returning formations holds along affecting and along being affected and fails along feeding

words: Pace: round a ring of links that act at every step, the most difference that can arrive at least doubles each time round. That the links act at every step is supplied.

atlas.text: Around a loop of m + 1 couplings holding at every step, under the standard bounds, the carried amount is at least 2^R times what had reached it by T and at most D(1 + M)^(T + (m + 1)R).
atlas.to: the carried amount at the loop's condition e at step T -> after R turns, at step T + (m + 1)R: at least 2^R times the amount at T and at most D(1 + M)^(T + (m + 1)R)

words: Sufficient, under wear that never heals (a supplied law): the first step of use beyond what comes back lowers what comes back, at once and for good.

atlas.text: With a positive initial rate, pressure beyond the rate at the first step lowers it at once and for good.
atlas.to: the renewal rate below its initial value at every step from the first on: ∀ k, (path law c0 demand (1 + k)).renew < c0.renew

words: Sufficient: each step's use exceeds what then comes back; nothing more is made after a number of steps fixed by the stock and the starting rate.

atlas.text: Where each step's pressure exceeds the then-current rate, nothing forms from the step equal to the bound on.
atlas.to: nothing forms at any step from the budget on: ∀ n, budget c0 ≤ n → formed law c0 demand n = 0, with budget c0 = stock + tri renew

words: Sufficient: two users, each within what comes back alone, together beyond it at every step; what they share ends. Each alone is in within-what-comes-back: the place belongs to the pair.

atlas.text: Two parts, each within renewal and ceaseless alone, together exceed the initial rate at every step: formation sharing the conditions ends.
atlas.to: each part alone within renewal forms at every step, and the formation sharing the conditions, under any allocation within what forms jointly, is nothing at every step from the budget on

words: Exact: the rate of return is kept at every step exactly when no step's use exceeds the starting rate.

atlas.text: With a positive initial rate, the rate is kept at every step exactly when no step's pressure exceeds the initial rate, zero pressure allowed.
atlas.to: no step's pressure exceeds the initial rate (zero pressure allowed): the rate is kept at every step -> some step's pressure exceeds the initial rate: the rate is not kept at some step

words: Necessary: a line ends only by a step that leaves what it had kept the same. The origin is really any place where a line goes on; outlives-members (widened) is the nearest. Family A's every-loss-passes-a-juncture is the same shape.

atlas.text: A step into an end under E leaves the core, for every relation E, and so does the last step of every line under E that ends.
atlas.to: a step that continues under E and leaves E's core: y continues x under E and the core of E does not make x and y alike («异» R E («核» R E) x y)

words: Witness: two bounds, each can be kept along some way of going on, and no way keeps both.

atlas.text: Each guard can be kept along some run while the two cannot be kept together.
atlas.to: witness (ChoicePoint): from the configuration split each of two guards is keepable, kept along some run, while no run keeps the two together

words: Exact: a start never reaches what is to be avoided exactly when it lies in some set that avoids it and that every step keeps. The general staying law, which 'holds-itself' and 'ended' also instance. Leads to family A's not-going-out-of-a-region.

atlas.text: For a determined law a start never reaches a target exactly when some set containing it avoids the target and is closed under the law, that is, exactly when it lies in the invariance kernel of the target's complement.
atlas.to: not-going-out-of-a-region

words: Exact in the model: with the correction weaker than the threshold, some state with something left never gets back into the protected region. For those states it is for good unless the correction changes; a later reader may prefer past-turning-back.

atlas.text: For 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error: every physical state with positive share lands exactly when the margin at threshold 3/8 under the worst influence is nonnegative, which is β ≤ 5/12; above it the fixed configuration is a closed set avoiding landing.
atlas.to: for β above 5/12 (with 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4), not every physical state with positive share lands: some never reaches the protection region, exactly as the margin at quality 3/8 under the worst influence is negative

words: Witness: right at the threshold, any small steady error in the adverse direction leaves some state that never gets back.

atlas.text: At β = 5/12, for every ε > 0 some constant adverse quality error below ε leaves a physical state with positive share that never lands.
atlas.to: witness: at β = 5/12, for every ε > 0 a constant adverse quality error e with 0 < e < ε and a physical state with positive share whose history under that noisy law never lands

words: Window: full correction for a stretch, then half, with enough support put in at the start to last the stretch; how long depends on how little is left, and no one length serves all. The origin is 'outside the protected region', loosely short-of-need. The intervention is assumed.

atlas.text: With β = 0 actually holding during the pulse, then β = 1/2, extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step and no other shocks, each positive state has a horizon N at which initial support at least K_N carries it through a finite correction into the original protection; no single N serves every positive share.
atlas.to: a physical operating state with positive renewing share, driven by the pulse (β = 0 during it, extra support consumption cost ≥ 0 a step) -> the original protection: at the horizon N the state is in the safe rectangle of the example, and its guarded history with no shock never fails

words: Exact threshold in the model: every state with something left gets back in finite time exactly where the correction is strong enough (at most 5/12 left uncorrected). The model's number, not a measured one.

atlas.text: Every physical rational state with positive renewing share, 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error, reaches the protection region in finite time exactly when β ≤ 5/12: the model's threshold, not a measured one, and not a complete basin of landing.
atlas.to: β ≤ 5/12: every physical state with positive share lands (reaches the protection region) in finite time -> β > 5/12 (up to 3/4): some physical state with positive share never lands

words: Window: partial correction within the threshold and a starting stock that covers the time it takes to get back.

atlas.text: For β ≤ 5/12 each such state has a landing time N, and, with extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step, initial stock at least the cover K_N carries its guarded run through the landing into the original protection.
atlas.to: a physical operating state with positive renewing share under partial correction β ≤ 5/12, support consumption cost ≥ 0 a step -> the original protection: at its landing time N the state is in the safe rectangle of the example, and its guarded history with no shock never fails

words: Sufficient: the reserve is less than the repair plus the move to the successor; the hand-over step cannot be taken.

atlas.text: A step is blocked where the carrier's reserve is below correction's draw plus migration.
atlas.to: the carrier's step is blocked: step returns none, so no successor generation is realized at that step

words: Sufficient: there is no replacement part; the step is blocked.

atlas.text: A step is blocked where the carrier has no part.
atlas.to: the carrier's step is blocked: step returns none, so no successor generation is realized at that step

words: Witness: the whole counts as safe while the one that has to carry it cannot take its step. Two places at two grains (the whole kept within bounds, the carrier short); not an arrow.

atlas.text: In the financed witness the aggregate is safe while a carrier with no part cannot take its step.
atlas.to: witness (financed): the aggregate market state is safe under the certificate at the raised fee while the carrier with no part cannot take its step

words: Witness: the one who was to review leaves before the round; the round cannot complete, so the practice is not handed on.

atlas.text: In a witness of the declared machine, the first reviewer's departure before the round makes the run fail.
atlas.to: witness: in the declared machine, a handoff to those present [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], which leaves out the first reviewer 0, before the round of reviewer 0 and worker 1 makes the run fail (run … = none): the practice round does not complete

words: Witness: a newcomer taken in before a tested retry; the run fails.

atlas.text: In a witness of the declared machine, enrollment before a tested retry makes the run fail.
atlas.to: witness: in the declared machine, enrolling worker 1 after attempt, response and revision but before a tested retry makes the run fail (run … = none): no admission without a tested review

words: Witness: support one unit short of what two rounds take; the last copy is left one piece short, all material kept.

atlas.text: Two rounds from one mature chain with the blocks for three chains and 26 units of support: the last successor has seven components, all material kept (with 27, four mature chains).
atlas.to: witness: two rounds from one mature chain with the blocks for three chains and 26 units of support, one short of the 27 the two rounds draw, end with chains of 8, 8, 8 and 7 components, one token left in the pool and all 26 units spent; the 32 units of material are all kept, and four mature chains are not reached

words: Witness: the pool lacks one kind the pattern needs; growth stops after one piece with work to spare.

atlas.text: From a pool of eight tokens of one kind with eight units, growth stalls after one token with seven units free.
atlas.to: witness: from a pool of eight tokens of one kind and eight units of support, growth stalls after one token, with seven tokens and seven units left: work remains while the pool does not supply the other kind the word needs

words: Exact: n rounds of b-fold copying run exactly while the stock covers what they take (k + bk + ... times the cost of one); past that the rounds cannot all run. A fixed stock: nothing comes back.

atlas.text: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly where d times k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k is at most m, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock.
atlas.to: the stock m covers what n rounds of b-fold copying from k units draw (d · requiredBy b n k ≤ m): the n rounds run and end with k · b^n units and m − d · requiredBy b n k of the stock -> the stock falls short of d · requiredBy b n k: no trace of n rounds of copying runs from (k, m)

words: Exact, the doubling case of transition 1.

atlas.text: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly when d · k(2^n − 1) ≤ m.
atlas.to: the stock m covers d · k(2^n − 1) (d · required n k ≤ m): n rounds of doubling run and end with k · 2^n units -> the stock falls short of d · k(2^n − 1): no trace of n rounds of doubling runs from (k, m)

words: Witness: nothing was set aside for stopping; after the first write everything is spent, it stays half-changed, the stop is refused and it keeps running.

atlas.text: This protocol reserves no stop: with nine units, recovery is exhausted after the first actual write: nothing is published, no tick follows, the shutdown command is refused and the activity still runs.
atlas.to: witness: with nine units and no reserved stop, after the first actual write the device stays pending with all nine units spent: nothing is published, no tick runs, the shutdown command is refused, and the activity still runs

words: Witness: a lost marker lets an old record be published that leaves out the real state, and a check made on the record passes. Family D's ground (a record that no longer matches the thing); H proposes no place for it.

atlas.text: Deleting the pending marker of a partly changed device publishes old bookkeeping whose candidates exclude the actual configuration, while a certificate over them accepts.
atlas.to: witness: a fault deleting the pending marker of a partly changed device publishes the old bookkeeping, whose candidates exclude the actual configuration, while a certificate over those candidates accepts

words: Sufficient: a stop set aside in advance, with a margin: every allowed sequence long enough ends stopped and safe. 'Ended' here is a stop that was provided for.

atlas.text: With a reserved stop: from an armed device every admissible schedule longer than the units of reserve above the three reserved, so from R units of at least R − 2 cycles, stops the supervisor, safe and stopped, given the grant, entry margin and bound on interruptions. This is a protocol entered with the margin in place: entry with nine units is refused, and the earlier witness's stranded state is not rescued.
atlas.to: the supervisor stops: every admissible schedule from an armed device longer than the reserve above three units runs to a stopped supervisor whose device is safe and stopped (completed, not running)

words: Sufficient, the general form of exit 3: a way out that stays open and a margin that falls with every other move; every allowed course longer than the margin ends at the way out.

atlas.text: For a partial law with a reserved exit, every admitted course longer than the margin from a valid configuration ends at the exit, valid.
atlas.to: every admitted course longer than the margin from a valid configuration runs and ends at the exit, valid

words: Witness: an interruption longer than was allowed for; the deadline passes, it is still running and no stop can be carried out.

atlas.text: Beyond the admitted bound: with interruption bound one and deadline fifteen, an interruption of ten breaks completion; the retained run is active at time eighteen with eight units used, still running, with no stop left executable.
atlas.to: witness: with interruption bound one and deadline fifteen, an interruption of ten breaks completion; the retained run is active at time eighteen with eight units used, still running, and no stop is left executable

words: Window, exact: the interrupted change completes in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly where the reserve covers them and the deadline is at least that far off; otherwise it stays half-done.

atlas.text: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps exactly when the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline lies at least n + 1 steps ahead.
atlas.to: the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline lies at least n + 1 steps ahead: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps -> the reserve or the deadline falls short of n + 1: no resumption of n + 1 steps publishes, and every shorter one leaves the device pending

words: Pace on exit 4's arrow: longer than the margin always reaches the way out; exactly as long as the margin can miss it (witness).

atlas.text: Every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit; a course of exactly the margin's length can miss it (Countdown.Slow, a witness), so the bound is attained.
atlas.to: an admitted course from a valid configuration longer than the margin: it ends at the exit, valid -> a course exactly as long as the margin: it can miss the exit (Countdown.Slow: n moves from margin n end at some 0, not at the exit)

words: Witness: later steps count for less than half of the step before, so every best course takes what is left and ends it; counting for more than half, every best course lets it regrow first (the entry's main law, which is short-of-need to made-good-again and has no item). 'Run down' is the origin, loosely short-of-need. Leads to family B.

atlas.text: In the doubling witness, where 2 w (t + 1) < w t, every optimum ends it.
atlas.to: a-weighting-faster-than-renewal-ends-the-base

words: Witness: copied exactly at one step only; one member for two generations, then none.

atlas.text: Exact at step 0 only and concordant there, the course has one member at cohorts 1 and 2 and is empty from cohort 3 on.
atlas.to: witness: a course read by offspring number, exact at step 0 and not at step 1, concordant at step 0, has one member at cohorts 1 and 2 and is empty from cohort 3 on, so goes_on's conclusion at t = 0 fails

words: Witness: those with the mark leave more at every step before the last; then none are left.

atlas.text: Concordance with the mark positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, and the family empty from N + 1 on.
atlas.to: witness: concordance with the mark positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, and the family empty from N + 1 on

words: Witness: having young simply stops; the count looked favourable at every generation but the last.

atlas.text: Reproduction simply stopped, the mark a label rather than a draw: the term is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, where it is zero, while every member degenerates.
atlas.to: witness: reproduction simply stopped, the mark a label rather than a draw: the term is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, where it is zero, while every member degenerates («退化»)

words: Sufficient: past every step there is a later one where those with the mark leave more; then every generation has members. Leads to the pilot's persisting-filters-what-was-chosen: such a line never used faster than it came back for long.

atlas.text: Where past every step there is a later one at which the selection term proper is positive, every generation is nonempty, so the line has a member in every cohort and persists (SelectionTerm.Generations.persists_of_alive); under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, the gate and every cohort coupled to the family at a need of at least m, such a line never overdrew it (Flow.persists_never_overdraws)
atlas.to: persisting-filters-what-was-chosen

words: A description of what is left after the filter: those still going look as if they put keeping above ending on the occasions met. It is faster-than-it-comes-back to ended read backwards; not a change of place. Leads to the pilot's persisting-filters.

atlas.text: Where a line carries its reading, every occasion picks it, the world is the course that reading generates and a reading ends where that course overdraws a family from a short stock, the filter's realization premise is the identity, ending being defined as that overdraw, so nothing is derived about the stake; under the filter's remaining premises some strict order according with the choices puts every reading that does not end above every ending one met with it
atlas.to: persisting-filters-what-was-chosen

words: Sufficient: two ways of seeing that lead to the same acts on everything that comes back to the line cannot be told apart by whether the line is still there late, whatever they say of the rest. Fits 'uncounted' if being still there counts as the measure.

atlas.text: With the rest reading through coupling, the two acts laws of what has stood, the first reading each slot's couplings only, agreeing under every history on what couples into the line's coupling closure drawn through both courses, both courses feasible and each slot's own standing coupled in, the line's slots stand late in the one course exactly when in the other, whatever the readings say of what lies beyond: the blindness with standing late as the selection
atlas.to: unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure

words: Witness: where those it clears away renew its own source (each depends on the others), the line that looks only to itself and its source ends with them, and the line that takes everything in goes on. Where nothing comes back from them, the clearing line goes on and they end: that half is 'uncounted' to 'ended'.

atlas.text: Where the dweller's line renews the source, the line reading itself and its source clears the habitat and is gone from the fourth step, after the dweller's line, while the line reading everything persists with it (Habitat.back_which_persist); where nothing comes back, the line reading itself alone overdraws its source and ends, and the clearing and the sparing lines both persist (Habitat.beyond_which_persist). Which conduct each reading gives is designed
atlas.to: witness: where the dweller's line renews the source, the line reading itself and its source clears the habitat and does not persist, nor does the dweller's line, while the line reading everything persists and so does the dweller's

words: Witness: those removed were the ones placed to notice; the measure taken among those left holds. Leads to the pilot's selection-read-off-its-own-survivors.

atlas.text: In the course where the line reads its source and nothing comes back, selection by persistence read off the course's pool holds while the course removes the dweller's line, read as a reader of the habitat; read off the fixed pool of both lines it fails there
atlas.to: selection-read-off-its-own-survivors

words: An identification, not a change: handing on unchanged is the special case of revising at hand-over. It is what joins this entry to the pilot's readings-revised-spread-and-locked (several-ways, all-on-one, holds-itself). A 'same place seen in another model' mark would fit.

atlas.text: Inheritance along descent is revision by the update that keeps the reading; letting the update read what the parent sensed, readings vary at descent, and a region's count moves by Price's equation with revision as its transmission term
atlas.to: readings-revised-spread-and-locked

words: Witness: the mark it is checked against is set wrong, so a real loss does not show and the aim stays. Loose: an aim, not a rule. Family D's 'record that no longer matches' may fit better.

atlas.text: A false reference leaves the attendance goal in place despite a real loss.
atlas.to: witness: under a real access loss, an acquired attendance goal assessed with its reference set false (reference := some true) and then revised keeps the attendance goal

words: Witness: the loss is recognised and nothing responds, so the aim stays; with a response, on the same grounds, it changes. Loose fit (an aim held by one party).

atlas.text: Without response the goal is not revised though the grounds are the same.
atlas.to: witness: under a real access loss, revision without response leaves the goal at attendance while revision with response moves it to learning, the grounds being the same

words: Witness: two losses at once (of access and of the means of changing over); the revision cannot complete.

atlas.text: Crossed losses block revision.
atlas.to: witness: with access loss and transition loss together (crossed losses), revision leaves the goal at attendance and acquisition, revision and reform do not complete (completed = none)

words: Witness: one unit of work where a round needs two; the re-forming fails.

atlas.text: Reform with work 1 fails.
atlas.to: witness: reform from a revised state whose work is one unit fails (none): a cycle needs two units of work

words: Exact: a practice runs n rounds exactly while work and reserve cover two units for each. A fixed stock.

atlas.text: A practice runs n cycles from work w and reserve q exactly where n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and twice the cycles the reserve does not support is at most w.
atlas.to: n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and twice the cycles the reserve does not support is at most w: the practice runs n cycles -> otherwise: the n cycles do not all run (cycles … returns none)

words: Exact in the construction: the aim is taken up, revised and the practice re-formed exactly where there is a loss of access and the means of changing over is kept. Loose fit: an aim, not a rule rebuilt from results.

atlas.text: Acquisition, revision and reform complete for a condition exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance.
atlas.to: access loss with transition maintenance kept: acquisition, revision and reform complete -> no access loss, or transition maintenance lost: completion fails (completed c = none)

words: Exact: after the re-forming five more operations run and no more (two without it).

atlas.text: Under access loss with kept transition maintenance, after acquisition, revision and reform n operations run exactly where n ≤ 5; without reform, exactly where n ≤ 2.
atlas.to: after acquisition, revision and reform, n ≤ 5: the n operations run, and every such run ends with the goal learning, one loss kept and the archive at 2 + n; without reform, the n operations run exactly where n ≤ 2 -> n > 5 after reform (n > 2 without reform): the n operations do not all run

words: Exact: everything that follows from a member is on its own line exactly where everything that follows from it is alike to it. This is the place's second clause (what one affects stays on one's own line), for one member, not a group. See doubts.

atlas.law: Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»
atlas.text: Everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, with no regularity assumed.
atlas.to: for a class E, everything downstream of m lies on its line under E exactly where everything downstream of m is alike to it; with no regularity assumed

words: Sufficient: its line ends while its last stage still affects something; then not everything it affects is on its line. Leads to 'something lies outside', which has no place without a rule.

atlas.text: Where a line from the member ends while its last stage still conditions something, not everything downstream of the member lies on its line.
atlas.to: not everything downstream of m lies on its line under E: the line from m ends at y while y still conditions something

words: Witness: its effects leave its kind; what they feed is not reached on its line.

atlas.text: Where a member's line runs through a condition but the member's effects leave its class, a constant class holding the member with the condition does not reach what the condition feeds.
atlas.to: witness (Unclosed): under a constant class holding the member with a condition its line runs through, the member's effects leave the class, and what the condition feeds is not alike to the member and is not reached on its line

words: Witness: the kind is not kept steady along the way; what follows need not be alike.

atlas.text: Where the class is not constant even up to the net's end, a class holding a member's effects need not have what follows them alike to it.
atlas.to: witness (Inconstant): a class holding the member's effects that is not constant even up to the net's end has something downstream of the member not alike to it

words: Sufficient: grown by adding one link at a time, so cutting any link leaves its two ends apart. 'In one piece' is weaker than each depending on the others; no place for 'apart'.

atlas.text: Every link of a relation grown by attachment separates its ends when cut.
atlas.to: with the grown link (p, n) cut, its ends lie apart: p and n are not within one closure of the remaining links

words: Witness: a second link across the cut; it stays one piece, and the cut uses up material and returns nothing.

atlas.text: An actual aggregation adds the retaining edge (0,7) to the chain; after cutting (3,4) it stays one component of all eight, so the certificate fails and the cut returns nothing.
atlas.to: witness: with the retaining edge (0, 7) aggregated onto the chain, cutting (3, 4) leaves one component of all eight, so the cut certificate fails and the cut returns nothing

words: Exact: after one added join, a cut changes nothing exactly where the join crosses the cut link.

atlas.text: After one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join crosses it.
atlas.to: the join crosses the cut link: without it p reaches a and b reaches n, or p reaches b and a reaches n; cutting the grown link changes no closure -> the join does not cross the cut link: cutting the grown link changes some closure

words: Sufficient: the level never rises and falls at every step the user is active; the user cannot go on being active. A double-negation form: no last step is named.

atlas.text: From T on a condition's level never rises across a step and falls across every step at which a formation is active: the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps.
atlas.to: it is not the case that the formation f is active at arbitrarily late steps of the run (¬ ∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ f active at t)

words: Sufficient: every possible step lowers a reserve; no way of going on without end exists.

atlas.text: Where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve of the configuration, the process has no run.
atlas.to: the process has no run: where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve, no infinite execution exists

words: Witness: from one start, taking two where one comes back uses it up and the one who depends on it stops from the next step; taking one, it renews. The place belongs to the way of going on, not to the start; what ends is a dependant, the user stays active.

atlas.text: Drawing two units a step where a condition gains one, the focal formation consumes the condition, and the sustaining formation, depending on it at need one, is inactive at every step from one on; drawing one from the same configuration, it renews.
atlas.to: witness (Renewable): from one configuration, with the focal formation active at every step of both runs, drawing two units a step where the condition gains one consumes it (ConsumingIn) and the sustaining formation is inactive at every step from one on, while drawing one renews (RenewingIn)

words: Pace: where more is given than taken at each step, the need m is reached in m minus the present level steps. Staying there afterwards is not given ('recovery does not guarantee maintenance').

atlas.text: Where giving jointly exceeds taking at each step at which the level is not below its start, m − level steps bring it to at least m.
atlas.to: c at its level at T, given more than is taken at each step at which it is not below that start -> c at least at m by step T + (m − its level at T)

words: Witness. Nothing supported; what one of them needs loosens, and it is supported at the next step. The entry calls this transformation, not recovery.

atlas.text: A requirement dissolves (requirements loosen): a formation unsupported at step zero is supported at step one (a witness); dissolving a requirement is transformation, not recovery.
atlas.to: a witness: balanced, only active formations giving and activity needing support, with nothing supported at step 0, a formation whose requirement loosens across step 0 is supported at step 1

words: Witness. Something outside the group, needing nothing itself, gives to what a member needs; supported at the next step.

atlas.text: Something beyond the family gives: a giver requiring nothing gives to the required condition, and a formation unsupported at step zero is supported at step one (a witness).
atlas.to: a witness: balanced, only active formations giving and activity needing support, one formation's requirements never loosening, another formation gives at step 0 to the condition the first requires there, and the first, unsupported at step 0, is supported at step 1

words: Sufficient, under the handing-on premise: nobody hands it on from some step; gone within one member's span d.

atlas.text: Under the passing premise, with carriers brief for d: where no carrier passes it from T on, nothing carries it from T + d on.
atlas.to: nothing carries the pattern at any step from T + d on (¬ V.Present t for every t ≥ T + d)

words: Pace: it must be handed on at least once in every d steps; the relay example meets the bound.

atlas.text: Under the passing premise, its carriers brief for d, the pattern is passed across one of every d consecutive steps from T on; PatternRelay attains the bound (a witness).

words: Sufficient: a correction larger than the gap to the mark puts the next level on the other side. One crossing; the swinging itself is exit 2.

atlas.text: Beyond the bound an opposing exchange crosses m: with balance across the step, above m and not within the gap, the next level is below m.
atlas.to: overshoot-beyond-the-gap

words: Witness: every correction exceeds the gap; alternates about the mark and is never on it.

atlas.text: A balanced witness opposing the departure at every step and exceeding the gap at every step oscillates about m and is never m.
atlas.to: overshoot-beyond-the-gap

words: Sufficient: below the mark, given no more than is taken there, the level never returns. Correction from one side only. Needs the reworded test.

atlas.text: With balance from T, the joint exchange giving no more than it takes wherever the level is below m: a level below m at T never returns to m.
atlas.to: loss-of-renewal-for-good

words: Sufficient: a push made on a measure l steps old, past b + 2 <= a + (l+1)M, leaves both ends of the band without end.

atlas.text: A relay reading ℓ steps late, balanced at every step, a ≤ b, past b + 2 ≤ a + (ℓ + 1)M: from the start a − 1 held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, the level leaves both ends of the band without end.
atlas.to: late-relay-oscillates

words: Exact threshold, both ways in the parameter: settles in the band exactly when the delayed push fits inside it, a + (l+1)M <= b + 1.

atlas.text: With a ≤ b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1: every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ steps late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, settles in the band [a, b] exactly where a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1.
atlas.to: a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1: every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, is within [a, b] at every step from some T -> b + 1 < a + (ℓ + 1)M: not every such run is within [a, b] from some step on

words: A bound attained, not an iff: a measure l steps old against pushes of d a step keeps no band narrower than 2(l+1)d.

atlas.text: A bound attained, not an iff in the Lean: a rule reading ℓ late that keeps the level within [a, b], 0 < a, under every rest moving it by at most d a step has a + 2(ℓ + 1)d ≤ b; where (ℓ + 1)d ≤ x₀ the late return keeps x₀ within (ℓ + 1)d on each side.
atlas.to: b < a + 2(ℓ + 1)d with 0 < a: no rule reading ℓ late keeps the level within [a, b] on its course from x₀ under every rest moving it by at most d a step -> with (ℓ + 1)d ≤ x₀, the late return, which reads ℓ late, keeps the level within (ℓ + 1)d of x₀ on each side under every such rest

words: Exact, one step: a need that was met is broken exactly where the need plus all that is taken exceeds the level plus all that is given. Each taker alone can be within the slack.

atlas.text: In a balanced flow a dependence met at a step breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given.
atlas.to: a dependence of g on c, met at t, broken across the step (the level at t + 1 below its need), exactly where the need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given

words: Sufficient: what the taker gets for each step kept, plus what the end leaves, is less than the need (c + e < m); every best plan breaks the need within the horizon.

atlas.text: Where c + e < m, every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon.
atlas.to: every optimum among the open courses, of every order rising with the worth, breaks f's dependence on c at some step within the horizon (∃ t ≤ n, W.Broken t f c)

words: Sufficient: r < q + c and c < m; kept to the last step and broken at the last.

atlas.text: Where r < q + c and c < m, every optimum meets it to the n-th step and breaks it at the last.
atlas.to: every optimum meets f's need of c at every step to the n-th and breaks the dependence at the last (W.Broken n f c)

words: Sufficient: what keeping forgoes each step exceeds the return for keeping (q + c < r) and the horizon is long. Joins family B's 'what keeping forgoes'.

atlas.text: Where q + c < r, a coupling of at most c a step with c + e < n + m falls below what keeping forgoes, so every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon.
atlas.to: keeping-forgoes-the-renewal-at-the-need

words: Witness at the tie: a plan that falls below the need once and meets it again is as good as keeping; one unit more a step and every best plan keeps. A boundary case of transition 2, not a change of place.

atlas.text: Under a burst renewing four at one, from the dweller's need two with capacity three, at a coupling of four a step: counted from the start every optimum keeps the dweller; counted at every step met, the course falling once and met again is an optimum beside the keeping course; five a step keeps it under every optimum.
atlas.to: a witness: under a burst renewing four at one, the dweller's need two, capacity three and a coupling of four a step counted at every step met, a course falling below the need once and met again is an optimum beside the keeping course; at five a step every optimum keeps the need

words: Tipping in a parameter: kept at every horizon where r <= q + c and e < c; where q + c < r a long horizon outweighs it. Two sufficient laws, not one iff.

atlas.text: Where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon; where q + c < r, a long horizon outweighs the coupling.
atlas.to: r ≤ q + c and e < c: every optimum of every order rising with the worth keeps the need at every horizon -> q + c < r, with c + e < n + m: every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon

words: Sufficient, one direction: counted at every step met, kept where r + e < q + c + m and e < c.

atlas.text: Counted at every step met, wherever: every optimum keeps the need where r + e < q + c + m and e < c; at r + e = q + c + m a fall met again can tie (a witness). The law is one direction, where and not exactly where.
atlas.to: counted at every step met, r + e < q + c + m and e < c: every optimum keeps the need -> at r + e = q + c + m, a witness: a course falling once and met again is an optimum beside the keeping course

words: Sufficient: a constant take above the renewal by at least one; level zero and no member at some step.

atlas.text: A family with a constant take of the renewal plus d, d at least one, closed under the steps that do not end, ends in level zero with no member at some step.
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Sufficient: members leave before they are old enough to teach (tenure <= teaching age); no holder of the rule after s steps.

atlas.text: Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level.
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Sufficient: the quota revised to zero empties the holders.

atlas.text: A revision to 0 where a holder stands empties the holders likewise.
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Witness: revisions from inside the band leave gaps between cohorts; it ends with the rule still held.

atlas.text: A state with gaps is reached by revisions from a state in the band and ends with the rule held (a witness).
atlas.to: a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return

words: Exact, from the steady state only: held at every step exactly where teaching age < tenure, quota >= 1 and holders plus entrants take no more than the renewal. The band is two conditions at once: handing on in time, and within-renewal.

atlas.law: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«稳者恒持当且仅当在带»
atlas.text: From the steady state for quota q, taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, a level of at least one: held at every step exactly where l < s, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g, with e q := f − c · q · (s − l).
atlas.to: in the band (l < s, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g): from the steady state for q, taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, a level of at least one, the rule is held at every step -> outside the band: the rule is not held at some step

words: Necessary: what is rebuilt from its own store ends only with the store empty; that state then stays, supply on or off.

atlas.text: Where the reader rebuilt from the level ends, the level is empty; that state is closed under the net, the supply on or off.
atlas.to: a-reader-rebuilt-from-its-stock-ends-with-it

words: Witness: two cases look alike and need different acts, so no fitting way to act exists; rebuilding the link that tells them apart (at the cost of a unit) opens a correction. The start is also family D's 'cannot tell apart'.

atlas.text: Starting with the link off and at least two units, rebuilding it opens the correction in one step (on Revising's process).
atlas.to: a witness on Revising's stock-and-link process: from the link off and n + 2 units, rebuilding the link in one step reaches a configuration with the link on and n + 1 units where a fitting uniform policy exists; with the link off none exists, both situations reading alike and needing different acts

words: Witness: the cases can be told apart but there is no stock to act; one unit replenished opens the correction.

atlas.text: Replenishing alone opens the correction where the link is on and the stock is not: the reading unchanged, the gain is in what can be executed.
atlas.to: a witness: with the link on and no stock, replenishing one unit reaches a configuration where a fitting uniform policy exists, the reading unchanged

words: Sufficient: nothing comes back from the work (yield 0); no unending run under any way of steering.

atlas.text: With the return cut, at yield 0, the process has no run at all, under any controller.
atlas.to: becoming-renewal-reading

words: Exact threshold: every number of rounds can be run exactly where what a round gives back covers the nine units a round uses.

atlas.text: At every yield, some configuration has every number of cycles executable from it exactly where the yield is at least nine.
atlas.to: yield at least nine: some configuration has every number of rounds of the history executable from it -> yield below nine: no configuration does

words: Exact threshold: a round can be repeated any number of times exactly where its first pass is covered and its total given back is at least its total taken.

atlas.text: In the stock process, one course can be repeated any number of times from stock n exactly where its first pass is covered from n (each draw within the stock then standing) and its total replenishment is at least its total draw.
atlas.to: the course's first pass covered from stock n and its total replenishment at least its total draw: it can be repeated any number of times from n -> otherwise: some number of repetitions is not covered from n

words: Sufficient: those with the trait leave no more faithful copies than the others leave offspring, with some copies lost; their part falls at every step while any remain. Needs the reworded shaping-costs; not a firm fit.

atlas.text: Where k ≤ w, with any loss and carriers present, the share falls at each step at which carriers remain.
atlas.to: carriers present, the carriers' share falls across the step: c k (c + d) < c (c k + (c m + d w)), the share cross-multiplied

words: Tipping in a parameter (the error threshold): from a balance that a run at or below it keeps, to falling at every step. The from end is weak: reaching the balance is not shown.

atlas.text: Where k ≤ w the share never rises, whatever c, and with any loss falls at each step at which carriers remain: the error threshold.
atlas.to: w < k: carriers present, the share rises exactly where c m + d w < d k (rises_iff), and the step keeps it exactly at the balance c m + d w = d k -> k ≤ w: the share never rises, whatever c, and with any loss falls at each step at which carriers remain (the error threshold)

words: Witness: the tie lapses in time; after one exchange neither reaches the other again. 'Come apart' has no place in this proposal.

atlas.text: Read in time, mutual dependence can lapse: the Drawing pair is mutually dependent in time from its first step and not from the next, while mutual dependence read across all steps stands (Drawing.lapses); read across all steps it can hold with nothing affecting anything in time (LatePair.apart).
atlas.to: a witness (Drawing): the pair is mutually dependent and mutually dependent in time from step 0, and not from step 1: from step 1, for some formations f and g, g's continuation lies within f's closure in time at no step

words: Witness: the two are tied by taking from each other, not by feeding; both stand at the first step only. The place includes mutual draining.

atlas.text: In Drawing, a balanced pair each taking one unit across the first step from the condition the other requires, every formation's acts return and the condition held de se at them holds along affecting and along being affected, not along feeding: exchanging counts taking as well as giving
atlas.to: a witness (Drawing): every formation's acts return, and the condition held de se at the returning formations holds along affecting and along being affected and fails along feeding
